ARQUIVO: README.md

# Omega-OS — Cortex neural-simbólico paginado

Kernel x86-64 C99 freestanding com compilador Ômega e inferência Llama em Ring 3.
`user/omega/cortex.c` reúne leitura GGUF, kernels quantizados, RMSNorm, RoPE,
atenção paginada GQA, SwiGLU, logits, arbitragem racional e emissão JIT.
Os modelos são arquivos GGUF reais fornecidos pelo operador; não há download
implícito de pesos nem modelo de linguagem treinado embutido no kernel.

| Contrato | Implementação |
|---|---|
| Contexto vetorial | CR4.OSXSAVE/XCR0, áreas privadas alinhadas de 832 bytes, XSAVE/XRSTOR e fallback FXSAVE/FXRSTOR |
| Memória limitada | PMM de 64 MiB; cache de até 64 frames de 4 KiB; páginas de pesos/KV acessadas por capacidades, LRU e backing SLS |
| Quantização | F32/F16, Q8_0, Q4_K e Q6_K — incluindo a combinação Q4_K_M |
| MatMul | Painéis de inteiros com acumulação int64 escalar/SWAR ou AVX2; projeções quantizadas com desquantização Q8/Q4 em registradores e FMA |
| Atenção | KV FP16 por página, GQA e softmax online; sem buffer de scores proporcional ao contexto |
| Arbitragem | Máscara nos logits reais antes da seleção, contratos racionais explícitos e e-graph original do Ômega |
| Código sintetizado | AST racional derivada do candidato aceito, encoder nativo e syscall 11 com auditoria canônica W^X |
| Persistência/cluster | Checkpoint CoW de KV/descritor/logits; hashes de modelo/KV/JIT vinculados ao certificado assinado; votante confere seu prefixo SLS |

O código e os testes são executáveis; não constituem prova formal de um kernel
ou garantia de correção de linguagem natural. O consenso permanece maioria
assinada 2/3 com líder fixo honesto, sem BFT geral ou eleição.

## Build e testes

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-test.txt
make clean
make -j4
make test-host
make test-cortex-scale QEMU=/workspace/tools/bin/qemu-system-x86_64
make test-cortex QEMU=/workspace/tools/bin/qemu-system-x86_64
make test QEMU=/workspace/tools/bin/qemu-system-x86_64
make bundle
```

Use `QEMU=qemu-system-x86_64` numa instalação comum. Neste ambiente, o wrapper
em `/workspace/tools/bin/` fornece bibliotecas e firmware. Reutilize o checkout
isolado existente; não crie worktrees para executar o projeto. Não há serviço
persistente do host a iniciar: cada teste cria e encerra seus QEMU.

O build gera `build/cortex.elf`, `build/compiler.elf` e `omega_os.elf`. Kernel e
ELFs usam C99/O3/LTO, `-ffreestanding -nostdlib -fno-builtin`, sem red zone e
`-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic`. Somente o córtex permite instruções FP/SIMD;
o kernel continua compilado com `-mgeneral-regs-only`. As referências NumPy,
OpenSSL e cryptography pertencem exclusivamente ao host de build/teste.

Os testes do córtex executam Q8/AVX2, Q4_K+Q6_K/AVX2 e Q4_K+Q6_K/escalar,
comparam logits e KV com uma implementação NumPy independente e reiniciam os
discos. As VMs desse teste possuem 64 MiB de RAM. Configuram uma KV lógica de **1 GiB**, usando no máximo **256 KiB** de
frames do pager. Os pesos dessas provas são fixtures numéricas GGUF claramente
identificadas; validam o motor completo, sem alegar qualidade de um LLM treinado.

O teste de escala escreve e verifica **17.000 páginas / 66,4 MiB de dados reais**,
mais que toda a RAM da VM, com 64 frames de cache e GC em disco.

A suíte de cluster inicia três nós roteados, testa isolamento, SIGKILL e retomada,
confere assinaturas e dois epochs com checkpoints do córtex. A suíte completa
preserva os testes V4, GC em disco de 1 MiB, oito fronteiras SIGKILL, corrupção,
rede cifrada e isolamento. Os testes de quórum configuram uma cadência maior
entre bursts para permitir auditar os checkpoints enquanto os três nós vivem.

## Executar pesos próprios

```sh
python3 tools/cortex_model.py modelo.gguf cortex.img --size-mib 4096 \
    --steps 1 --prompt 1,128000
make run DISK=cortex.img QEMU=/workspace/tools/bin/qemu-system-x86_64
```

A ferramenta cria uma **nova** imagem, recusando sobrescrita. Dimensione o disco
para pesos, KV e as duas regiões CoW. `--prompt` recebe IDs do tokenizer do modelo;
não existe tokenizer de texto geral nessa entrega. Para AVX2, acrescente `-cpu max`
ao QEMU ou use o teste Cortex. O `make run` padrão também funciona com fallback.
Uma imagem sem GGUF inicia o processo e informa que aguarda pesos; não finge inferência.

`--contracts regras.json` ativa decodificação lógica fechada. Exemplo:

```json
[{"token":0,"num":1,"den":2},{"token":3,"num":-1,"den":2}]
```

Só os IDs anotados, com transições racionais válidas e norma quadrática ≤1,
permanecem elegíveis. Tokens desconhecidos ou inválidos recebem -INFINITY. Sem
esse arquivo o modo é inferência neural normal, sem promessa de poda semântica.
O vocabulário/tokenizador externo deve dar a esses IDs o significado declarado.

Consulte [arquitetura e contratos Cortex](docs/CORTEX.md),
[V4](docs/V4.md), [V3](docs/V3.md) e [evidência V4](docs/V4-validation.md).
O arquivo [omega_os_fontes.txt](omega_os_fontes.txt) reúne fontes e cápsulas
públicas geradas; exclui pesos binários, imagens, initrds e chaves privadas.

ARQUIVO: Makefile

CC = gcc
OBJCOPY = objcopy
QEMU = qemu-system-x86_64
QEMU_IMG = qemu-img
DISK ?= disk.img
CFLAGS = -std=c99 -ffreestanding -O3 -flto -fno-stack-protector -fno-pie -no-pie -mno-red-zone -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Iinclude -Iinclude/crypto -Ibuild
CFLAGS += -fno-builtin -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -fno-unwind-tables -mgeneral-regs-only -MMD -MP
SOURCES = $(wildcard src/*.c) $(wildcard src/crypto/*.c)
OBJECTS = $(SOURCES:src/%.c=build/%.o)
.PHONY: all clean run test test-v4 test-cortex test-cortex-scale test-host bundle
all: omega_os.elf $(DISK)
build:
	mkdir -p $@
build/%.o: src/%.c | build
	mkdir -p $(dir $@)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
USERFLAGS = -mcmodel=large -std=c99 -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -O3 -flto -fno-stack-protector -fno-pie -mno-red-zone -mgeneral-regs-only -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Iinclude -Iinclude/crypto -Iuser/omega
build/omega_generated.c: tests/bootstrap_omega.py $(shell find vendor/omega -type f) | build
	python3 tests/bootstrap_omega.py
build/omega_generated.o: build/omega_generated.c user/omega/omega_value.h
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/omega_driver.o: user/omega/driver.c user/omega/omega_value.h | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/omega_rational.o: src/rational.c | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/omega_bytecode.o: src/bytecode.c | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/omega_jit.o: src/jit.c | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/omega_incubator.o: user/omega/incubator.c | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/compiler.elf: build/omega_generated.o build/omega_driver.o build/omega_rational.o build/omega_bytecode.o build/omega_jit.o build/omega_incubator.o user/omega/link.ld
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -nostdlib -no-pie -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-T,user/omega/link.ld -Wl,--build-id=none -o $@ $(filter %.o,$^)
build/omega_library.o: user/omega/driver.c user/omega/omega_value.h | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -DOMEGA_LIBRARY -c $< -o $@
CORTEXFLAGS = $(filter-out -mgeneral-regs-only,$(USERFLAGS)) -ffp-contract=off
build/cortex.o: user/omega/cortex.c include/cortex.h | build
	$(CC) $(CORTEXFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/cortex_crypto.o: src/crypto/monocypher.c | build
	$(CC) $(USERFLAGS) -c $< -o $@
build/cortex.elf: build/cortex.o build/omega_library.o build/omega_generated.o build/omega_rational.o build/omega_bytecode.o build/omega_jit.o build/cortex_crypto.o user/omega/link.ld
	$(CC) $(CORTEXFLAGS) -nostdlib -no-pie -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,-T,user/omega/link.ld -Wl,--build-id=none -o $@ $(filter %.o,$^)
build/agent.o: user/agent.c | build
	$(CC) -std=c99 -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -O2 -fno-stack-protector -fno-pie -mno-red-zone -mgeneral-regs-only -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -c $< -o $@
build/agent.bin: build/agent.o user/agent.ld
	$(LD) -T user/agent.ld $< -o $@
ifneq ($(AUTHORITY_BUNDLE),)
build/capsule.h: $(AUTHORITY_BUNDLE) | build
	cp $< $@
else
build/capsule.h: build/agent.bin build/compiler.elf build/cortex.elf tests/make_capsule.py
	python3 tests/make_capsule.py
endif
build/admission.o: build/capsule.h
build/omega64.elf: $(OBJECTS) link.ld
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -nostdlib -Wl,-T,link.ld -Wl,--build-id=none -Wl,-z,max-page-size=0x1000 $(OBJECTS) -o $@
# QEMU's Multiboot loader requires an ELF32 container; code switches to long mode.
omega_os.elf: build/omega64.elf
	$(OBJCOPY) -O elf32-i386 $< $@
$(DISK):
	@if command -v $(QEMU_IMG) >/dev/null 2>&1; then $(QEMU_IMG) create -f raw $@ 32M; else python3 -c "with open('$@', 'xb') as f: f.truncate(32*1024*1024)"; fi
run: omega_os.elf $(DISK)
	$(QEMU) -kernel omega_os.elf -drive file=$(DISK),if=virtio,format=raw -smp 2 -m 128M -serial stdio -display none
test-cortex-scale: omega_os.elf
	python3 tests/cortex_scale.py "$(QEMU)"
test-cortex: omega_os.elf
	python3 tests/cortex_validation.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/cortex_cluster.py "$(QEMU)"
test-v4: omega_os.elf
	python3 tests/v4_validation.py "$(QEMU)"
test: omega_os.elf
	python3 tests/cortex_scale.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/cortex_validation.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/cortex_cluster.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/v4_validation.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/v3_validation.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/corruption_test.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/v3_network.py "$(QEMU)"
	python3 tests/format_test.py "$(QEMU)"
test-host: build/capsule.h | build
	python3 tests/cortex_math.py
	python3 tests/jit_test.py
	python3 tests/consensus_test.py
	python3 tests/tunnel_test.py
	python3 tests/bytecode_test.py
	python3 tests/admission_test.py
	python3 tests/rational_test.py
	$(CC) -std=c99 -O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic -Iinclude -pthread tests/ipc_stress.c src/ipc.c -o build/ipc_stress
	./build/ipc_stress
bundle:
	python3 tests/bundle_sources.py
clean:
	rm -rf build omega_os.elf
-include $(OBJECTS:.o=.d)

========================================================================
ARQUIVO: link.ld
========================================================================
OUTPUT_FORMAT(elf64-x86-64)
ENTRY(_start)
PHDRS { code PT_LOAD FLAGS(5); data PT_LOAD FLAGS(6); }
SECTIONS {
 . = 0x100000;
 .multiboot : { KEEP(*(.multiboot)) } :code
 . = ALIGN(4096);
 __text_start = .;
 .text : { *(.text.boot) *(.text .text.*) } :code
 . = ALIGN(4096);
 __text_end = .;
 .rodata : { *(.rodata .rodata.*) } :code
 . = ALIGN(4096);
 __rodata_end = .;
 .data : { *(.data .data.*) } :data
 . = ALIGN(4096);
 __bss_start = .;
 .bss (NOLOAD) : {
  *(.bss.boot)
  . = ALIGN(4096); *(.bss.idt)
  . = ALIGN(4096); *(.bss.dma)
  *(.bss .bss.*) *(COMMON)
 } :data
 . = ALIGN(4096);
 __kernel_end = .;
 /DISCARD/ : { *(.eh_frame*) *(.comment) *(.note*) }
}
ASSERT(SIZEOF(.multiboot) == 12, "Multiboot header missing")
ASSERT(__kernel_end < 0x4000000, "Kernel exceeds 64 MiB")

#ifndef OMEGA_CONSENSUS_H
#define OMEGA_CONSENSUS_H
#include "types.h"
#define CONSENSUS_NODES 3U
#define LINEAGE_VA 0x40006000ULL
/* Signed majority with a fixed, honest leader. This is NOT general BFT:
 * n=3,q=2 cannot tolerate one equivocating Byzantine identity. */
typedef struct {uint32_t id,ip;uint16_t port;uint8_t reserved[6],xkey[32],edkey[32];} cluster_member_t;
typedef struct {bool enabled;unsigned self;uint64_t burst_ticks;uint8_t id[32],xsecret[32],edsecret[64];cluster_member_t member[3];} cluster_config_t;
extern cluster_config_t cluster_config;
typedef struct {uint64_t magic,epoch;uint8_t previous[32],hash[32];uint64_t voters;uint8_t signatures[3][64],payload[2816],padding[1000];} lineage_record_t;
typedef char lineage_page_size[(sizeof(lineage_record_t)==4096)?1:-1];
void consensus_provision(uint8_t *module,size_t n);
bool consensus_gate(uint64_t va,const void *data);
bool consensus_certificate(const lineage_record_t *r);
void consensus_run(void);
#endif

ARQUIVO: include/cortex.h

#ifndef OMEGA_CORTEX_H
#define OMEGA_CORTEX_H
#include "types.h"
#include "rational.h"
#define CORTEX_META 0x1000ULL
#define CORTEX_CHECKPOINT 0x1001ULL
#define CORTEX_MODEL 0x2000ULL
#define CORTEX_KV 0x800000ULL
#define CORTEX_CACHE_VA 0xa0000000ULL
#define CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES 64U
#define CORTEX_MAGIC 0x315854524f434d4fULL
#define CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET 2320U
typedef struct {
    uint64_t magic, generation, position, token, model_bytes, kv_pages, logical_bytes;
    uint32_t dim, hidden, layers, heads, kv_heads, vocab, context, flags;
    uint8_t model_hash[32], kv_hash[32], logit_hash[32], jit_hash[32];
    uint64_t accepted, rejected;
    uint8_t reserved[24];
} cortex_checkpoint_t;
typedef char cortex_checkpoint_size[(sizeof(cortex_checkpoint_t) == 256) ? 1 : -1];
typedef struct {
    uint64_t resident, peak, reads, writes, hits, evictions, logical_pages;
} cortex_pager_stats_t;
void cortex_pager_begin(uint64_t root);
uint64_t cortex_pager_map(uint64_t id, bool write);
bool cortex_pager_release(uint64_t va);
bool cortex_pager_commit(const cortex_checkpoint_t *checkpoint);
void cortex_pager_output(const void *data);
void cortex_pager_end(void);
const cortex_pager_stats_t *cortex_pager_stats(void);
bool cortex_checkpoint_valid(const cortex_checkpoint_t *c);
/* Public numerical interfaces; memory B is row-major N x K. */
bool cortex_gemm_i8(const signed char *a, const signed char *b, int64_t *c, uint32_t m, uint32_t n,
                    uint32_t k, bool vector);
typedef struct {
    uint32_t token, reserved;
    omega_rational_t value;
} cortex_contract_t;
unsigned cortex_symbolic_prune(float *logits, unsigned vocabulary,
                               const cortex_contract_t *contracts, unsigned count);
float cortex_fp16(uint16_t value);
float cortex_dequant_value(unsigned type, const uint8_t *block, unsigned index);
#endif

#ifndef ED25519_H
#define ED25519_H

#include "monocypher.h"

#ifdef MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE
namespace MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE {
#elif defined(__cplusplus)
extern "C" {
#endif

////////////////////////
/// Type definitions ///
////////////////////////

// Do not rely on the size or content on any of those types,
// they may change without notice.
typedef struct {
	uint64_t hash[8];
	uint64_t input[16];
	uint64_t input_size[2];
	size_t   input_idx;
} crypto_sha512_ctx;

typedef struct {
	uint8_t key[128];
	crypto_sha512_ctx ctx;
} crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx;


// SHA 512
// -------
void crypto_sha512_init  (crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx);
void crypto_sha512_update(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx,
                          const uint8_t *message, size_t  message_size);
void crypto_sha512_final (crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx, uint8_t hash[64]);
void crypto_sha512(uint8_t hash[64],
                   const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

// SHA 512 HMAC
// ------------
void crypto_sha512_hmac_init(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx,
                             const uint8_t *key, size_t key_size);
void crypto_sha512_hmac_update(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx,
                               const uint8_t *message, size_t  message_size);
void crypto_sha512_hmac_final(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx, uint8_t hmac[64]);
void crypto_sha512_hmac(uint8_t hmac[64],
                        const uint8_t *key    , size_t key_size,
                        const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

// SHA 512 HKDF
// ------------
void crypto_sha512_hkdf_expand(uint8_t       *okm,  size_t okm_size,
                               const uint8_t *prk,  size_t prk_size,
                               const uint8_t *info, size_t info_size);
void crypto_sha512_hkdf(uint8_t       *okm , size_t okm_size,
                        const uint8_t *ikm , size_t ikm_size,
                        const uint8_t *salt, size_t salt_size,
                        const uint8_t *info, size_t info_size);

// Ed25519
// -------
// Signatures (EdDSA with curve25519 + SHA-512)
// --------------------------------------------
void crypto_ed25519_key_pair(uint8_t secret_key[64],
                             uint8_t public_key[32],
                             uint8_t seed[32]);
void crypto_ed25519_sign(uint8_t        signature [64],
                         const uint8_t  secret_key[64],
                         const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);
int crypto_ed25519_check(const uint8_t  signature [64],
                         const uint8_t  public_key[32],
                         const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

// Pre-hash variants
void crypto_ed25519_ph_sign(uint8_t       signature   [64],
                            const uint8_t secret_key  [64],
                            const uint8_t message_hash[64]);
int crypto_ed25519_ph_check(const uint8_t signature   [64],
                            const uint8_t public_key  [32],
                            const uint8_t message_hash[64]);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif // ED25519_H

#ifndef MONOCYPHER_H
#define MONOCYPHER_H

#include "types_bridge.h"

#ifdef MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE
namespace MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE {
#elif defined(__cplusplus)
extern "C" {
#endif

// Constant time comparisons
// -------------------------

// Return 0 if a and b are equal, -1 otherwise
int crypto_verify16(const uint8_t a[16], const uint8_t b[16]);
int crypto_verify32(const uint8_t a[32], const uint8_t b[32]);
int crypto_verify64(const uint8_t a[64], const uint8_t b[64]);


// Erase sensitive data
// --------------------
void crypto_wipe(void *secret, size_t size);


// Authenticated encryption
// ------------------------
void crypto_aead_lock(uint8_t       *cipher_text,
                      uint8_t        mac  [16],
                      const uint8_t  key  [32],
                      const uint8_t  nonce[24],
                      const uint8_t *ad,         size_t ad_size,
                      const uint8_t *plain_text, size_t text_size);
int crypto_aead_unlock(uint8_t       *plain_text,
                       const uint8_t  mac  [16],
                       const uint8_t  key  [32],
                       const uint8_t  nonce[24],
                       const uint8_t *ad,          size_t ad_size,
                       const uint8_t *cipher_text, size_t text_size);

// Authenticated stream
// --------------------
typedef struct {
	uint64_t counter;
	uint8_t  key[32];
	uint8_t  nonce[8];
} crypto_aead_ctx;

void crypto_aead_init_x(crypto_aead_ctx *ctx,
                        const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t nonce[24]);
void crypto_aead_init_djb(crypto_aead_ctx *ctx,
                          const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t nonce[8]);
void crypto_aead_init_ietf(crypto_aead_ctx *ctx,
                           const uint8_t key[32], const uint8_t nonce[12]);

void crypto_aead_write(crypto_aead_ctx *ctx,
                       uint8_t         *cipher_text,
                       uint8_t          mac[16],
                       const uint8_t   *ad        , size_t ad_size,
                       const uint8_t   *plain_text, size_t text_size);
int crypto_aead_read(crypto_aead_ctx *ctx,
                     uint8_t         *plain_text,
                     const uint8_t    mac[16],
                     const uint8_t   *ad        , size_t ad_size,
                     const uint8_t   *cipher_text, size_t text_size);


// General purpose hash (BLAKE2b)
// ------------------------------

// Direct interface
void crypto_blake2b(uint8_t *hash,          size_t hash_size,
                    const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

void crypto_blake2b_keyed(uint8_t *hash,          size_t hash_size,
                          const uint8_t *key,     size_t key_size,
                          const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

// Incremental interface
typedef struct {
	// Do not rely on the size or contents of this type,
	// for they may change without notice.
	uint64_t hash[8];
	uint64_t input_offset[2];
	uint64_t input[16];
	size_t   input_idx;
	size_t   hash_size;
} crypto_blake2b_ctx;

void crypto_blake2b_init(crypto_blake2b_ctx *ctx, size_t hash_size);
void crypto_blake2b_keyed_init(crypto_blake2b_ctx *ctx, size_t hash_size,
                               const uint8_t *key, size_t key_size);
void crypto_blake2b_update(crypto_blake2b_ctx *ctx,
                           const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);
void crypto_blake2b_final(crypto_blake2b_ctx *ctx, uint8_t *hash);


// Password key derivation (Argon2)
// --------------------------------
#define CRYPTO_ARGON2_D  0
#define CRYPTO_ARGON2_I  1
#define CRYPTO_ARGON2_ID 2

typedef struct {
	uint32_t algorithm;  // Argon2d, Argon2i, Argon2id
	uint32_t nb_blocks;  // memory hardness, >= 8 * nb_lanes
	uint32_t nb_passes;  // CPU hardness, >= 1 (>= 3 recommended for Argon2i)
	uint32_t nb_lanes;   // parallelism level (single threaded anyway)
} crypto_argon2_config;

typedef struct {
	const uint8_t *pass;
	const uint8_t *salt;
	uint32_t pass_size;
	uint32_t salt_size;  // 16 bytes recommended
} crypto_argon2_inputs;

typedef struct {
	const uint8_t *key; // may be NULL if no key
	const uint8_t *ad;  // may be NULL if no additional data
	uint32_t key_size;  // 0 if no key (32 bytes recommended otherwise)
	uint32_t ad_size;   // 0 if no additional data
} crypto_argon2_extras;

extern const crypto_argon2_extras crypto_argon2_no_extras;

void crypto_argon2(uint8_t *hash, uint32_t hash_size, void *work_area,
                   crypto_argon2_config config,
                   crypto_argon2_inputs inputs,
                   crypto_argon2_extras extras);


// Key exchange (X-25519)
// ----------------------

// Shared secrets are not quite random.
// Hash them to derive an actual shared key.
void crypto_x25519_public_key(uint8_t       public_key[32],
                              const uint8_t secret_key[32]);
void crypto_x25519(uint8_t       raw_shared_secret[32],
                   const uint8_t your_secret_key  [32],
                   const uint8_t their_public_key [32]);

// Conversion to EdDSA
void crypto_x25519_to_eddsa(uint8_t eddsa[32], const uint8_t x25519[32]);

// scalar "division"
// Used for OPRF.  Be aware that exponential blinding is less secure
// than Diffie-Hellman key exchange.
void crypto_x25519_inverse(uint8_t       blind_salt [32],
                           const uint8_t private_key[32],
                           const uint8_t curve_point[32]);

// "Dirty" versions of x25519_public_key().
// Use with crypto_elligator_rev().
// Leaks 3 bits of the private key.
void crypto_x25519_dirty_small(uint8_t pk[32], const uint8_t sk[32]);
void crypto_x25519_dirty_fast (uint8_t pk[32], const uint8_t sk[32]);


// Signatures
// ----------

// EdDSA with curve25519 + BLAKE2b
void crypto_eddsa_key_pair(uint8_t secret_key[64],
                           uint8_t public_key[32],
                           uint8_t seed[32]);
void crypto_eddsa_sign(uint8_t        signature [64],
                       const uint8_t  secret_key[64],
                       const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);
int crypto_eddsa_check(const uint8_t  signature [64],
                       const uint8_t  public_key[32],
                       const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);

// Conversion to X25519
void crypto_eddsa_to_x25519(uint8_t x25519[32], const uint8_t eddsa[32]);

// EdDSA building blocks
void crypto_eddsa_trim_scalar(uint8_t out[32], const uint8_t in[32]);
void crypto_eddsa_reduce(uint8_t reduced[32], const uint8_t expanded[64]);
void crypto_eddsa_mul_add(uint8_t r[32],
                          const uint8_t a[32],
                          const uint8_t b[32],
                          const uint8_t c[32]);
void crypto_eddsa_scalarbase(uint8_t point[32], const uint8_t scalar[32]);
int crypto_eddsa_check_equation(const uint8_t signature[64],
                                const uint8_t public_key[32],
                                const uint8_t h_ram[32]);


// Chacha20
// --------

// Specialised hash.
// Used to hash X25519 shared secrets.
void crypto_chacha20_h(uint8_t       out[32],
                       const uint8_t key[32],
                       const uint8_t in [16]);

// Unauthenticated stream cipher.
// Don't forget to add authentication.
uint64_t crypto_chacha20_djb(uint8_t       *cipher_text,
                             const uint8_t *plain_text,
                             size_t         text_size,
                             const uint8_t  key[32],
                             const uint8_t  nonce[8],
                             uint64_t       ctr);
uint32_t crypto_chacha20_ietf(uint8_t       *cipher_text,
                              const uint8_t *plain_text,
                              size_t         text_size,
                              const uint8_t  key[32],
                              const uint8_t  nonce[12],
                              uint32_t       ctr);
uint64_t crypto_chacha20_x(uint8_t       *cipher_text,
                           const uint8_t *plain_text,
                           size_t         text_size,
                           const uint8_t  key[32],
                           const uint8_t  nonce[24],
                           uint64_t       ctr);


// Poly 1305
// ---------

// This is a *one time* authenticator.
// Disclosing the mac reveals the key.
// See crypto_lock() on how to use it properly.

// Direct interface
void crypto_poly1305(uint8_t        mac[16],
                     const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size,
                     const uint8_t  key[32]);

// Incremental interface
typedef struct {
	// Do not rely on the size or contents of this type,
	// for they may change without notice.
	uint8_t  c[16];  // chunk of the message
	size_t   c_idx;  // How many bytes are there in the chunk.
	uint32_t r  [4]; // constant multiplier (from the secret key)
	uint32_t pad[4]; // random number added at the end (from the secret key)
	uint32_t h  [5]; // accumulated hash
} crypto_poly1305_ctx;

void crypto_poly1305_init  (crypto_poly1305_ctx *ctx, const uint8_t key[32]);
void crypto_poly1305_update(crypto_poly1305_ctx *ctx,
                            const uint8_t *message, size_t message_size);
void crypto_poly1305_final (crypto_poly1305_ctx *ctx, uint8_t mac[16]);


// Elligator 2
// -----------

// Elligator mappings proper
void crypto_elligator_map(uint8_t curve [32], const uint8_t hidden[32]);
int  crypto_elligator_rev(uint8_t hidden[32], const uint8_t curve [32],
                          uint8_t tweak);

// Easy to use key pair generation
void crypto_elligator_key_pair(uint8_t hidden[32], uint8_t secret_key[32],
                               uint8_t seed[32]);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif // MONOCYPHER_H

#ifndef OMEGA_TYPES_H
#define OMEGA_TYPES_H
typedef unsigned char uint8_t;
typedef unsigned short uint16_t;
typedef unsigned int uint32_t;
typedef unsigned long long uint64_t;
typedef signed long long int64_t;
typedef __SIZE_TYPE__ size_t;
typedef _Bool bool;
#define true 1
#define false 0
#define ALIGN_64 __attribute__((aligned(64)))
#define ALIGN_4K __attribute__((aligned(4096)))
static inline void outb(uint16_t p, uint8_t v) { __asm__ volatile("outb %0,%1"::"a"(v),"Nd"(p)); }
static inline uint8_t inb(uint16_t p) { uint8_t v; __asm__ volatile("inb %1,%0":"=a"(v):"Nd"(p)); return v; }
static inline void compiler_barrier(void) { __asm__ volatile("":::"memory"); }
static inline void outw(uint16_t p,uint16_t v) { __asm__ volatile("outw %0,%1"::"a"(v),"Nd"(p)); }
static inline void outl(uint16_t p,uint32_t v) { __asm__ volatile("outl %0,%1"::"a"(v),"Nd"(p)); }
static inline uint16_t inw(uint16_t p) { uint16_t v; __asm__ volatile("inw %1,%0":"=a"(v):"Nd"(p)); return v; }
static inline uint32_t inl(uint16_t p) { uint32_t v; __asm__ volatile("inl %1,%0":"=a"(v):"Nd"(p)); return v; }
static inline void cpu_pause(void) { __asm__ volatile("pause":::"memory"); }
static inline void mfence(void) { __asm__ volatile("mfence":::"memory"); }
static inline void lfence(void) { __asm__ volatile("lfence":::"memory"); }
static inline void sfence(void) { __asm__ volatile("sfence":::"memory"); }
static inline void invlpg(uint64_t v) { __asm__ volatile("invlpg (%0)"::"r"(v):"memory"); }
static inline uint64_t rdtsc(void) { uint32_t l,h; lfence(); __asm__ volatile("rdtsc":"=a"(l),"=d"(h)); return ((uint64_t)h<<32)|l; }
void *memset(void *p, int c, size_t n);
void *memcpy(void *d, const void *s, size_t n);
void panic(const char *reason) __attribute__((noreturn));
#endif

========================================================================
ARQUIVO: src/admission.c
========================================================================
#include "admission.h"
#include "crypto/monocypher-ed25519.h"
#include "uart.h"
#include "capsule.h"
const uint8_t *admission_code(size_t *length) {
 const uint8_t *m=capsule_message; uint32_t n,v; uint8_t bad[64],wrong_key[32];
 static const uint8_t domain[16]="OMEGA-CAPSULE-2";
 if(sizeof(capsule_message)<24) panic("short capsule");
 for(unsigned i=0;i<16;i++) if(m[i]!=domain[i]) panic("capsule domain");
 memcpy(&n,m+16,4); memcpy(&v,m+20,4);
 if(!n||n>4096||v>256||24ULL+n+v!=sizeof(capsule_message)) panic("capsule lengths");
 if(crypto_ed25519_check(capsule_signature,authority_public,m,sizeof(capsule_message))) panic("Ed25519 authority rejected");
 memcpy(wrong_key,authority_public,32); wrong_key[0]^=1;
 if(!crypto_ed25519_check(capsule_signature,wrong_key,m,sizeof(capsule_message))) panic("wrong authority accepted");
 memcpy(bad,capsule_signature,64); bad[0]^=1;
 if(!crypto_ed25519_check(bad,authority_public,m,sizeof(capsule_message))) panic("tampered signature accepted");
 if(!vm_verify(m+24+n,v)||vm_verify((const uint8_t *)"\x02\x00",2)) panic("VM proof admission");
 uart_puts("TEST Ed25519 external signature + tamper rejection + typed stack VM PASS\n");
 *length=n; return m+24;
}

const uint8_t *admission_compiler(size_t *length) {

#include "bytecode.h"
bool bytecode_run(const void *capsule,size_t size,omega_rational_t *out) {
 const uint8_t *p=capsule; uint64_t magic,n; omega_rational_t stack[32]; unsigned sp=0,gas=0; size_t pc=16;
 if(size<17||size>4096) return false;
 memcpy(&magic,p,8);memcpy(&n,p+8,8);if(magic!=BYTECODE_MAGIC||n!=size-16) return false;
 while(pc<size&&++gas<=256){uint8_t op=p[pc++];omega_rational_t a,b,q;
  if(op==0){if(pc!=size||sp!=1)return false;*out=stack[0];return true;}
  if(op==1){if(size-pc<16||sp==32)return false;memcpy(&q,p+pc,16);pc+=16;if(!rational_valid(q))return false;stack[sp++]=q;continue;}
  if(op==6){omega_rational_t zero={0,1};if(!sp||!rational_sub(zero,stack[sp-1],&q))return false;stack[sp-1]=q;continue;}
  if(sp<2)return false;
  b=stack[--sp];a=stack[sp-1];
  if(op==2){if(!rational_add(a,b,&q))return false;}
  else if(op==3){if(!rational_sub(a,b,&q))return false;}
  else if(op==4){if(!rational_mul(a,b,&q))return false;}
  else if(op==5){omega_rational_t inv;if(!rational_make(b.den,b.num,&inv)||!rational_mul(a,inv,&q))return false;}
  else return false;
  stack[sp-1]=q;
 }
 return false;
}

static bool content(const lineage_record_t *r){

static void entropy(uint8_t out[48]){uint32_t a,b,c,d;__asm__ volatile("cpuid":"=a"(a),"=b"(b),"=c"(c),"=d"(d):"a"(1),"c"(0));if(!(c&(1U<<30)))panic("cluster requires RDRAND");for(unsigned i=0;i<6;i++){uint64_t v;uint8_t ok=0;for(unsigned n=0;n<64&&!ok;n++)__asm__ volatile("rdrand %0;setc %1":"=r"(v),"=qm"(ok));if(!ok)panic("cluster entropy failure");memcpy(out+8*i,&v,8);}}
static void map(uint64_t va){uint64_t p=pmm_alloc_frame();if(!p||!mmu_map(boot_pml4,va,p,PAGE_WRITE))panic("cluster SLS frame");(void)sls_register(va);}
static void flush(void){if(!mmu_sls_commit(boot_pml4))panic("cluster durable transaction");}
static bool eligible(const lineage_record_t *r){return r->epoch==published->epoch+1&&(!published->epoch?!compare(r->previous,(uint8_t[32]){0},32):!crypto_verify32(r->previous,published->hash));}
static bool lock_vote(lineage_record_t *r){
 if(!content(r)||!signature(r,0)||!eligible(r))return false;
 cortex_checkpoint_t c;memcpy(&c,r->payload+CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET,sizeof c);if(!runtime_cortex_ensure(&c))return false;

}
static void publish(const lineage_record_t *r){
 if(!consensus_certificate(r)||r->epoch<=published->epoch)return;
 /* A quorum certificate authenticates a complete application checkpoint.
  * A lagging node may install it without replaying missing local LBAs. */
 if(r->epoch==published->epoch+1&&!eligible(r))return;
 cortex_checkpoint_t c;memcpy(&c,r->payload+CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET,sizeof c);if(!runtime_cortex_ensure(&c))return;
 authorized_epoch=r->epoch;memcpy(authorized_hash,r->hash,32);
 memcpy(published,r,4096);flush();
 uart_puts("QUORUM durable lineage epoch=");uart_put_dec(r->epoch);uart_puts(" voters=");uart_put_hex(r->voters);uart_puts("\n");announced=true;
}

static void fragment(unsigned id,const lineage_record_t *r,uint8_t type){unsigned chunk=transmit_chunk[id]%4;memset(app,0,16);app[0]=type;app[1]=(uint8_t)cluster_config.self;memcpy(app+8,&r->epoch,8);app[2]=(uint8_t)chunk;memcpy(app+16,(const uint8_t *)r+chunk*1024,1024);if(send(id,app,1040))transmit_chunk[id]++;}
static void receive(unsigned id,const uint8_t *p,size_t n){
 if(n<16||p[1]!=id)return;
 if(p[0]==2&&cluster_config.self==0&&n==120){uint64_t epoch;memcpy(&epoch,p+8,8);if(epoch!=pending.epoch||crypto_verify32(p+16,pending.hash))return;
  lineage_record_t vote=pending;memcpy(vote.signatures[id],p+48,64);if(!signature(&vote,id))return;
  memcpy(pending.signatures[id],p+48,64);pending.voters|=1ULL<<id;
  if(consensus_certificate(&pending)){publish(&pending);}
  return;
 }

}
static void propose(void){
 const void *nomination=runtime_nomination();if(!nomination||published->epoch==~0ULL)panic("cluster nomination/epoch exhausted");
 if(proposal_checkpoint->epoch>published->epoch){
  if(!content(proposal_checkpoint)||!signature(proposal_checkpoint,0)||!eligible(proposal_checkpoint))panic("recovered proposal integrity");
  memcpy(&pending,proposal_checkpoint,4096);if(!lock_vote(&pending))panic("recovered proposal lock");uart_puts("QUORUM recovered durable uncommitted proposal\n");return;
 }
 memset(&pending,0,sizeof pending);pending.magic=LINEAGE_MAGIC;pending.epoch=published->epoch+1;if(published->epoch)memcpy(pending.previous,published->hash,32);
 memcpy(pending.payload,nomination,2816);
 cortex_checkpoint_t next_cortex;memcpy(&next_cortex,pending.payload+CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET,sizeof next_cortex);
 /* A quarantined/unavailable cortex must not erase its last approved state. */
 if(!next_cortex.magic&&published->epoch)memcpy(pending.payload+CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET,published->payload+CORTEX_MANIFEST_OFFSET,sizeof next_cortex);
 crypto_blake2b(pending.hash,32,pending.payload,sizeof pending.payload);pending.voters=1;uint8_t text[120];statement(text,&pending);crypto_ed25519_sign(pending.signatures[0],cluster_config.edsecret,text,sizeof text);
 memcpy(proposal_checkpoint,&pending,4096);flush();
 if(!lock_vote(&pending))panic("leader durable vote lock");
}
void consensus_run(void){
 uint8_t random[48];uint64_t last_hello[3]={0,0,0},last_data[3]={0,0,0};
 if(!cluster_config.enabled)return;
 if(!net_init())panic("cluster VirtIO-Net missing");
 map((uint64_t)durable);map(LINEAGE_VA);if(cluster_config.self==0)map((uint64_t)proposal_checkpoint);ready=true;
 if(durable[0]&&durable[0]!=STATE_MAGIC)panic("cluster vote metadata format");
 if(durable[0]){if(crypto_verify32((uint8_t *)durable+64,cluster_config.id))panic("cluster pins changed");}
 else{durable[0]=STATE_MAGIC;memcpy((uint8_t *)durable+64,cluster_config.id,32);}
 if(published->epoch&&!consensus_certificate(published))panic("recovered lineage certificate");
 authorized_epoch=published->epoch;memcpy(authorized_hash,published->hash,32);
 if(durable[1]==~0ULL)panic("cluster boot counter exhausted");
 durable[1]++;flush();
 for(unsigned i=0;i<3;i++)if(i!=cluster_config.self){uint8_t *floor=(uint8_t *)durable+128+64*i;uint64_t boot;memcpy(&boot,floor,8);entropy(random);
  if(!tunnel_init(&channels[i],cluster_config.xsecret,cluster_config.member[i].xkey,random,durable[1],boot,floor+8,net_config.local_ip,cluster_config.member[i].ip))panic("cluster tunnel DH");
  tunnel_hello(&channels[i],hello[i]);}
 crypto_wipe(random,48);crypto_wipe(cluster_config.xsecret,32);
 if(cluster_config.self==0&&!published->epoch)propose();
 uart_puts("QUORUM service ready; fixed leader 1, signed majority 2/3; no general BFT\n");
 if(published->epoch){uart_puts("QUORUM recovered certified lineage epoch=");uart_put_dec(published->epoch);uart_puts("\n");}
 uint64_t start=rdtsc(),last_burst=rdtsc(),last_resumed_epoch=0;bool isolated=false;
 for(;;){
  for(unsigned i=0;i<3;i++)if(i!=cluster_config.self){udp_select(cluster_config.member[i].ip,cluster_config.member[i].port);
   if(rdtsc()-last_hello[i]>30000000ULL){(void)udp_send(hello[i],104);last_hello[i]=rdtsc();}
   if(cluster_config.self==0&&channels[i].established&&rdtsc()-last_data[i]>2000000ULL){if(pending.epoch>published->epoch&&(!published->epoch||((transmit_chunk[i]/4)&1)==0)){fragment(i,&pending,1);}else{fragment(i,published,3);}last_data[i]=rdtsc();}
  }
  const uint8_t *packet;size_t n;uint32_t ip;uint16_t port;
  if(udp_receive_from(&packet,&n,&ip,&port)){unsigned id;for(id=0;id<3;id++)if(id!=cluster_config.self&&ip==cluster_config.member[id].ip&&port==cluster_config.member[id].port)break;
   if(id<3){bool changed=false;if(n==104&&packet[8]==1){if(tunnel_accept(&channels[id],packet,n,&changed)&&changed){uint8_t *floor=(uint8_t *)durable+128+64*id;memcpy(floor,&channels[id].peer_boot,8);memcpy(floor+8,channels[id].saved_hello,32);flush();}}
    else{size_t length;if(tunnel_open(&channels[id],plain,&length,packet,n))receive(id,plain,length);}}
   udp_release();
  }
  if(!published->epoch&&!isolated&&rdtsc()-start>2000000000ULL){uart_puts("QUORUM isolated: lineage epoch remains 0; local metadata generations independent\n");isolated=true;}
  if(announced){uart_puts("TEST quorum certified lineage persisted; service remains available\n");announced=false;}
  /* Retain the same compiler process/arena across bursts. Network service
   * resumes between bounded bursts; no host compiler or child tool runs. */
  if(published->epoch>last_resumed_epoch&&rdtsc()-last_burst>cluster_config.burst_ticks){last_resumed_epoch=published->epoch;runtime_resume();runtime_cortex();last_burst=rdtsc();if(cluster_config.self==0)propose();}
  cpu_pause();
 }
}

========================================================================
ARQUIVO: src/cortex_pager.c

#include "cortex.h"
#include "mmu.h"
#include "uart.h"
#define ADDRESS(id) (0x40000000ULL + (id) * 4096)
typedef struct {
    uint64_t id, physical, age;
    unsigned pins;
    bool used, writable;
} block_t;
static block_t blocks[CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES];
static cortex_pager_stats_t stats;
static uint64_t root, clock_age;
static uint8_t checkpoint_page[4096] ALIGN_4K, output_page[4096] ALIGN_4K;
static bool output_pending;
void cortex_pager_output(const void *data) {
    memcpy(output_page, data, 4096);
    output_pending = true;
}
static bool dirty(unsigned i) {
    uint64_t *p = mmu_leaf((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * i);
    return p && (*p & PAGE_DIRTY);
}
static bool stage(unsigned i) {
    if (!blocks[i].used || !dirty(i))
        return true;
    if (!blocks[i].writable || !sls_stage_page(ADDRESS(blocks[i].id), (void *)blocks[i].physical))
        return false;
    stats.writes++;
    return true;
}
static void clean(unsigned i) {
    uint64_t *p = mmu_leaf((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * i);
    if (p)
        *p &= ~PAGE_DIRTY;
    invlpg(CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * i);
}
void cortex_pager_begin(uint64_t r) {
    memset(blocks, 0, sizeof blocks);
    memset(&stats, 0, sizeof stats);
    clock_age = 0;
    root = r;
    output_pending = false;
}
uint64_t cortex_pager_map(uint64_t id, bool write) {
    unsigned slot = CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES;
    if (id >= 16777216ULL || id < CORTEX_META ||
        (!write && id < CORTEX_MODEL && id != CORTEX_META && id != CORTEX_CHECKPOINT) ||
        (write && id < CORTEX_KV))
        return ~0ULL;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES; i++)
        if (blocks[i].used && blocks[i].id == id) {
            slot = i;
            stats.hits++;
            break;
        }
    if (slot == CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES) {
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES; i++)
            if (!blocks[i].pins && (!blocks[i].used || slot == CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES ||
                                    blocks[i].age < blocks[slot].age)) {
                slot = i;
                if (!blocks[i].used)
                    break;
            }
        if (slot == CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES)
            return ~0ULL;
        block_t *b = &blocks[slot];
        if (b->used) {
            if (dirty(slot)) {
                sls_begin_pages(1);
                if (!stage(slot) || !sls_commit())
                    panic("cortex eviction I/O");
            }
            stats.evictions++;
        } else if (!b->physical) {
            b->physical = pmm_alloc_frame();
            if (!b->physical)
                return ~0ULL;
            stats.resident++;
            if (stats.resident > stats.peak)
                stats.peak = stats.resident;
        }
        /* Revoke the old capability before reusing its frame. */
        uint64_t *leaf = mmu_leaf((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096);
        if (leaf)
            *leaf = 0;
        invlpg(CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096);
        bool present = sls_read_page(ADDRESS(id), (void *)b->physical);
        stats.reads++;
        if (!present) {
            if (!write) {
                b->used = false;
                return ~0ULL;
            }
            memset((void *)b->physical, 0, 4096);
        }
        b->id = id;
        b->writable = write;
        b->used = true;
        stats.logical_pages++;
    }
    block_t *b = &blocks[slot];
    b->age = ++clock_age;
    b->pins++;
    if (write)
        b->writable = true;
    uint64_t *leaf = mmu_leaf((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096);
    if (leaf && (*leaf & PAGE_PRESENT)) {
        if (b->writable && !(*leaf & PAGE_WRITE)) {
            *leaf |= PAGE_WRITE;
            invlpg(CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096);
        }
    } else if (!mmu_map((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096, b->physical,
                        PAGE_USER | PAGE_NX | (b->writable ? PAGE_WRITE : 0)))
        panic("cortex pager map");
    return CORTEX_CACHE_VA + slot * 4096;
}
bool cortex_pager_release(uint64_t va) {
    if (va < CORTEX_CACHE_VA || va >= CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES || (va & 4095))
        return false;
    unsigned i = (unsigned)((va - CORTEX_CACHE_VA) / 4096);
    if (!blocks[i].pins)
        return false;
    blocks[i].pins--;
    return true;
}
bool cortex_checkpoint_valid(const cortex_checkpoint_t *c) {
    if (c->magic != CORTEX_MAGIC || !c->generation || !c->dim || c->dim > 8192 || !c->hidden ||
        c->hidden > 32768 || !c->layers || c->layers > 128 || !c->heads || c->heads > 128 ||
        !c->kv_heads || c->heads % c->kv_heads || c->dim % c->heads || c->vocab < 2 ||
        c->vocab > 262144 || !c->context || c->context > 1048576 || c->position > c->context ||
        c->token >= c->vocab || c->kv_pages > 0x800000ULL || !c->model_bytes)
        return false;
    uint64_t dim = (uint64_t)c->dim * c->kv_heads / c->heads;
    uint64_t pages = ((c->context * dim * 4 + 4095) / 4096) * c->layers;
    return c->position && c->generation <= c->position && c->accepted == c->position &&
           c->rejected <= (uint64_t)c->vocab * c->position && !(c->flags & ~1U) &&
           c->kv_pages == pages && c->logical_bytes == pages * 4096 &&
           c->model_bytes < (CORTEX_KV - CORTEX_MODEL) * 4096;
}
bool cortex_pager_commit(const cortex_checkpoint_t *c) {
    if (!cortex_checkpoint_valid(c))
        return false;
    sls_begin_pages(CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES + 2);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES; i++)
        if (!stage(i))
            return false;
    memset(checkpoint_page, 0, 4096);
    memcpy(checkpoint_page, c, sizeof *c);
    if (output_pending && !sls_stage_page(ADDRESS(CORTEX_CHECKPOINT + 1), output_page))
        return false;
    if (!sls_stage_page(ADDRESS(CORTEX_CHECKPOINT), checkpoint_page) || !sls_commit())
        return false;
    output_pending = false;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES; i++)
        clean(i);
    uart_puts("CORTEX SLS atomic checkpoint position=");
    uart_put_dec(c->position);
    uart_puts(" resident frames=");
    uart_put_dec(stats.peak);
    uart_puts("\n");
    return true;
}
const cortex_pager_stats_t *cortex_pager_stats(void) { return &stats; }
void cortex_pager_end(void) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < CORTEX_CACHE_FRAMES; i++)
        if (blocks[i].physical) {
            uint64_t *p = mmu_leaf((uint64_t *)root, CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * i);
            if (p)
                *p = 0;
            invlpg(CORTEX_CACHE_VA + 4096 * i);
            if (!pmm_free_frame(blocks[i].physical))
                panic("pager frame release");
        }
    memset(blocks, 0, sizeof blocks);
}

/////////////////
/// Utilities ///
/////////////////
#define FOR(i, min, max)     for (size_t i = min; i < max; i++)
#define COPY(dst, src, size) FOR(_i_, 0, size) (dst)[_i_] = (src)[_i_]
#define ZERO(buf, size)      FOR(_i_, 0, size) (buf)[_i_] = 0
#define WIPE_CTX(ctx)        crypto_wipe(ctx   , sizeof(*(ctx)))
#define WIPE_BUFFER(buffer)  crypto_wipe(buffer, sizeof(buffer))
#define MIN(a, b)            ((a) <= (b) ? (a) : (b))
typedef uint8_t u8;
typedef uint64_t u64;

// Returns the smallest positive integer y such that
// (x + y) % pow_2  == 0
// Basically, it's how many bytes we need to add to "align" x.
// Only works when pow_2 is a power of 2.
// Note: we use ~x+1 instead of -x to avoid compiler warnings
static size_t align(size_t x, size_t pow_2)
{
	return (~x + 1) & (pow_2 - 1);
}

static u64 load64_be(const u8 s[8])
{
	return((u64)s[0] << 56)
		| ((u64)s[1] << 48)
		| ((u64)s[2] << 40)
		| ((u64)s[3] << 32)
		| ((u64)s[4] << 24)
		| ((u64)s[5] << 16)
		| ((u64)s[6] <<  8)
		|  (u64)s[7];
}

static void store64_be(u8 out[8], u64 in)
{
	out[0] = (in >> 56) & 0xff;
	out[1] = (in >> 48) & 0xff;
	out[2] = (in >> 40) & 0xff;
	out[3] = (in >> 32) & 0xff;
	out[4] = (in >> 24) & 0xff;
	out[5] = (in >> 16) & 0xff;
	out[6] = (in >>  8) & 0xff;
	out[7] =  in        & 0xff;
}

static void load64_be_buf (u64 *dst, const u8 *src, size_t size) {
	FOR(i, 0, size) { dst[i] = load64_be(src + i*8); }
}

///////////////
/// SHA 512 ///
///////////////
static u64 rot(u64 x, int c       ) { return (x >> c) | (x << (64 - c));   }
static u64 ch (u64 x, u64 y, u64 z) { return (x & y) ^ (~x & z);           }
static u64 maj(u64 x, u64 y, u64 z) { return (x & y) ^ ( x & z) ^ (y & z); }
static u64 big_sigma0(u64 x) { return rot(x, 28) ^ rot(x, 34) ^ rot(x, 39); }
static u64 big_sigma1(u64 x) { return rot(x, 14) ^ rot(x, 18) ^ rot(x, 41); }
static u64 lit_sigma0(u64 x) { return rot(x,  1) ^ rot(x,  8) ^ (x >> 7);   }
static u64 lit_sigma1(u64 x) { return rot(x, 19) ^ rot(x, 61) ^ (x >> 6);   }

static const u64 K[80] = {
	0x428a2f98d728ae22,0x7137449123ef65cd,0xb5c0fbcfec4d3b2f,0xe9b5dba58189dbbc,
	0x3956c25bf348b538,0x59f111f1b605d019,0x923f82a4af194f9b,0xab1c5ed5da6d8118,
	0xd807aa98a3030242,0x12835b0145706fbe,0x243185be4ee4b28c,0x550c7dc3d5ffb4e2,
	0x72be5d74f27b896f,0x80deb1fe3b1696b1,0x9bdc06a725c71235,0xc19bf174cf692694,
	0xe49b69c19ef14ad2,0xefbe4786384f25e3,0x0fc19dc68b8cd5b5,0x240ca1cc77ac9c65,
	0x2de92c6f592b0275,0x4a7484aa6ea6e483,0x5cb0a9dcbd41fbd4,0x76f988da831153b5,
	0x983e5152ee66dfab,0xa831c66d2db43210,0xb00327c898fb213f,0xbf597fc7beef0ee4,
	0xc6e00bf33da88fc2,0xd5a79147930aa725,0x06ca6351e003826f,0x142929670a0e6e70,
	0x27b70a8546d22ffc,0x2e1b21385c26c926,0x4d2c6dfc5ac42aed,0x53380d139d95b3df,
	0x650a73548baf63de,0x766a0abb3c77b2a8,0x81c2c92e47edaee6,0x92722c851482353b,
	0xa2bfe8a14cf10364,0xa81a664bbc423001,0xc24b8b70d0f89791,0xc76c51a30654be30,
	0xd192e819d6ef5218,0xd69906245565a910,0xf40e35855771202a,0x106aa07032bbd1b8,
	0x19a4c116b8d2d0c8,0x1e376c085141ab53,0x2748774cdf8eeb99,0x34b0bcb5e19b48a8,
	0x391c0cb3c5c95a63,0x4ed8aa4ae3418acb,0x5b9cca4f7763e373,0x682e6ff3d6b2b8a3,
	0x748f82ee5defb2fc,0x78a5636f43172f60,0x84c87814a1f0ab72,0x8cc702081a6439ec,
	0x90befffa23631e28,0xa4506cebde82bde9,0xbef9a3f7b2c67915,0xc67178f2e372532b,
	0xca273eceea26619c,0xd186b8c721c0c207,0xeada7dd6cde0eb1e,0xf57d4f7fee6ed178,
	0x06f067aa72176fba,0x0a637dc5a2c898a6,0x113f9804bef90dae,0x1b710b35131c471b,
	0x28db77f523047d84,0x32caab7b40c72493,0x3c9ebe0a15c9bebc,0x431d67c49c100d4c,
	0x4cc5d4becb3e42b6,0x597f299cfc657e2a,0x5fcb6fab3ad6faec,0x6c44198c4a475817
};

static void sha512_compress(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx)
{
	u64 a = ctx->hash[0];    u64 b = ctx->hash[1];
	u64 c = ctx->hash[2];    u64 d = ctx->hash[3];
	u64 e = ctx->hash[4];    u64 f = ctx->hash[5];
	u64 g = ctx->hash[6];    u64 h = ctx->hash[7];

	FOR (j, 0, 16) {
		u64 in = K[j] + ctx->input[j];
		u64 t1 = big_sigma1(e) + ch (e, f, g) + h + in;
		u64 t2 = big_sigma0(a) + maj(a, b, c);
		h = g;  g = f;  f = e;  e = d  + t1;
		d = c;  c = b;  b = a;  a = t1 + t2;
	}
	size_t i16 = 0;
	FOR(i, 1, 5) {
		i16 += 16;
		FOR (j, 0, 16) {
			ctx->input[j] += lit_sigma1(ctx->input[(j- 2) & 15]);
			ctx->input[j] += lit_sigma0(ctx->input[(j-15) & 15]);
			ctx->input[j] +=            ctx->input[(j- 7) & 15];
			u64 in = K[i16 + j] + ctx->input[j];
			u64 t1 = big_sigma1(e) + ch (e, f, g) + h + in;
			u64 t2 = big_sigma0(a) + maj(a, b, c);
			h = g;  g = f;  f = e;  e = d  + t1;
			d = c;  c = b;  b = a;  a = t1 + t2;
		}
	}

	ctx->hash[0] += a;    ctx->hash[1] += b;
	ctx->hash[2] += c;    ctx->hash[3] += d;
	ctx->hash[4] += e;    ctx->hash[5] += f;
	ctx->hash[6] += g;    ctx->hash[7] += h;
}

// Write 1 input byte
static void sha512_set_input(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx, u8 input)
{
	size_t word = ctx->input_idx >> 3;
	size_t byte = ctx->input_idx &  7;
	ctx->input[word] |= (u64)input << (8 * (7 - byte));
}

// Increment a 128-bit "word".
static void sha512_incr(u64 x[2], u64 y)
{
	x[1] += y;
	if (x[1] < y) {
		x[0]++;
	}
}

void crypto_sha512_init(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx)
{
	ctx->hash[0] = 0x6a09e667f3bcc908;
	ctx->hash[1] = 0xbb67ae8584caa73b;
	ctx->hash[2] = 0x3c6ef372fe94f82b;
	ctx->hash[3] = 0xa54ff53a5f1d36f1;
	ctx->hash[4] = 0x510e527fade682d1;
	ctx->hash[5] = 0x9b05688c2b3e6c1f;
	ctx->hash[6] = 0x1f83d9abfb41bd6b;
	ctx->hash[7] = 0x5be0cd19137e2179;
	ctx->input_size[0] = 0;
	ctx->input_size[1] = 0;
	ctx->input_idx = 0;
	ZERO(ctx->input, 16);
}

void crypto_sha512_update(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx,
                          const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	// Avoid undefined NULL pointer increments with empty messages
	if (message_size == 0) {
		return;
	}

	// Align ourselves with word boundaries
	if ((ctx->input_idx & 7) != 0) {
		size_t nb_bytes = MIN(align(ctx->input_idx, 8), message_size);
		FOR (i, 0, nb_bytes) {
			sha512_set_input(ctx, message[i]);
			ctx->input_idx++;
		}
		message      += nb_bytes;
		message_size -= nb_bytes;
	}

	// Align ourselves with block boundaries
	if ((ctx->input_idx & 127) != 0) {
		size_t nb_words = MIN(align(ctx->input_idx, 128), message_size) >> 3;
		load64_be_buf(ctx->input + (ctx->input_idx >> 3), message, nb_words);
		ctx->input_idx += nb_words << 3;
		message        += nb_words << 3;
		message_size   -= nb_words << 3;
	}

	// Compress block if needed
	if (ctx->input_idx == 128) {
		sha512_incr(ctx->input_size, 1024); // size is in bits
		sha512_compress(ctx);
		ctx->input_idx = 0;
		ZERO(ctx->input, 16);
	}

	// Process the message block by block
	FOR (i, 0, message_size >> 7) { // number of blocks
		load64_be_buf(ctx->input, message, 16);
		sha512_incr(ctx->input_size, 1024); // size is in bits
		sha512_compress(ctx);
		ctx->input_idx = 0;
		ZERO(ctx->input, 16);
		message += 128;
	}
	message_size &= 127;

	if (message_size != 0) {
		// Remaining words
		size_t nb_words = message_size >> 3;
		load64_be_buf(ctx->input, message, nb_words);
		ctx->input_idx += nb_words << 3;
		message        += nb_words << 3;
		message_size   -= nb_words << 3;

		// Remaining bytes
		FOR (i, 0, message_size) {
			sha512_set_input(ctx, message[i]);
			ctx->input_idx++;
		}
	}
}

void crypto_sha512_final(crypto_sha512_ctx *ctx, u8 hash[64])
{
	// Add padding bit
	if (ctx->input_idx == 0) {
		ZERO(ctx->input, 16);
	}
	sha512_set_input(ctx, 128);

	// Update size
	sha512_incr(ctx->input_size, ctx->input_idx * 8);

	// Compress penultimate block (if any)
	if (ctx->input_idx > 111) {
		sha512_compress(ctx);
		ZERO(ctx->input, 14);
	}
	// Compress last block
	ctx->input[14] = ctx->input_size[0];
	ctx->input[15] = ctx->input_size[1];
	sha512_compress(ctx);

	// Copy hash to output (big endian)
	FOR (i, 0, 8) {
		store64_be(hash + i*8, ctx->hash[i]);
	}

	WIPE_CTX(ctx);
}

void crypto_sha512(u8 hash[64], const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	crypto_sha512_ctx ctx;
	crypto_sha512_init  (&ctx);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx, message, message_size);
	crypto_sha512_final (&ctx, hash);
}

////////////////////
/// HMAC SHA 512 ///
////////////////////
void crypto_sha512_hmac_init(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx,
                             const u8 *key, size_t key_size)
{
	// hash key if it is too long
	if (key_size > 128) {
		crypto_sha512(ctx->key, key, key_size);
		key      = ctx->key;
		key_size = 64;
	}
	// Compute inner key: padded key XOR 0x36
	FOR (i, 0, key_size)   { ctx->key[i] = key[i] ^ 0x36; }
	FOR (i, key_size, 128) { ctx->key[i] =          0x36; }
	// Start computing inner hash
	crypto_sha512_init  (&ctx->ctx);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx->ctx, ctx->key, 128);
}

void crypto_sha512_hmac_update(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx,
                               const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx->ctx, message, message_size);
}

void crypto_sha512_hmac_final(crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx *ctx, u8 hmac[64])
{
	// Finish computing inner hash
	crypto_sha512_final(&ctx->ctx, hmac);
	// Compute outer key: padded key XOR 0x5c
	FOR (i, 0, 128) {
		ctx->key[i] ^= 0x36 ^ 0x5c;
	}
	// Compute outer hash
	crypto_sha512_init  (&ctx->ctx);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx->ctx, ctx->key , 128);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx->ctx, hmac, 64);
	crypto_sha512_final (&ctx->ctx, hmac); // outer hash
	WIPE_CTX(ctx);
}

void crypto_sha512_hmac(u8 hmac[64], const u8 *key, size_t key_size,
                        const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx ctx;
	crypto_sha512_hmac_init  (&ctx, key, key_size);
	crypto_sha512_hmac_update(&ctx, message, message_size);
	crypto_sha512_hmac_final (&ctx, hmac);
}

////////////////////
/// HKDF SHA 512 ///
////////////////////
void crypto_sha512_hkdf_expand(u8       *okm,  size_t okm_size,
                               const u8 *prk,  size_t prk_size,
                               const u8 *info, size_t info_size)
{
	int not_first = 0;
	u8 ctr = 1;
	u8 blk[64];

	while (okm_size > 0) {
		size_t out_size = MIN(okm_size, sizeof(blk));

		crypto_sha512_hmac_ctx ctx;
		crypto_sha512_hmac_init(&ctx, prk , prk_size);
		if (not_first) {
			// For some reason HKDF uses some kind of CBC mode.
			// For some reason CTR mode alone wasn't enough.
			// Like what, they didn't trust HMAC in 2010?  Really??
			crypto_sha512_hmac_update(&ctx, blk , sizeof(blk));
		}
		crypto_sha512_hmac_update(&ctx, info, info_size);
		crypto_sha512_hmac_update(&ctx, &ctr, 1);
		crypto_sha512_hmac_final(&ctx, blk);

		COPY(okm, blk, out_size);

		not_first = 1;
		okm      += out_size;
		okm_size -= out_size;
		ctr++;
	}
}

void crypto_sha512_hkdf(u8       *okm , size_t okm_size,
                        const u8 *ikm , size_t ikm_size,
                        const u8 *salt, size_t salt_size,
                        const u8 *info, size_t info_size)
{
	// Extract
	u8 prk[64];
	crypto_sha512_hmac(prk, salt, salt_size, ikm, ikm_size);

	// Expand
	crypto_sha512_hkdf_expand(okm, okm_size, prk, sizeof(prk), info, info_size);
}

///////////////
/// Ed25519 ///
///////////////
void crypto_ed25519_key_pair(u8 secret_key[64], u8 public_key[32], u8 seed[32])
{
	u8 a[64];
	COPY(a, seed, 32);                      // a[ 0..31]  = seed
	crypto_wipe(seed, 32);
	COPY(secret_key, a, 32);                // secret key = seed
	crypto_sha512(a, a, 32);                // a[ 0..31]  = scalar
	crypto_eddsa_trim_scalar(a, a);         // a[ 0..31]  = trimmed scalar
	crypto_eddsa_scalarbase(public_key, a); // public key = [trimmed scalar]B
	COPY(secret_key + 32, public_key, 32);  // secret key includes public half
	WIPE_BUFFER(a);
}

static void hash_reduce(u8 h[32],
                        const u8 *a, size_t a_size,
                        const u8 *b, size_t b_size,
                        const u8 *c, size_t c_size,
                        const u8 *d, size_t d_size)
{
	u8 hash[64];
	crypto_sha512_ctx ctx;
	crypto_sha512_init  (&ctx);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx, a, a_size);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx, b, b_size);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx, c, c_size);
	crypto_sha512_update(&ctx, d, d_size);
	crypto_sha512_final (&ctx, hash);
	crypto_eddsa_reduce(h, hash);
}

static void ed25519_dom_sign(u8 signature [64], const u8 secret_key[32],
                             const u8 *dom,     size_t dom_size,
                             const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	u8 a[64];  // secret scalar and prefix
	u8 r[32];  // secret deterministic "random" nonce
	u8 h[32];  // publically verifiable hash of the message (not wiped)
	u8 R[32];  // first half of the signature (allows overlapping inputs)
	const u8 *pk = secret_key + 32;

	crypto_sha512(a, secret_key, 32);
	crypto_eddsa_trim_scalar(a, a);
	hash_reduce(r, dom, dom_size, a + 32, 32, message, message_size, 0, 0);
	crypto_eddsa_scalarbase(R, r);
	hash_reduce(h, dom, dom_size, R, 32, pk, 32, message, message_size);
	COPY(signature, R, 32);
	crypto_eddsa_mul_add(signature + 32, h, a, r);

	WIPE_BUFFER(a);
	WIPE_BUFFER(r);
}

void crypto_ed25519_sign(u8 signature [64], const u8 secret_key[64],
                         const u8 *message, size_t message_size)
{
	ed25519_dom_sign(signature, secret_key, 0, 0, message, message_size);
}

int crypto_ed25519_check(const u8 signature[64], const u8 public_key[32],
                         const u8 *msg, size_t msg_size)
{
	u8 h_ram[32];
	hash_reduce(h_ram, signature, 32, public_key, 32, msg, msg_size, 0, 0);
	return crypto_eddsa_check_equation(signature, public_key, h_ram);
}

static const u8 domain[34] = "SigEd25519 no Ed25519 collisions\1";

void crypto_ed25519_ph_sign(uint8_t signature[64], const uint8_t secret_key[64],
                            const uint8_t message_hash[64])
{
	ed25519_dom_sign(signature, secret_key, domain, sizeof(domain),
	                 message_hash, 64);
}

int crypto_ed25519_ph_check(const uint8_t sig[64], const uint8_t pk[32],
                            const uint8_t msg_hash[64])
{
	u8 h_ram[32];
	hash_reduce(h_ram, domain, sizeof(domain), sig, 32, pk, 32, msg_hash, 64);
	return crypto_eddsa_check_equation(sig, pk, h_ram);
}


#ifdef MONOCYPHER_CPP_NAMESPACE
}
#endif
