 crypto_aead_init_ietf(&aead,t->tx,nonce);crypto_aead_write(&aead,out+40,out+40+n,out,40,plain,n);crypto_wipe(&aead,sizeof aead);return n+56;
}
bool tunnel_open(tunnel_t *t,uint8_t *plain,size_t *n,const uint8_t *p,size_t size){
 uint64_t seq,delta;uint16_t length;uint8_t nonce[12]={0};crypto_aead_ctx aead;
 if(!t->established||size<56||!eqmagic(p)||p[8]!=2||p[9]!=3||crypto_verify16(p+24,t->session))return false;
 memcpy(&seq,p+16,8);memcpy(&length,p+10,2);if(!seq||length>1100||size!=56U+length)return false;
 if(seq<=t->highest){delta=t->highest-seq;if(delta>=64||(t->window&(1ULL<<delta))){t->replay_drops++;return false;}}
 memcpy(nonce+4,&seq,8);crypto_aead_init_ietf(&aead,t->rx,nonce);
 if(crypto_aead_read(&aead,plain,p+40+length,p,40,p+40,length)){crypto_wipe(&aead,sizeof aead);t->auth_drops++;return false;}
 crypto_wipe(&aead,sizeof aead);
 if(seq>t->highest){delta=seq-t->highest;t->window=delta>=64?1:(t->window<<delta)|1;t->highest=seq;}else t->window|=1ULL<<(t->highest-seq);
 *n=length;return true;
}

}

#include "udp.h"

static uint16_t be16(const uint8_t *p){return (uint16_t)((unsigned)p[0]*256+p[1]);}
static uint32_t be32(const uint8_t *p){return (uint32_t)p[0]<<24|(uint32_t)p[1]<<16|(uint32_t)p[2]<<8|p[3];}
static void put16(uint8_t *p,uint16_t v){p[0]=(uint8_t)(v>>8);p[1]=(uint8_t)v;}
static void put32(uint8_t *p,uint32_t v){p[0]=(uint8_t)(v>>24);p[1]=(uint8_t)(v>>16);p[2]=(uint8_t)(v>>8);p[3]=(uint8_t)v;}
static uint32_t sum(const uint8_t *p,size_t n,uint32_t value){while(n>1){value+=be16(p);p+=2;n-=2;}if(n)value+=(uint32_t)*p<<8;return value;}
static uint16_t finish(uint32_t value){while(value>>16)value=(value&65535)+(value>>16);return (uint16_t)~value;}
static uint32_t next_hop(void){return (net_config.local_ip&net_config.mask)==(net_config.peer_ip&net_config.mask)?net_config.peer_ip:net_config.gateway;}
void net_boot_config(uint32_t info){
 const uint32_t *mb=(const uint32_t *)(uint64_t)info;uint32_t start,end;uint8_t digest[32];static const uint8_t magic[8]="OMNETV3";
 if(!(mb[0]&8)||mb[5]!=1)return;
 if(mb[6]>PHYS_LIMIT-16)panic("network module descriptor");
 const uint32_t *module=(const uint32_t *)(uint64_t)mb[6];start=module[0];end=module[1];
 if(start>=end||end>PHYS_LIMIT||(end-start!=128&&end-start!=400))panic("network module bounds");
 uint8_t *p=(uint8_t *)(uint64_t)start;
 if(end-start==400){consensus_provision(p,400);return;}
 for(unsigned i=0;i<8;i++)if(p[i]!=magic[i])panic("network config domain");
 crypto_blake2b(digest,32,p,96);if(crypto_verify32(digest,p+96))panic("network config checksum");
 memcpy(&net_config.local_ip,p+12,4);memcpy(&net_config.peer_ip,p+16,4);memcpy(&net_config.gateway,p+20,4);memcpy(&net_config.mask,p+24,4);
 memcpy(&net_config.local_port,p+28,2);memcpy(&net_config.peer_port,p+30,2);memcpy(net_config.secret,p+32,32);memcpy(net_config.peer_key,p+64,32);
 crypto_wipe(p+32,32);
 if(!net_config.local_ip||!net_config.peer_ip||!net_config.local_port||!net_config.peer_port)panic("network static configuration");
 net_config.configured=true;
}
static bool arp(uint16_t op,const uint8_t *destination,uint32_t target){
 uint8_t *p=net_tx_buffer();uint64_t mac=net_mac();memset(p,0,60);memcpy(p,destination,6);memcpy(p+6,&mac,6);put16(p+12,0x806);
 put16(p+14,1);put16(p+16,0x800);p[18]=6;p[19]=4;put16(p+20,op);memcpy(p+22,&mac,6);put32(p+28,net_config.local_ip);
 if(op==2)memcpy(p+32,destination,6);
 put32(p+38,target);return net_send(60);
}
void udp_select(uint32_t ip,uint16_t port){uint32_t hop=next_hop();net_config.peer_ip=ip;net_config.peer_port=port;if(next_hop()!=hop){resolved=false;last_arp=0;}}
uint8_t *udp_tx_payload(void){return net_tx_buffer()+42;}
bool udp_send(const uint8_t *body,size_t n){
 uint8_t *p=net_tx_buffer();uint64_t mac=net_mac();uint16_t length=(uint16_t)(n+8),check;
 if(n>1400)return false;
 if(!resolved){if(rdtsc()-last_arp>1000000){uint8_t broadcast[6]={255,255,255,255,255,255};if(!arp(1,broadcast,next_hop()))panic("ARP transmit");last_arp=rdtsc();}return false;}

 put16(p+34,net_config.local_port);put16(p+36,net_config.peer_port);put16(p+38,length);if(body!=p+42)memcpy(p+42,body,n);
 check=finish(sum(p+26,8,sum(p+34,length,17+length)));put16(p+40,check?check:65535);return net_send(42+n);
}
bool udp_receive_from(const uint8_t **body,size_t *n,uint32_t *source,uint16_t *port){
 const uint8_t *p;size_t length;uint32_t ip;uint16_t total,udp_length;
 if(!net_receive(&p,&length))return false;
 if(length>=42&&be16(p+12)==0x806&&be16(p+14)==1&&be16(p+16)==0x800&&p[18]==6&&p[19]==4){
  ip=be32(p+28);
  if(be16(p+20)==1&&be32(p+38)==net_config.local_ip){if(!arp(2,p+22,ip))panic("ARP response");}
  if(ip==next_hop()&&be32(p+38)==net_config.local_ip&&(be16(p+20)==1||be16(p+20)==2)){memcpy(next_mac,p+22,6);resolved=true;}
  net_release();return false;
 }
 if(length<42||be16(p+12)!=0x800||p[14]!=0x45||p[23]!=17||!p[22]||be16(p+20)&0x3fff||finish(sum(p+14,20,0))||be32(p+30)!=net_config.local_ip){net_release();return false;}

    (be16(p+40)&&finish(sum(p+26,8,sum(p+34,udp_length,17+udp_length))))){net_release();return false;}
 *source=be32(p+26);*port=be16(p+34);*body=p+42;*n=udp_length-8;return true;
}
bool udp_receive(const uint8_t **body,size_t *n){uint32_t ip;uint16_t port;if(!udp_receive_from(body,n,&ip,&port))return false;if(ip!=net_config.peer_ip||port!=net_config.peer_port){net_release();return false;}return true;}
void udp_release(void){net_release();}

#include "virtio_blk.h"
#include "pci.h"
#include "uart.h"
/* Legacy vring: avail immediately follows descriptors, used is page-aligned.
 * Padding avail to a page would VIOLATE the legacy queue layout. */
static uint8_t queue_memory[32768] ALIGN_4K __attribute__((section(".bss.dma")));
static vring_desc *descriptors;
static vring_avail *available;
static vring_used *used;
static uint16_t queue_size;
static struct { uint32_t type,reserved; uint64_t sector; } request ALIGN_64;
static uint8_t dma_page[4096] ALIGN_4K __attribute__((section(".bss.dma")));
static uint8_t status ALIGN_64;
static uint16_t io,last_used;
static bool inflight,failed,write_operation;
static void *read_target;
static uint64_t capacity;
static uint32_t transfer_length;
static bool finish(void) {
 uint64_t start=rdtsc(); bool ok=false;
 while(!virtio_blk_poll(&ok)) {
  if(rdtsc()-start>120000000000ULL) {
   /* A bounded storage deadline, not a CPU quantum: synchronous FLUSH can
    * stall on shared backing media. Never recycle outstanding DMA buffers. */
   failed=true;uart_puts("VirtIO stalled type=");uart_put_dec(request.type);
   uart_puts(" sector=");uart_put_dec(request.sector);uart_puts(" avail=");uart_put_dec(available->idx);
   uart_puts(" used=");uart_put_dec(used->idx);uart_puts(" consumed=");uart_put_dec(last_used);uart_puts("\n");
   panic("VirtIO timeout: DMA buffers retained");
  }
  cpu_pause();
 }
 return ok;
}
void virtio_blk_init(void) {
 pci_device_t d=pci_find_device(0x1af4,0x1001); uint32_t bar,features;
 if(!d.found) {
  d=pci_find_device(0x1af4,0x1042);
  panic(d.found?"modern-only VirtIO unsupported: use transitional device":"VirtIO PCI device absent");
 }
 bar=pci_read(d,0x10);
 if(!(bar&1U)||(bar&~3U)>65500U) panic("VirtIO invalid I/O BAR");
 io=(uint16_t)(bar&~3U); pci_enable_io_dma(d);
 outb(io+18,0); outb(io+18,1); outb(io+18,3);
 features=inl(io);
 if(!(features&(1U<<9))) panic("VirtIO FLUSH required for durability");
 outl(io+4,1U<<9); outw(io+14,0);
 queue_size=inw(io+12);
 uart_puts("VirtIO IO="); uart_put_hex(io); uart_puts(" qsize="); uart_put_dec(queue_size); uart_puts(" PFN="); uart_put_hex(inl(io+8)); uart_puts("\n");
 if((queue_size<128||queue_size>1024||(queue_size&(queue_size-1)))||inl(io+8)!=0) panic("VirtIO queue size unsupported");
 memset(queue_memory,0,sizeof queue_memory);
 descriptors=(vring_desc *)queue_memory;
 available=(vring_avail *)(queue_memory+16U*queue_size);
 used=(vring_used *)(queue_memory+((16U*queue_size+6U+2U*queue_size+4095U)&~4095U));
 outl(io+8,(uint32_t)((uint64_t)queue_memory>>12));
 capacity=(uint64_t)inl(io+20)|((uint64_t)inl(io+24)<<32);
 if(capacity<1024) panic("VirtIO disk too small");
 outb(io+18,7);
 if(inb(io+18)&128) panic("VirtIO device rejected initialization");
 uart_puts("PCI VirtIO legacy detected; DMA queue="); uart_put_dec(queue_size); uart_puts("; FLUSH negotiated\n");
}
static bool submit(uint32_t type,uint64_t sector,const void *page,uint32_t length) {
 vring_desc *d=descriptors; uint16_t a;
 if(!io||failed||inflight||sector>capacity||capacity-sector<length/512) return false;
 if(length>4096||length%512||(!page&&type!=4)) return false;
 transfer_length=length; request.type=type; request.reserved=0; request.sector=sector;
 status=0xff; write_operation=type!=0; read_target=(void *)page;
 if(type==1) memcpy(dma_page,page,length);
 d[0].addr=(uint64_t)&request; d[0].len=16; d[0].flags=1; d[0].next=type==4?2:1;
 d[1].addr=(uint64_t)dma_page; d[1].len=length; d[1].flags=(uint16_t)(1|(type==0?2:0)); d[1].next=2;
 d[2].addr=(uint64_t)&status; d[2].len=1; d[2].flags=2; d[2].next=0;
 a=available->idx; ((uint16_t *)((uint8_t *)available+4))[a%queue_size]=0;
 inflight=true;
 __atomic_store_n(&available->idx,(uint16_t)(a+1),__ATOMIC_RELEASE);
 mfence(); outw(io+16,0); return true;
}
bool virtio_blk_submit(uint64_t sector,const void *page,bool write) { return submit(write?1U:0U,sector,page,4096); }
bool virtio_blk_poll(bool *ok) {
 uint16_t u; uint8_t s;
 if(!inflight) { *ok=false; return true; }
 u=__atomic_load_n(&used->idx,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
 if(u==last_used) return false;
 if((uint16_t)(u-last_used)!=1 || ((vring_used_elem *)((uint8_t *)used+4))[last_used%queue_size].id!=0) panic("VirtIO corrupt used ring");
 s=__atomic_load_n(&status,__ATOMIC_ACQUIRE); *ok=s==0;
 if(*ok&&!write_operation) memcpy(read_target,dma_page,transfer_length);
 last_used=u; inflight=false; (void)inb(io+19); return true;
}
bool virtio_blk_write_page(uint64_t sector,const void *page) { return virtio_blk_submit(sector,page,true)&&finish(); }
bool virtio_blk_read_page(uint64_t sector,void *page) { return virtio_blk_submit(sector,page,false)&&finish(); }
bool virtio_blk_flush(void) { return submit(4,0,0,0)&&finish(); }

uint64_t virtio_blk_capacity(void) { return capacity; }
bool virtio_blk_sector(uint64_t sector,void *data,bool write) { return submit(write?1U:0U,sector,data,512)&&finish(); }

#include "admission.h"
/* Total, deterministic stack checker/interpreter, no back edges, memory access
 * or arbitrary calls. ASSERT proves the evaluated integer equality, not Lean. */
bool vm_verify(const uint8_t *code,size_t length) {
 uint64_t stack[16]; uint8_t kind[16]; unsigned sp=0; size_t pc=0; bool assertion=false;
 if(!length||length>256) return false;
 while(pc<length) {
  uint8_t op=code[pc++]; uint64_t a,b;
  switch(op) {
   case 0: return assertion&&sp==0&&pc==length;
   case 1: if(pc==length||sp==16) return false; kind[sp]=0; stack[sp++]=code[pc++]; break;
   case 2: if(sp<2||kind[sp-1]||kind[sp-2]) return false; b=stack[--sp]; a=stack[sp-1]; if(__builtin_add_overflow(a,b,&stack[sp-1])) return false; break;
   case 3: if(sp<2||kind[sp-1]||kind[sp-2]) return false; b=stack[--sp]; stack[sp-1]=(stack[sp-1]==b); kind[sp-1]=1; break;
   case 4: if(!sp||kind[sp-1]!=1||stack[--sp]!=1) return false; assertion=true; break;
   default: return false;
  }
 }
 return false;
}

#include "xstate.h"
#include "uart.h"
static bool use_xsave, initialized;
static uint64_t mask;
static xstate_t initial;
static void cpuid(uint32_t leaf, uint32_t sub, uint32_t *a, uint32_t *b, uint32_t *c, uint32_t *d) {
    __asm__ volatile("cpuid" : "=a"(*a), "=b"(*b), "=c"(*c), "=d"(*d) : "a"(leaf), "c"(sub));
}
void xstate_init_cpu(void) {
    uint32_t a, b, c, d;
    uint64_t cr0, cr4, enabled = 3;
    cpuid(1, 0, &a, &b, &c, &d);
    bool xs = (c & (1U << 26)) != 0, avx = (c & (1U << 28)) != 0;
    __asm__ volatile("movq %%cr0,%0" : "=r"(cr0));
    cr0 = (cr0 & ~12ULL) | 2;
    __asm__ volatile("movq %0,%%cr0" ::"r"(cr0) : "memory");
    __asm__ volatile("movq %%cr4,%0" : "=r"(cr4));
    cr4 |= (1ULL << 9) | (1ULL << 10);
    if (xs)
        cr4 |= 1ULL << 18;
    __asm__ volatile("movq %0,%%cr4" ::"r"(cr4) : "memory");
    if (xs) {
        cpuid(13, 0, &a, &b, &c, &d);
        if (avx && (a & 7) == 7)
            enabled = 7;
        __asm__ volatile("xsetbv" ::"c"(0), "a"((uint32_t)enabled), "d"(0) : "memory");
        cpuid(13, 0, &a, &b, &c, &d);
        if (b > sizeof initial)
            panic("XSAVE enabled state exceeds context");
    }
    if (initialized && (use_xsave != xs || mask != (xs ? enabled : 0)))
        panic("heterogeneous XSAVE feature set");
    if (!initialized) {
        use_xsave = xs;
        mask = xs ? enabled : 0;
        memset(&initial, 0, sizeof initial);
        initial.bytes[0] = 0x7f;
        initial.bytes[1] = 3;
        initial.bytes[24] = 0x80;
        initial.bytes[25] = 0x1f;
        initialized = true;
    }
    xstate_restore(&initial);
}
void xstate_reset(xstate_t *s) { memcpy(s, &initial, sizeof *s); }
void xstate_save(xstate_t *s) {
    if (use_xsave)
        __asm__ volatile("xsave64 %0" : "=m"(*s) : "a"((uint32_t)mask), "d"(0) : "memory");
    else
        __asm__ volatile("fxsave64 %0" : "=m"(*s)::"memory");
}
void xstate_restore(const xstate_t *s) {
    if (use_xsave)
        __asm__ volatile("xrstor64 %0" ::"m"(*s), "a"((uint32_t)mask), "d"(0) : "memory");
    else
        __asm__ volatile("fxrstor64 %0" ::"m"(*s) : "memory");
}
uint64_t xstate_features(void) { return mask; }

keys=[Ed25519PrivateKey.generate() for _ in range(3)]
cluster=hashlib.blake2b(b'host-only-consensus-vector',digest_size=32).digest()
def record(bad=False):
    organisms=b''.join(struct.pack('<4Q2q96s',i+1,1,42,512,25 if bad else 24,1,b'tensor result = 24; mostrar result;') for i in range(16))
    payload=(b'OMEGA-LINEAGE-V4'+organisms).ljust(2816,b'\0')
    digest=hashlib.blake2b(payload,digest_size=32).digest();epoch=struct.pack('<Q',1);previous=bytes(32)
    statement=b'OMEGA-QUORUM-V4\0'+cluster+epoch+previous+digest
    signatures=keys[0].sign(statement)+keys[1].sign(statement)+bytes(64)
    return b'LINEAGE4'+epoch+previous+digest+struct.pack('<Q',3)+signatures+payload+bytes(1000)
def array(name,data):return 'static const uint8_t '+name+'['+str(len(data))+']={'+','.join(map(str,data))+'};\n'
header=array('cluster_id',cluster)+array('valid_record',record())+array('invalid_semantics',record(True))
header+='static const uint8_t public_keys[3][32]={'+','.join('{'+','.join(map(str,k.public_key().public_bytes_raw()))+'}' for k in keys)+'};\n'
Path('build/consensus_vectors.h').write_text(header)
subprocess.run(['gcc','-std=c99','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror','-pedantic','-ffunction-sections','-fdata-sections','-Iinclude','-Iinclude/crypto','-Ibuild','tests/consensus_harness.c','src/consensus.c','src/cortex_pager.c','src/crypto/monocypher.c','src/crypto/monocypher-ed25519.c','-Wl,--gc-sections','-o','build/consensus_test'],check=True)
subprocess.run(['build/consensus_test'],check=True)
print('PASS signed-majority certificates: public-key verification, quorum, identity, domain, content and semantic rejection')

"""Numerical GGUF fixture, not a trained language model. Same loader as production.
Produces standard Llama tensors with quantized Q8_0 or Q4_K/Q6_K blocks.
"""
import random,struct
from pathlib import Path
D=256;HIDDEN=512;LAYERS=2;HEADS=4;KV=2;VOCAB=256;CONTEXT=1048576

def text(s):b=s.encode();return struct.pack('<Q',len(b))+b

def model(path,mode='q8',seed=8,rope_scaling=None):
    rng=random.Random(seed);metadata={'general.architecture':'llama','llama.embedding_length':D,'llama.feed_forward_length':HIDDEN,'llama.block_count':LAYERS,'llama.attention.head_count':HEADS,'llama.attention.head_count_kv':KV,'llama.context_length':CONTEXT,'llama.attention.layer_norm_rms_epsilon':1e-5,'llama.rope.freq_base':10000.0}
    if rope_scaling:
        metadata.update({"llama.rope.scaling.type":rope_scaling,"llama.rope.scaling.factor":2.0 if rope_scaling=="linear" else 8.0,"llama.rope.scaling.original_context_length":64})
    tables=[];data=bytearray();decoded={}
    def tensor(name,columns,rows=1,norm=False):
        kind=0 if norm else (8 if mode=='q8' else (14 if 'ffn_down' in name else 12))
        values=[];payload=bytearray();n=columns*rows
        if norm:values=[1.0]*n;payload+=struct.pack('<%df'%n,*values)
        elif kind==8:
            for _ in range(n//32):
                scale=struct.unpack('<e',struct.pack('<e',0.002))[0];quant=[rng.randint(-12,12) for _ in range(32)];payload+=struct.pack('<e32b',scale,*quant);values += [scale*x for x in quant]
        elif kind==12:
            for _ in range(n//256):
                # Scale/min fields exercise both the low-six-bit and packed cases.
                scale=struct.unpack('<e',struct.pack('<e',0.002))[0];minimum=struct.unpack("<e",struct.pack("<e",scale*7))[0];scales=bytes([1]*4+[1]*4+[0x11]*4);quant=bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(128));payload+=struct.pack('<ee',scale,minimum)+scales+quant
                for group in range(8):values += [scale*((quant[group//2*32+j]>>(4*(group%2)))&15)-minimum for j in range(32)]
        else:
            for _ in range(n//256):
                scale=struct.unpack('<e',struct.pack('<e',0.001))[0];ql=bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(128));qh=bytes(rng.randrange(256) for _ in range(64));scales=[rng.choice([-2,-1,1,2]) for _ in range(16)];payload+=ql+qh+struct.pack('<16be',*scales,scale)
                for part in range(2):
                    for group in range(4):
                        for j in range(32):
                            low=ql[part*64+j+(group%2)*32];low=low&15 if group<2 else low>>4;q=(low|(((qh[part*32+j]>>(group*2))&3)<<4))-32;values.append(scale*scales[part*8+group*2+j//16]*q)
        offset=(len(data)+31)&~31;data.extend(bytes(offset-len(data)));data.extend(payload);tables.append(text(name)+struct.pack('<I',1 if norm else 2)+struct.pack('<Q',columns)+(b'' if norm else struct.pack('<Q',rows))+struct.pack('<IQ',kind,offset));decoded[name]=(rows,columns,values)
    tensor('token_embd.weight',D,VOCAB)
    tensor('output_norm.weight',D,norm=True)
    for layer in range(LAYERS):
        prefix=f'blk.{layer}.'
        for name in ['attn_norm.weight','ffn_norm.weight']:tensor(prefix+name,D,norm=True)
        for name,rows,cols in [('attn_q',D,D),('attn_k',D*KV//HEADS,D),('attn_v',D*KV//HEADS,D),('attn_output',D,D),('ffn_gate',HIDDEN,D),('ffn_up',HIDDEN,D),('ffn_down',D,HIDDEN)]:tensor(prefix+name+'.weight',cols,rows)
    entries=[]
    for key,value in metadata.items():
        kind=8 if isinstance(value,str) else (6 if isinstance(value,float) else 4);entries.append(text(key)+struct.pack('<I',kind)+(text(value) if kind==8 else struct.pack('<f' if kind==6 else '<I',value)))
    header=b'GGUF'+struct.pack('<IQQ',3,len(tables),len(entries))+b''.join(entries)+b''.join(tables);header=header.ljust((len(header)+31)&~31,b'\0');Path(path).write_bytes(header+data);return decoded

"""Independent NumPy Llama reference for the GGUF numerical fixture."""
import numpy as np
from cortex_fixture import D,HIDDEN,LAYERS,HEADS,KV,VOCAB

def infer(decoded,steps,prompt,contracts=True,rope_scaling=None):
    weights={name:np.asarray(value[2],dtype=np.float32).reshape(value[0],value[1]) for name,value in decoded.items()}
    key=np.zeros((LAYERS,steps,D*KV//HEADS),dtype=np.float16);value=np.zeros_like(key)
    def rms(x,w):return x/np.sqrt(np.mean(x*x,dtype=np.float32)+np.float32(1e-5))*w[0]
    token=1
    for pos in range(steps):
        if pos<len(prompt):token=prompt[pos]
        x=weights['token_embd.weight'][token].copy()
        for layer in range(LAYERS):
            name=f'blk.{layer}.';normalized=rms(x,weights[name+'attn_norm.weight'])
            q=weights[name+'attn_q.weight']@normalized;k=weights[name+'attn_k.weight']@normalized;v=weights[name+'attn_v.weight']@normalized
            size=D//HEADS
            for vector,heads in [(q,HEADS),(k,KV)]:
                for head in range(heads):
                    for j in range(0,size,2):
                        frequency=np.exp(np.float32(-j/size)*np.log(np.float32(10000)))
                        if rope_scaling=="linear":frequency/=2
                        elif rope_scaling=="llama3":
                            wavelength=2*np.pi/frequency
                            if wavelength>64:frequency/=8
                            elif wavelength>16:
                                smooth=(64/wavelength-1)/3;frequency=frequency*(smooth+(1-smooth)/8)
                        angle=np.float32(pos)*frequency
                        cosine,sine=np.cos(angle),np.sin(angle);a,b=vector[head*size+j:head*size+j+2].copy();vector[head*size+j:head*size+j+2]=[a*cosine-b*sine,a*sine+b*cosine]
            key[layer,pos]=k;value[layer,pos]=v;attention=np.zeros(D,dtype=np.float32)
            for head in range(HEADS):
                kh=head//(HEADS//KV);keys=key[layer,:pos+1,kh*size:(kh+1)*size].astype(np.float32);values=value[layer,:pos+1,kh*size:(kh+1)*size].astype(np.float32)
                score=keys@q[head*size:(head+1)*size]/np.sqrt(np.float32(size));prob=np.exp(score-np.max(score));prob/=np.sum(prob);attention[head*size:(head+1)*size]=prob@values
            x+=weights[name+'attn_output.weight']@attention
            normalized=rms(x,weights[name+'ffn_norm.weight']);up=weights[name+'ffn_up.weight']@normalized;gate=weights[name+'ffn_gate.weight']@normalized;x+=weights[name+'ffn_down.weight']@(up*gate/(1+np.exp(-gate)))
        logits=weights.get('output.weight',weights['token_embd.weight'])@rms(x,weights['output_norm.weight'])
        if contracts:
            mask=np.ones(VOCAB,dtype=bool);mask[[0,3]]=False;logits[mask]=-np.inf
        token=int(np.argmax(logits))
    return token,logits,key,value

"""Hardware Cortex acceptance with a standard numerical GGUF and real disk paging."""
from hardware import *
import hashlib,re
import numpy as np
from cortex_reference import infer
from cortex_fixture import model
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]/'tools'))
from cortex_model import provision

def run(image,label,cpu='max',expect_rejection=False):
    cmd=[QEMU,'-kernel','omega_os.elf','-smp','2','-m','64M','-cpu',cpu,'-serial','stdio','-display','none','-no-reboot','-drive',f'file={image},if=virtio,format=raw']
    p=subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT);output=bytearray();selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();selector.register(p.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ);end=time.monotonic()+240
    try:
        while time.monotonic()<end:
            for key,_ in selector.select(.1):
                chunk=os.read(key.fd,65536);output+=chunk
                if b'FAIL:' in output or (b'OMEGA USER ERROR:' in output and not expect_rejection):raise AssertionError(output.decode(errors='replace'))
                if b'complete; HLT\n' in output:return output.decode()
                if not chunk and p.poll() is not None:raise AssertionError(output.decode(errors='replace'))
        raise AssertionError('Cortex timeout:\n'+output.decode(errors='replace')[-2000:])
    finally:
        if p.poll() is None:p.kill()
        p.wait(timeout=5);selector.close();Path(f'build/{label}.log').write_bytes(output)

def main():
    for mode,cpu,profile in [('q8','max','q8-avx'),('q4','max','q4-avx'),('q4','qemu64,-xsave','q4-scalar')]:
        path=Path(f'build/cortex-{profile}.gguf');image=Path(f'build/cortex-{profile}.img');scaling='llama3' if profile=='q4-avx' else ('linear' if profile=='q4-scalar' else None);decoded=model(path,mode,rope_scaling=scaling);image.unlink(missing_ok=True);provision(path,image,32*1024*1024,8,[1,2,3],[(0,1,2),(1,3,2),(2,1,0),(3,-1,2)]);
        text=run(image,f'cortex-{profile}-first',cpu)
        assert 'GGUF inference + PagedAttention + symbolic pruning + native JIT PASS' in text
        assert ('AVX2/FMA dispatch' if cpu=='max' else 'scalar/SWAR dispatch') in text
        assert ('XSAVE x87/SSE/YMM' if cpu=='max' else 'FXSAVE x87/SSE') in text
        reads,writes,evictions,peak=map(int,re.search(r'CORTEX pager reads=(\d+) writes=(\d+) evictions=(\d+) peak=(\d+)',text).groups());assert reads>64 and writes>0 and evictions>0 and peak<=64
        state=roots(image)[-1][1][0x1001][1];values=struct.unpack_from('<7Q8I',state);assert values[2]==8 and values[6]>768*1024*1024
        pages=roots(image)[-1][1];token,reference,keys,values=infer(decoded,8,[1,2,3],rope_scaling=scaling)
        actual=np.frombuffer(pages[0x1002][1],dtype='<f4',count=256);assert np.all(np.isneginf(actual)==np.isneginf(reference))
        np.testing.assert_allclose(actual[[0,3]],reference[[0,3]],rtol=0.004,atol=0.0004)
        assert values is not None and struct.unpack_from('<Q',state,24)[0]==token
        # Compare complete stored K/V blocks, not merely their checksums.
        for layer_id in range(2):
            offset=0x800000+layer_id*131072
            packed=np.frombuffer(b''.join(pages[offset+i][1] for i in range(1)),dtype='<f2')[:8*256].reshape(8,256)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(packed[:,:128],keys[layer_id],rtol=0.008,atol=0.001)
            np.testing.assert_allclose(packed[:,128:],values[layer_id],rtol=0.008,atol=0.001)
        second=run(image,f'cortex-{profile}-reboot',cpu);assert 'restored SLS KV-cache hash PASS' in second
        recovered=roots(image)[-1][1][0x1001][1];assert struct.unpack_from('<Q',recovered,16)[0]==16
        print(f'PASS Cortex {profile}: full Llama path, logical KV >768 MiB, 64 resident frames, page eviction, arbiter/JIT and durable reboot')
    path=Path('build/cortex-invalid.gguf');image=Path('build/cortex-invalid.img');model(path,'q8');raw=bytearray(path.read_bytes());key=b'llama.feed_forward_length';where=raw.index(key)+len(key);struct.pack_into('<I',raw,where+4,0);path.write_bytes(raw);image.unlink(missing_ok=True);provision(path,image,32*1024*1024,1,[1])
    rejected=run(image,'cortex-invalid',expect_rejection=True)
    assert 'OMEGA USER ERROR: GGUF model configuration' in rejected and 'CORTEX task quarantined; kernel retained prior checkpoint' in rejected
    assert 0x1001 not in roots(image)[-1][1]
    print('PASS malformed GGUF quarantined; kernel continues; no cognitive checkpoint published')
if __name__=='__main__':main()

except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:

"""V2 hardware acceptance: atomic roots, timer/SYSCALL processes, Ed25519, P2P DMA."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,selectors,struct,subprocess,sys,time,socket
QEMU=sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv)>1 else 'qemu-system-x86_64'
MASK=(1<<64)-1
MAGIC=0x324f4d454741534c

CRC_TABLE=[]
for byte in range(256):
    value=byte<<56
    for bit in range(8):value=((value<<1)^(0x42f0e1eba9ea3693 if value>>63 else 0))&MASK
    CRC_TABLE.append(value)
def crc(data):
    value=0
    for byte in data:value=CRC_TABLE[(value>>56)^byte]^((value<<8)&MASK)
    return value
assert crc(b'123456789')==0x6c40df5f0b497347

def roots(image):
    candidates=[]
    with open(image,'rb') as f:
        def block(s,h,limit):
            assert s>=8 and s%8==0 and s+8<=limit
            f.seek(s*512); data=f.read(4096)
            assert len(data)==4096 and crc(data)==h
            return data
        def walk(s,h,depth,prefix,limit,pages):
            words=struct.unpack('<512Q',block(s,h,limit))
            for i in range(256):
                if words[2*i]:
                    if depth==2: pages[(prefix<<8)|i]=(words[2*i],block(words[2*i],words[2*i+1],limit))
                    else: walk(words[2*i],words[2*i+1],depth+1,(prefix<<8)|i,limit,pages)
        for slot in range(2):
            f.seek(slot*512); raw=bytearray(f.read(512))
            if len(raw)<512: continue
            v=struct.unpack('<64Q',raw); raw[40:48]=bytes(8)
            if v[0]!=MAGIC or not v[1] or crc(raw)!=v[5]: continue
            pages={}
            try: walk(v[2],v[3],0,0,v[4],pages)
            except AssertionError: continue
            candidates.append((v[1],pages))
    assert candidates,'no complete global root'
    return sorted(candidates)

def create(path,size=128*1024*1024):
    with open(path,'wb') as f: f.truncate(size)

def launch(image,label,crash=0,network=None,stress=False,source=None):
    cmd=[QEMU,'-kernel','omega_os.elf','-smp','2','-m','128M','-serial','stdio','-display','none','-no-reboot','-accel','tcg,thread=multi',
         '-drive',f'file={image},if=virtio,format=raw']
    if source is not None: cmd+=['-append','omega.source='+source]
    if stress: cmd+=['-append','sls.stress']
    if crash: cmd+=['-append',f'sls.crash={crash}']
    if network:
        role,port,config=network
        cmd+=['-cpu','max','-initrd',str(config),'-netdev',f'socket,id=n,connect=127.0.0.1:{port}',
              '-device',f'virtio-net-pci,netdev=n,mac=52:54:00:12:34:0{role}',
              '-object',f'filter-dump,id=dump,netdev=n,file=build/{label}.pcap']
    return subprocess.Popen(cmd,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT),label,crash,network

def finish(jobs):
    sel=selectors.DefaultSelector(); buffers={p:bytearray() for p,*_ in jobs}; pending=set(buffers); deadline=time.monotonic()+90
    for p,*_ in jobs: sel.register(p.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ,p)
    try:
        while pending and time.monotonic()<deadline:
            for key,_ in sel.select(.1):
                p=key.data; chunk=os.read(key.fd,65536)
                if chunk: buffers[p].extend(chunk)
                if b'FAIL:' in buffers[p] or (not chunk and p.poll() is not None): raise AssertionError(buffers[p].decode(errors='replace'))
                job=next(j for j in jobs if j[0] is p)
                marker=f'SLS crash-test boundary={job[2]}\n'.encode() if job[2] else b'complete; HLT\n'
                if marker in buffers[p]: pending.discard(p); sel.unregister(p.stdout)
        assert not pending,'QEMU progress timeout: '+repr([buffers[p].decode(errors='replace') for p in pending])
        texts=[]
        for p,label,crash,network in jobs:
            text=buffers[p].decode(errors='replace'); texts.append(text)
            if not crash:
                for m in ['noncanonical syscall stack quarantined without SYSRET PASS','private peer page PF + non-executable stack PF PASS','SMP SPSC 65536','Ed25519 external signature','private CR3; Ring3 IPC syscalls PASS','original Omega frontend + egraph + tensor PUCT in Ring3 + dynamic child + exact SLS PASS','Ring3 PF/GP + disk rollback PASS','SLS global atomic epoch=']:
                    assert m in text,(label,m,text)
                if network: assert 'routed encrypted UDP + authenticated 4096-byte SLS replication PASS' in text,text
        return texts
    finally:
        for p,label,*_ in jobs:
            if p.poll() is None: p.kill()
            p.wait(timeout=5); Path(f'build/{label}.log').write_bytes(buffers[p])
        sel.close()

def boot(image,label,crash=0): return finish([launch(image,label,crash)])[0]
def epochs(pages): return tuple(struct.unpack_from('<Q',pages[i][1],80)[0] for i in [0,1])
def sparse_copy(source,target):
    subprocess.run(['cp','--sparse=always',str(source),str(target)],check=True)

def run(ops,expected):
    cert=struct.pack('<QQ',0x3343424f,len(ops)+1)+ops+b'\0'
    mapping=mmap.mmap(-1,4096,prot=mmap.PROT_READ|mmap.PROT_WRITE)
    view=(C.c_ubyte*4096).from_buffer(mapping);addr=C.addressof(view);n=C.c_size_t()

    if branch>=0:locations.append(branch+2)

        view[location]=original

    assert libc.mprotect(addr,4096,mmap.PROT_READ|mmap.PROT_WRITE)==0
    del view;mapping.close()

"""Cross-check freestanding arithmetic against Python exact fractions."""
import ctypes as C
from fractions import Fraction
import random
import subprocess

subprocess.run(['gcc', '-shared', '-fPIC', '-O3', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                '-std=c99', '-Iinclude', 'src/rational.c', '-o', 'build/rational.so'], check=True)
class R(C.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('num', C.c_longlong), ('den', C.c_longlong)]
lib = C.CDLL('./build/rational.so')
for name in ['add', 'sub', 'mul']:
    f = getattr(lib, 'rational_' + name)
    f.argtypes = [R, R, C.POINTER(R)]
    f.restype = C.c_bool
lib.rational_cmp.argtypes = [R, R, C.POINTER(C.c_int)]
lib.rational_cmp.restype = C.c_bool
rng = random.Random(42)
count = 0
for _ in range(10000):
    a = Fraction(rng.randint(-100000, 100000), rng.randint(1, 100000))
    b = Fraction(rng.randint(-100000, 100000), rng.randint(1, 100000))
    ar, br = R(a.numerator, a.denominator), R(b.numerator, b.denominator)
    for name, expected in [('add', a+b), ('sub', a-b), ('mul', a*b)]:
        out = R()
        assert getattr(lib, 'rational_'+name)(ar, br, C.byref(out))
        assert (out.num, out.den) == (expected.numerator, expected.denominator)
        count += 1
    result = C.c_int()
    assert lib.rational_cmp(ar, br, C.byref(result))
    assert result.value == (a > b) - (a < b)
    count += 1
print(f'PASS: {count} rational operations versus fractions.Fraction')

"""Two routed subnets, ARP gateways, authenticated encrypted UDP, adverse frames."""
from hardware import *
import hashlib,ipaddress,threading
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519 import X25519PrivateKey

def checksum(data):
    if len(data)&1:data+=b'\0'
    value=sum(struct.unpack('!%dH'%(len(data)//2),data))
    while value>>16:value=(value&65535)+(value>>16)
    return (~value)&65535

class Router:
    def __init__(self):
        self.selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();self.listeners=[];self.connections={};self.input={};self.output={};self.inject=[0,0];self.count=[0,0];self.capture=[];self.stop=False;self.error=None
        self.ips=[int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(x)) for x in ['10.21.0.2','10.22.0.2']]
        self.gateways=[int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(x)) for x in ['10.21.0.1','10.22.0.1']]
        for i in range(2):
            s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));s.listen();s.setblocking(False);self.listeners.append(s);self.selector.register(s,selectors.EVENT_READ,('listen',i))
        self.ports=[s.getsockname()[1] for s in self.listeners]
        self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.run,daemon=True);self.thread.start()
    def enqueue(self,i,packet):
        if i not in self.connections:return
        self.output[i]+=struct.pack('!I',len(packet))+packet
        self.selector.modify(self.connections[i],selectors.EVENT_READ|selectors.EVENT_WRITE,('connection',i))
    def route(self,i,p):
        if len(p)<42:return
        other=1-i;kind=struct.unpack_from('!H',p,12)[0]
        gateway_mac=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0xab,0,0xe1+i])
        if kind==0x806 and struct.unpack_from('!H',p,20)[0]==1:
            target=struct.unpack_from('!I',p,38)[0]
            assert target==self.gateways[i],'guest failed to choose off-subnet gateway'
            reply=bytearray(60);reply[:6]=p[6:12];reply[6:12]=gateway_mac;reply[12:22]=bytes.fromhex('08060001080006040002')
            reply[22:28]=gateway_mac;reply[28:32]=struct.pack('!I',self.gateways[i]);reply[32:38]=p[22:28];reply[38:42]=p[28:32]
            self.enqueue(i,reply);return
        if kind!=0x800:return # V2 direct-DMA probe isn't part of secure state traffic.
        assert checksum(p[14:34])==0 and p[23]==17
        assert struct.unpack_from('!2I',p,26)==(self.ips[i],self.ips[other])
        body=p[42:];assert b'OMEGA-COG-V3' not in body,'plaintext snapshot leaked'
        self.capture.append(p)
        routed=bytearray(p);routed[:6]=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0x12,0x34,other+1]);routed[6:12]=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0xab,0,0xe1+other]);routed[22]-=1;routed[24:26]=b'\0\0';routed[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',checksum(bytes(routed[14:34])))
        if len(body)>8 and body[:8]==b'OMPNET3\0' and body[8]==2:
            self.count[i]+=1
            if self.inject[i]<8:
                bad=bytearray(routed);bad[-1]^=0x80;bad[40:42]=b'\0\0';udp_length=struct.unpack_from('!H',bad,38)[0]
                pseudo=bytes(bad[26:34])+b'\0\x11'+bytes(bad[38:40]);bad[40:42]=struct.pack('!H',checksum(pseudo+bytes(bad[34:34+udp_length])) or 65535)
                self.enqueue(other,bad);self.enqueue(other,routed);self.enqueue(other,routed);self.inject[i]+=1;return
        self.enqueue(other,routed)
    def run(self):
        try:
            while not self.stop:
                for key,events in self.selector.select(.05):
                    mode,i=key.data
                    if mode=='listen':
                        conn,_=key.fileobj.accept();conn.setblocking(False);self.connections[i]=conn;self.input[i]=bytearray();self.output[i]=bytearray();self.selector.register(conn,selectors.EVENT_READ,('connection',i));continue
                    conn=key.fileobj
                    if events&selectors.EVENT_READ:
                        try:data=conn.recv(65536)
                        except ConnectionResetError:data=b''
                        if not data:self.selector.unregister(conn);conn.close();self.connections.pop(i,None);continue
                        self.input[i]+=data
                        while len(self.input[i])>=4:
                            n=struct.unpack_from('!I',self.input[i])[0]
                            assert n<=65536
                            if len(self.input[i])<n+4:break
                            p=bytes(self.input[i][4:4+n]);del self.input[i][:4+n]
                            if n:self.route(i,p)
                    if events&selectors.EVENT_WRITE and self.output[i]:
                        try:sent=conn.send(self.output[i])
                        except (BrokenPipeError,ConnectionResetError):
                            self.selector.unregister(conn);conn.close();self.connections.pop(i,None);continue
                        del self.output[i][:sent]
                        if not self.output[i]:self.selector.modify(conn,selectors.EVENT_READ,('connection',i))
        except (OSError,AssertionError) as exc:
            if not self.stop:self.error=exc
    def close(self):
        self.stop=True;self.thread.join(timeout=2)
        for s in [*self.listeners,*self.connections.values()]:s.close()
        self.selector.close()

def configs():

"""Three routed QEMU nodes: native Ring3, bounded evolution, signed majority, SIGKILL."""
from hardware import *
from v3_network import Router,checksum
import hashlib,ipaddress,re,tempfile,threading,signal

from cluster_config import provision
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey

class ClusterRouter(Router):
    def __init__(self):
        self.selector=selectors.DefaultSelector();self.listeners=[];self.connections={};self.input={};self.output={};self.capture=[];self.stop=False;self.error=None
        self.blocked={0,1,2}
        self.ips=[int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(f'10.{21+i}.0.2')) for i in range(3)]
        self.gateways=[int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(f'10.{21+i}.0.1')) for i in range(3)]
        for i in range(3):
            s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));s.listen();s.setblocking(False);self.listeners.append(s);self.selector.register(s,selectors.EVENT_READ,('listen',i))
        self.ports=[s.getsockname()[1] for s in self.listeners];self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.run,daemon=True);self.thread.start()
    def route(self,i,p):
        if len(p)<42:return
        kind=struct.unpack_from('!H',p,12)[0];gateway_mac=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0xab,0,0xe1+i])
        if kind==0x806 and struct.unpack_from('!H',p,20)[0]==1:
            assert struct.unpack_from('!I',p,38)[0]==self.gateways[i]
            reply=bytearray(60);reply[:6]=p[6:12];reply[6:12]=gateway_mac;reply[12:22]=bytes.fromhex('08060001080006040002')
            reply[22:28]=gateway_mac;reply[28:32]=struct.pack('!I',self.gateways[i]);reply[32:38]=p[22:28];reply[38:42]=p[28:32];self.enqueue(i,reply);return
        if kind!=0x800:return
        assert checksum(p[14:34])==0 and p[23]==17
        src,dst=struct.unpack_from('!2I',p,26);assert src==self.ips[i] and dst in self.ips
        other=self.ips.index(dst)
        assert b'OMEGA-LINEAGE-V4' not in p[42:],'plaintext genome escaped tunnel'
        self.capture.append(p)
        if i in self.blocked or other in self.blocked:return
        routed=bytearray(p);routed[:6]=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0x12,0x34,other+1]);routed[6:12]=bytes([0x52,0x54,0,0xab,0,0xe1+other]);routed[22]-=1;routed[24:26]=b'\0\0';routed[24:26]=struct.pack('!H',checksum(bytes(routed[14:34])));self.enqueue(other,routed)

def verify_record(raw,config):
    assert len(raw)==4096 and raw[:8]==b'LINEAGE4'
    epoch=struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,8)[0];digest=hashlib.blake2b(raw[280:3096],digest_size=32).digest()
    assert digest==raw[48:80] and raw[280:296]==b'OMEGA-LINEAGE-V4'
    mask=struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,80)[0];assert mask&1 and mask.bit_count()>=2 and mask&~7==0
    module=config.read_bytes();statement=b'OMEGA-QUORUM-V4\0'+module[96:128]+raw[8:16]+raw[16:48]+digest
    for i in range(3):
        if mask>>i&1:Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(module[128+i*80+48:128+i*80+80]).verify(raw[88+i*64:152+i*64],statement)
    return epoch,digest

def main(provisioner=None,burst_ticks=60000000000):
    router=ClusterRouter();configuration=provision(Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='cluster-',dir='build')),burst_ticks)
    images=[Path(f'build/v4-node-{i+1}.img') for i in range(3)]
    for image in images:
        if provisioner:provisioner(image)
        else:create(image,32*1024*1024)
    jobs=[];logs={};selector=selectors.DefaultSelector()
    def start(i,label):
        job=launch(images[i],label,network=(i+1,router.ports[i],configuration[i]));jobs.append(job);logs[job[0]]=bytearray();selector.register(job[0].stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ,job);return job
    def until(job,marker,timeout=90):
        end=time.monotonic()+timeout
        while marker not in logs[job[0]] and time.monotonic()<end:
            assert router.error is None,router.error
            for key,_ in selector.select(.05):
                active=key.data;chunk=os.read(key.fd,65536)
                if chunk:logs[active[0]]+=chunk
                elif active[0].poll() is not None:selector.unregister(active[0].stdout)
                assert b'FAIL:' not in logs[active[0]],logs[active[0]].decode(errors='replace')
        assert marker in logs[job[0]],logs[job[0]].decode(errors='replace')
    def snapshot(active):
        # Freeze only our own guests while reading their external disk state.
        # A running semispace GC can otherwise recycle blocks mid-inspection.
        for job in active:job[0].send_signal(signal.SIGSTOP)
        try:
            for job in active:
                _,status=os.waitpid(job[0].pid,os.WUNTRACED)
                assert os.WIFSTOPPED(status)
            return [roots(image)[-1][1][6][1] for image in images]
        finally:
            for job in active:job[0].send_signal(signal.SIGCONT)
    try:
        a=start(0,'v4-node-1');until(a,b'QUORUM isolated: lineage epoch remains 0')
        assert 6 not in roots(images[0])[-1][1],'isolated leader published lineage'
        a[0].kill();a[0].wait(timeout=5)
        a=start(0,'v4-node-1-restart');until(a,b'QUORUM recovered durable uncommitted proposal')
        until(a,b'QUORUM service ready')
        b=start(1,'v4-node-2');c=start(2,'v4-node-3')
        until(b,b'QUORUM service ready');until(c,b'QUORUM service ready')
        # All three VMs now run concurrently in distinct routed subnets.
        router.blocked={2} # The third node remains alive but partitioned.
        for job in [a,b]:until(job,b'QUORUM durable lineage epoch=1')
        assert 6 not in roots(images[2])[-1][1]
        c[0].kill();c[0].wait(timeout=5) # actual SIGKILL before its publication
        router.blocked.clear()
        recovered=start(2,'v4-node-3-catchup');until(recovered,b'QUORUM durable lineage epoch=1')
        records=snapshot([a,b,recovered])
        assert len(set(records))==1
        for i,record in enumerate(records):assert verify_record(record,configuration[i])[0]==1
        for job in [a,b,c,recovered]:
            text=logs[job[0]].decode();native,reference=map(int,re.search(r'JIT native TSC=(\d+) reference interpreter TSC=(\d+)',text).groups());assert native<reference
            cycles,promoted,rejected=map(int,re.search(r'INCUBATOR cycles=(\d+) promotions=(\d+) rejected=(\d+)',text).groups());assert cycles>=50 and promoted>0 and rejected>=3
            assert 'egraph/PUCT mutations=50' in text
            assert 'TEST JIT RX write trapped #PF; child quarantined PASS' in text and '16 private Ring3 address spaces runnable simultaneously' in text and 'JIT fault rollback parent retained vector=14' in text
        recovered[0].kill();recovered[0].wait(timeout=5)
        restarted=start(2,'v4-node-3-restart');until(restarted,b'QUORUM recovered certified lineage epoch=1')
        assert roots(images[2])[-1][1][6][1]==records[2]
        for job in [a,b,restarted]:until(job,b'QUORUM durable lineage epoch=2')
        current_records=snapshot([a,b,restarted])
        assert len(set(current_records))==1
        for i,record in enumerate(current_records):assert verify_record(record,configuration[i])[0]==2
        for job in [a,b,restarted]:until(job,b'INCUBATOR cycles=100 ')
        assert len(router.capture)>10 and router.error is None
        print('PASS native JIT + 50 Pareto cycles + 16 private processes; isolated epoch blocked; 3 routed encrypted nodes; Ed25519 2/3 certificate; real SIGKILL recovery; persistent compiler resumed through epoch 2')
    finally:
        for job in jobs:
            if job[0].poll() is None:job[0].kill()
            job[0].wait(timeout=5);Path(f'build/{job[1]}.log').write_bytes(logs[job[0]])
        router.close();selector.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()

/* Hosted test only: kernel objects themselves have no libc dependencies. */
#include <pthread.h>
#include <sched.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "ipc.h"
#define MESSAGES 1000000ULL
static omega_ring_t ring;
static void *produce(void *unused) {
 uint64_t i; (void)unused;
 for(i=0;i<MESSAGES;i++) while(!ring_push(&ring,i)) sched_yield();
 return 0;
}
static void *consume(void *unused) {
 uint64_t i,v; (void)unused;
 for(i=0;i<MESSAGES;i++) {
  while(!ring_pop(&ring,&v)) sched_yield();
  if(v!=i) { fputs("FIFO corruption\n",stderr); exit(1); }
 }
 return 0;
}
int main(void) {
 pthread_t producer,consumer;
 ring_init(&ring);
 if(pthread_create(&producer,0,produce,0)||pthread_create(&consumer,0,consume,0)) return 1;
 if(pthread_join(producer,0)||pthread_join(consumer,0)) return 1;
 puts("PASS: 1000000 SPSC messages between two host threads"); return 0;
}

/* Native Ring 3 program. Compiled separately; no kernel symbols or headers. */
typedef unsigned long long u64;
static u64 ticks(void) { unsigned l,h; __asm__ volatile("lfence; rdtsc":"=a"(l),"=d"(h)::"memory"); return ((u64)h<<32)|l; }
static u64 call(u64 nr,u64 arg) {
 u64 result;
 __asm__ volatile("syscall":"=a"(result):"a"(nr),"D"(arg):"rcx","r11","memory"); return result;
}
void _start(void) {
 volatile u64 *data=(volatile u64 *)0x80002000ULL;
 u64 role=data[0],i;
 if(call(0,0)!=role+1) (void)call(3,1);
 if(data[22]){if(data[24])*(volatile unsigned char *)0x83000000ULL=0xf4;u64 ok=((u64 (*)(void *))0x83000000ULL)((void *)(data+6));if(!ok)(void)call(3,1);(void)call(data[23],0);}

   if(mac) { volatile unsigned char *packet=(volatile unsigned char *)0x80003000ULL;
