/* Omega Cortex: streaming GGUF/Llama inference in a private Ring-3 ELF.
 * No libc, heap, BLAS, CUDA or floating-point kernel dependency.
 * Weights and FP16 KV blocks are acquired as SLS page capabilities. */
#include "cortex.h"
#include "jit.h"
#include "crypto/monocypher.h"
#define LOCAL static __attribute__((unused))
#define MAX_DIM 8192U
#define MAX_HIDDEN 32768U
#define MAX_VOCAB 262144U
#define MAX_TENSORS 4096U
#define PI 3.14159265358979323846f
LOCAL bool vector_available(void) {
    uint32_t a, b, c, d, lo, hi;
    __asm__ volatile("cpuid" : "=a"(a), "=b"(b), "=c"(c), "=d"(d) : "a"(1), "c"(0));
    if ((c & ((1U << 27) | (1U << 28) | (1U << 12))) != ((1U << 27) | (1U << 28) | (1U << 12)))
        return false;
    __asm__ volatile("xgetbv" : "=a"(lo), "=d"(hi) : "c"(0));
    if ((lo & 7) != 7)
        return false;
    __asm__ volatile("cpuid" : "=a"(a), "=b"(b), "=c"(c), "=d"(d) : "a"(7), "c"(0));
    return (b & (1U << 5)) != 0;
}
LOCAL bool finite(float x) {
    uint32_t u;
    memcpy(&u, &x, 4);
    return (u & 0x7f800000U) != 0x7f800000U;
}
float cortex_fp16(uint16_t h) {
    uint32_t sign = (uint32_t)(h & 0x8000) << 16, e = (h >> 10) & 31, m = h & 1023, u;
    if (e == 31)
        u = sign | 0x7f800000U | (m << 13);
    else if (!e) {
        if (!m)
            u = sign;
        else {
            unsigned shift = 0;
            while (!(m & 1024)) {
                m <<= 1;
                shift++;
            }
            u = sign | ((127 - 14 - shift) << 23) | ((m & 1023) << 13);
        }
    } else
        u = sign | ((e + 112) << 23) | (m << 13);
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, &u, 4);
    return f;
}
LOCAL uint16_t half(float x) {
    uint32_t u;
    memcpy(&u, &x, 4);
    uint32_t sign = (u >> 16) & 0x8000, e = (u >> 23) & 255, m = u & 0x7fffff;
    if (e == 255)
        return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00 | (m ? 0x200 : 0));
    int exponent = (int)e - 127 + 15;
    if (exponent >= 31)
        return (uint16_t)(sign | 0x7c00);
    if (exponent <= 0) {
        if (exponent < -10)
            return (uint16_t)sign;
        m |= 0x800000;
        unsigned shift = (unsigned)(14 - exponent);
        uint32_t value = m >> shift, rem = m & ((1U << shift) - 1), mid = 1U << (shift - 1);
        if (rem > mid || (rem == mid && (value & 1)))
            value++;
        return (uint16_t)(sign | value);
    }
    uint32_t value = m >> 13, rem = m & 8191;
    if (rem > 4096 || (rem == 4096 && (value & 1))) {
        value++;
        if (value == 1024) {
            value = 0;
            exponent++;
        }
    }
    return (uint16_t)(sign | ((uint32_t)exponent << 10) | value);
}
LOCAL float load_float(const uint8_t *p) {
    float f;
    memcpy(&f, p, 4);
    return f;
}
LOCAL float load_half(const uint8_t *p) {
    uint16_t h;
    memcpy(&h, p, 2);
    return cortex_fp16(h);
}
float cortex_dequant_value(unsigned type, const uint8_t *p, unsigned index) {
    if (type == 0)
        return load_float(p + 4 * index);
    if (type == 1)
        return load_half(p + 2 * index);
    if (type == 8)
        return load_half(p) * (float)((const signed char *)(p + 2))[index];
    if (type == 12) {
        unsigned group = index / 32, j = index % 32, scale, min;
        const uint8_t *s = p + 4;
        if (group < 4) {
            scale = s[group] & 63;
            min = s[group + 4] & 63;
        } else {
            scale = (s[group + 4] & 15) | ((s[group - 4] >> 6) << 4);
            min = (s[group + 4] >> 4) | ((s[group] >> 6) << 4);
        }
        unsigned q = p[16 + (group / 2) * 32 + j];
        q = (group & 1) ? q >> 4 : q & 15;
        return load_half(p) * (float)(scale * q) - load_half(p + 2) * (float)min;
    }
    if (type == 14) {
        unsigned part = index / 128, i = index % 128, l = i % 32, group = i / 32;
        const uint8_t *ql = p + part * 64, *qh = p + 128 + part * 32;
        unsigned low = ql[l + (group & 1) * 32];
        low = group < 2 ? low & 15 : low >> 4;
        int q = (int)(low | (((qh[l] >> (group * 2)) & 3) << 4)) - 32;
        int scale = ((const signed char *)(p + 192))[part * 8 + group * 2 + l / 16];
        return load_half(p + 208) * (float)(scale * q);
    }
    return 0.0f / 0.0f;
}
LOCAL __attribute__((target("avx2,fma"))) float dot_avx(const float *a, const float *b,
                                                        unsigned n) {
    float lanes[8] ALIGN_64;
    unsigned i = 0;
    __asm__ volatile("vxorps %%ymm0,%%ymm0,%%ymm0" ::: "ymm0");
    for (; i + 8 <= n; i += 8)
        __asm__ volatile("vmovups (%0),%%ymm1; vfmadd231ps (%1),%%ymm1,%%ymm0" ::"r"(a + i),
                         "r"(b + i)
                         : "ymm0", "ymm1", "memory");
    __asm__ volatile("vmovups %%ymm0,%0; vzeroupper" : "=m"(lanes)::"ymm0", "memory");
    float s = 0;
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < 8; j++)
        s += lanes[j];
    for (; i < n; i++)
        s += a[i] * b[i];
    return s;
}
LOCAL float dot_scalar(const float *a, const float *b, unsigned n) {
    float s = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++)
        s += a[i] * b[i];
    return s;
}
LOCAL __attribute__((target("avx2,fma"))) float quant_dot_avx(unsigned type, const uint8_t *quant,
                                                              const float *input) {
    float total = 0;
    unsigned groups = type == 8 ? 1 : 8;
    for (unsigned group = 0; group < groups; group++) {
        float scale, minimum = 0;
        unsigned shift = 0;
        const uint8_t *p;
        if (type == 8) {
            scale = load_half(quant);
            p = quant + 2;
        } else {
            const uint8_t *s = quant + 4;
            unsigned sc, mn;
            if (group < 4) {
                sc = s[group] & 63;
                mn = s[group + 4] & 63;
            } else {
                sc = (s[group + 4] & 15) | ((s[group - 4] >> 6) << 4);
                mn = (s[group + 4] >> 4) | ((s[group] >> 6) << 4);
            }
            scale = load_half(quant) * (float)sc;
            minimum = load_half(quant + 2) * (float)mn;
            shift = (group & 1) ? 4 : 0;
            p = quant + 16 + group / 2 * 32;
        }
        float lanes[8] ALIGN_64;
        const float *x = input + group * 32;
        unsigned count = 4, mask = 15;
        if (type == 8) {
            __asm__ volatile("vxorps %%ymm0,%%ymm0,%%ymm0; vbroadcastss %4,%%ymm2; 1: vpmovsxbd "
                             "(%1),%%ymm1; vcvtdq2ps %%ymm1,%%ymm1; vmulps %%ymm2,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; "
                             "vfmadd231ps (%2),%%ymm1,%%ymm0; addq $8,%1; addq $32,%2; decl %3; "
                             "jnz 1b; vmovups %%ymm0,%0; vzeroupper"
                             : "=m"(lanes), "+&r"(p), "+&r"(x), "+&r"(count)
                             : "m"(scale)
                             : "ymm0", "ymm1", "ymm2", "memory", "cc");
        } else {
            __asm__ volatile(
                "vxorps %%ymm0,%%ymm0,%%ymm0; vbroadcastss %4,%%ymm2; vbroadcastss %5,%%ymm3; "
                "vpbroadcastd %6,%%ymm4; 1: vpmovzxbd (%1),%%ymm1; testl %7,%7; jz 2f; vpsrld "
                "$4,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; 2: vpand %%ymm4,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; vcvtdq2ps %%ymm1,%%ymm1; vmulps "
                "%%ymm2,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; vsubps %%ymm3,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; vfmadd231ps "
                "(%2),%%ymm1,%%ymm0; addq $8,%1; addq $32,%2; decl %3; jnz 1b; vmovups %%ymm0,%0; "
                "vzeroupper"
                : "=m"(lanes), "+&r"(p), "+&r"(x), "+&r"(count)
                : "m"(scale), "m"(minimum), "m"(mask), "r"(shift)
                : "ymm0", "ymm1", "ymm2", "ymm3", "ymm4", "memory", "cc");
        }
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 8; j++)
            total += lanes[j];
    }
    return total;
}
LOCAL __attribute__((target("avx2"))) int64_t i8_avx(const signed char *a, const signed char *b,
                                                     unsigned n) {
    int32_t lanes[8] ALIGN_64;
    int64_t sum = 0;
    unsigned i = 0;
    for (; i + 16 <= n; i += 16) {
        __asm__ volatile("vpmovsxbw (%1),%%ymm0; vpmovsxbw (%2),%%ymm1; vpmullw "
                         "%%ymm1,%%ymm0,%%ymm0; vpcmpeqw %%ymm1,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; vpsrlw "
                         "$15,%%ymm1,%%ymm1; vpmaddwd %%ymm1,%%ymm0,%%ymm0; vmovdqu %%ymm0,%0"
                         : "=m"(lanes)
                         : "r"(a + i), "r"(b + i)
                         : "ymm0", "ymm1", "memory");
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 8; j++)
            sum += lanes[j];
    }
    __asm__ volatile("vzeroupper" ::: "memory");
    for (; i < n; i++)
        sum += (int64_t)a[i] * b[i];
    return sum;
}
bool cortex_gemm_i8(const signed char *a, const signed char *b, int64_t *c, uint32_t m, uint32_t n,
                    uint32_t k, bool vector) {
    if (!m || !n || !k || k > 1048576 || m > 65536 || n > 65536)
        return false;
    bool simd = vector && vector_available();
    /* A and B panels: 4 x K and 32 x K. Accumulation never saturates int16. */
    for (unsigned ii = 0; ii < m; ii += 4)
        for (unsigned jj = 0; jj < n; jj += 32)
            for (unsigned i = ii; i < m && i < ii + 4; i++)
                for (unsigned j = jj; j < n && j < jj + 32; j++) {
                    int64_t total = 0;
                    for (unsigned kk = 0; kk < k; kk += 256) {
                        unsigned count = k - kk;
                        if (count > 256)
                            count = 256;
                        if (simd)
                            total += i8_avx(a + (size_t)i * k + kk, b + (size_t)j * k + kk, count);
                        else {
                            /* 64-bit packed loads, explicitly signed lanes, exact int64
                             * accumulation. */
                            unsigned t = 0;
                            for (; t + 8 <= count; t += 8) {
                                uint64_t x, y;
                                memcpy(&x, a + (size_t)i * k + kk + t, 8);
                                memcpy(&y, b + (size_t)j * k + kk + t, 8);
                                for (unsigned lane = 0; lane < 8; lane++)
                                    total += (int64_t)(signed char)(x >> (lane * 8)) *
                                             (signed char)(y >> (lane * 8));
                            }
                            for (; t < count; t++)
                                total +=
                                    (int64_t)a[(size_t)i * k + kk + t] * b[(size_t)j * k + kk + t];
                        }
                    }
                    c[(size_t)i * n + j] = total;
                }
    return true;
}
unsigned cortex_symbolic_prune(float *scores, unsigned vocabulary, const cortex_contract_t *rules,
                               unsigned count) {
    unsigned rejected = 0;
    omega_rational_t one = {1, 1};
    uint32_t neginf = 0xff800000U;
    for (unsigned token = 0; token < vocabulary; token++) {
        bool allowed = false;
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; i++)
            if (rules[i].token == token) {
                omega_rational_t square;
                int cmp = 1;
                allowed = rational_valid(rules[i].value) &&
                          rational_mul(rules[i].value, rules[i].value, &square) &&
                          rational_cmp(square, one, &cmp) && cmp <= 0;
                break;
            }
        if (!allowed) {
            memcpy(scores + token, &neginf, 4);
            rejected++;
        }
    }
    return rejected;
}
LOCAL float root(float x) {
    if (x <= 0)
        return 0;
    uint32_t u;
    memcpy(&u, &x, 4);
    u = (u >> 1) + 0x1fc00000;
    float r;
    memcpy(&r, &u, 4);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 6; i++)
        r = 0.5f * (r + x / r);
    return r;
}
LOCAL float exponential(float x) {
    if (x < -80)
        return 0;
    if (x > 80)
        x = 80;
    float y = x * 1.4426950408889634f;
    int k = (int)y;
    if ((float)k > y)
        k--;
    float r = x - (float)k * 0.6931471805599453f;
    float p = 1 + r * (1 + r * (0.5f + r * (0.1666666667f +
                                            r * (0.0416666667f +
                                                 r * (0.0083333333f +
                                                      r * (0.0013888889f + r * 0.0001984127f))))));
    uint32_t bits = (uint32_t)(k + 127) << 23;
    float scale;
    memcpy(&scale, &bits, 4);
    return p * scale;
}
LOCAL float logarithm(float x) {
    uint32_t b;
    memcpy(&b, &x, 4);
    int k = (int)((b >> 23) & 255) - 127;
    b = (b & 0x7fffff) | 0x3f800000;
    float m;
    memcpy(&m, &b, 4);
    float z = (m - 1) / (m + 1), q = z * z, p = z, sum = 0;
    for (unsigned j = 1; j < 24; j += 2) {
        sum += p / (float)j;
        p *= q;
    }
    return 2 * sum + (float)k * 0.69314718056f;
}
LOCAL void sincosine(float x, float *s, float *c) {
    double angle = x;
    int64_t turns = (int64_t)(angle / 6.283185307179586476925);
    x = (float)(angle - (double)turns * 6.283185307179586476925);
    if (x > PI)
        x -= 2 * PI;
    if (x < -PI)
        x += 2 * PI;
    float cosine_sign = 1;
    if (x > PI / 2) {
        x = PI - x;
        cosine_sign = -1;
    }
    if (x < -PI / 2) {
        x = -PI - x;
        cosine_sign = -1;
    }
    float q = x * x;
    *s = x *
         (1 +
          q * (-0.16666666667f +
               q * (0.00833333333f +
                    q * (-0.00019841270f +
                         q * (0.00000275573f + q * (-0.00000002505f + q * 0.00000000016059f))))));
    *c = 1 + q * (-0.5f +
                  q * (0.04166666667f +
                       q * (-0.00138888889f +
                            q * (0.00002480159f + q * (-0.00000027557f + q * 0.00000000208768f)))));
    *c *= cosine_sign;
}
#ifdef CORTEX_HOST_TEST
float cortex_test_sin(float x) {
    float s, c;
    sincosine(x, &s, &c);
    return s;
}
float cortex_test_exp(float x) { return exponential(x); }
#endif
#ifndef CORTEX_HOST_TEST
extern void omega_fail(const char *s);
extern bool omega_cortex_contract(omega_rational_t value);
LOCAL uint64_t sys(uint64_t n, uint64_t a, uint64_t b) {
    uint64_t r;
    __asm__ volatile("syscall" : "=a"(r) : "a"(n), "D"(a), "S"(b) : "rcx", "r11", "memory");
    return r;
}
LOCAL void fail(const char *s) { omega_fail(s); }
LOCAL void log_line(const char *s) {
    char *p = (char *)0x80003000;
    size_t n = 0;
    while (s[n] && n < 255) {
        p[n] = s[n];
        n++;
    }
    p[n] = 0;
    (void)sys(43, 0, 0);
}
LOCAL uint64_t mapped_id = ~0ULL, mapped_va;
LOCAL bool mapped_write;
LOCAL uint8_t *page(uint64_t id, bool write) {
    if (id == mapped_id && (!write || mapped_write))
        return (uint8_t *)mapped_va;
    if (mapped_id != ~0ULL && sys(41, mapped_va, 0))
        fail("page release");
    mapped_id = ~0ULL;
    uint64_t va = sys(40, id, write);
    if (va == ~0ULL)
        fail("SLS page capability unavailable");
    mapped_id = id;
    mapped_va = va;
    mapped_write = write;
    return (uint8_t *)va;
}
LOCAL void unmap(void) {
    if (mapped_id != ~0ULL) {
        if (sys(41, mapped_va, 0))
            fail("pager unpin");
        mapped_id = ~0ULL;
    }
}
LOCAL uint64_t file_bytes;
LOCAL void read_file(uint64_t offset, void *out, size_t n) {
    if (offset > file_bytes || n > file_bytes - offset)
        fail("GGUF file bounds");
    uint8_t *d = out;
    while (n) {
        size_t count = 4096 - (size_t)(offset & 4095);
        if (count > n)
            count = n;
        memcpy(d, page(CORTEX_MODEL + offset / 4096, false) + (offset & 4095), count);
        d += count;
        offset += count;
        n -= count;
    }
}
LOCAL uint32_t read32(uint64_t *at) {
    uint32_t x;
    read_file(*at, &x, 4);
    *at += 4;
    return x;
}
LOCAL uint64_t read64(uint64_t *at) {
    uint64_t x;
    read_file(*at, &x, 8);
    *at += 8;
    return x;
}
LOCAL bool equal(const char *a, const char *b) {
    unsigned i = 0;
    while (a[i] && a[i] == b[i])
        i++;
    return a[i] == b[i];
}
LOCAL void string(uint64_t *at, char *out, size_t cap) {
    uint64_t n = read64(at);
    if (n > file_bytes - *at)
        fail("GGUF string length");
    if (out) {
        if (n >= cap)
            fail("GGUF identifier length");
        read_file(*at, out, (size_t)n);
        out[n] = 0;
    }
    *at += n;
}
LOCAL void skip_value(uint64_t *at, unsigned type, unsigned depth) {
    static const unsigned widths[13] = {1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 1, 0, 0, 8, 8, 8};
    if (type >= 13 || depth > 4)
        fail("GGUF metadata type");
    if (type == 8) {
        string(at, (void *)0, 0);
        return;
    }
    if (type == 9) {
        unsigned subtype = read32(at);
        uint64_t n = read64(at);
        if (n > 16777216ULL || subtype == 9)
            fail("GGUF array bounds");
        for (uint64_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
            skip_value(at, subtype, depth + 1);
        return;
    }
    if (*at > file_bytes || widths[type] > file_bytes - *at)
        fail("GGUF scalar bounds");
    *at += widths[type];
}
typedef struct {
    char name[96];
    uint64_t offset, bytes;
    uint32_t columns, rows, type;
} tensor_t;
LOCAL tensor_t tensors[MAX_TENSORS];
LOCAL unsigned tensor_count;
typedef struct {
    unsigned dim, hidden, layers, heads, kv_heads, vocab, context;
    float epsilon, rope, rope_factor, rope_low, rope_high;
    unsigned rope_scaling, original_context;
} config_t;
LOCAL config_t cfg;
LOCAL bool simd;
LOCAL cortex_contract_t contracts[16];
LOCAL unsigned contract_count;
LOCAL uint64_t accepted_tokens, rejected_tokens;
LOCAL uint8_t model_hash[32];
LOCAL void gguf(void) {
    uint64_t at = 0;
    unsigned alignment = 32;
    if (read32(&at) != 0x46554747 || read32(&at) != 3)
        fail("GGUF v3 required");
    uint64_t count = read64(&at), metadata = read64(&at);
    if (!count || count > MAX_TENSORS || metadata > 1048576)
        fail("GGUF table limits");
    tensor_count = (unsigned)count;
    cfg.epsilon = 0.00001f;
    cfg.rope = 10000;
    cfg.rope_factor = 1;
    cfg.rope_low = 1;
    cfg.rope_high = 4;
    cfg.original_context = 8192;
    for (uint64_t i = 0; i < metadata; i++) {
        char name[192];
        string(&at, name, sizeof name);
        unsigned type = read32(&at);
        uint64_t start = at;
        if (equal(name, "general.architecture")) {
            char architecture[32];
            if (type != 8)
                fail("architecture metadata type");
            string(&at, architecture, sizeof architecture);
            if (!equal(architecture, "llama"))
                fail("GGUF architecture requires Llama tensors");
            continue;
        }
        if (equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.type")) {
            char method[32];
            if (type != 8)
                fail("RoPE scaling type");
            string(&at, method, sizeof method);
            if (equal(method, "none"))
                cfg.rope_scaling = 0;
            else if (equal(method, "linear"))
                cfg.rope_scaling = 1;
            else if (equal(method, "llama3"))
                cfg.rope_scaling = 2;
            else
                fail("unsupported RoPE scaling method");
            continue;
        }
        if (equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.factor") ||
            equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.low_freq_factor") ||
            equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.high_freq_factor")) {
            float value;
            if (type != 6)
                fail("RoPE scaling numeric type");
            read_file(at, &value, 4);
            at += 4;
            if (!finite(value) || value <= 0)
                fail("RoPE scaling range");
            if (equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.factor"))
                cfg.rope_factor = value;
            else if (equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.low_freq_factor"))
                cfg.rope_low = value;
            else
                cfg.rope_high = value;
            continue;
        }
        unsigned *field = (void *)0;
        if (equal(name, "llama.embedding_length"))
            field = &cfg.dim;
        if (equal(name, "llama.feed_forward_length"))
            field = &cfg.hidden;
        if (equal(name, "llama.block_count"))
            field = &cfg.layers;
        if (equal(name, "llama.attention.head_count"))
            field = &cfg.heads;
        if (equal(name, "llama.attention.head_count_kv"))
            field = &cfg.kv_heads;
        if (equal(name, "llama.context_length"))
            field = &cfg.context;
        if (equal(name, "llama.rope.scaling.original_context_length"))
            field = &cfg.original_context;
        if (equal(name, "general.alignment"))
            field = &alignment;
        if (field) {
            if (type != 4)
                fail("GGUF integer configuration type");
            *field = read32(&at);
            continue;
        }
        if (equal(name, "llama.attention.layer_norm_rms_epsilon") ||
            equal(name, "llama.rope.freq_base")) {
            if (type != 6)
                fail("GGUF float configuration type");
            float value;
            read_file(at, &value, 4);
            at += 4;
            if (!finite(value) || value <= 0)
                fail("GGUF float configuration");
            if (equal(name, "llama.rope.freq_base"))
                cfg.rope = value;
            else
                cfg.epsilon = value;
            continue;
        }
        at = start;
        skip_value(&at, type, 0);
    }
    if (cfg.rope < 1 || cfg.rope_high <= cfg.rope_low || !cfg.original_context)
        fail("RoPE scaling configuration");
    if (!cfg.kv_heads)
        cfg.kv_heads = cfg.heads;
    if (!cfg.dim || cfg.dim > MAX_DIM || !cfg.hidden || cfg.hidden > MAX_HIDDEN || !cfg.layers ||
        cfg.layers > 128 || !cfg.heads || cfg.heads > 128 || !cfg.kv_heads ||
        cfg.heads % cfg.kv_heads || cfg.dim % cfg.heads || (cfg.dim / cfg.heads) & 1 ||
        !cfg.context || cfg.context > 1048576 || !alignment || alignment > 4096 ||
        (alignment & (alignment - 1)))
        fail("GGUF model configuration");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < tensor_count; i++) {
        tensor_t *t = &tensors[i];
        string(&at, t->name, sizeof t->name);
        unsigned rank = read32(&at);
        if (!rank || rank > 2)
            fail("Llama tensor rank");
        uint64_t cols = read64(&at), rows = rank == 2 ? read64(&at) : 1;
        if (cols > MAX_HIDDEN || rows > MAX_VOCAB || !cols || !rows)
            fail("tensor shape bounds");
        t->columns = (unsigned)cols;
        t->rows = (unsigned)rows;
        t->type = read32(&at);
        t->offset = read64(&at);
        unsigned block = t->type == 8 ? 32 : (t->type == 12 || t->type == 14 ? 256 : 1),
                 bytes =
                     t->type == 8
                         ? 34
                         : (t->type == 12 ? 144 : (t->type == 14 ? 210 : (t->type == 0 ? 4 : 2)));
        if (t->type != 0 && t->type != 1 && t->type != 8 && t->type != 12 && t->type != 14)
            fail("unsupported GGUF tensor quantization");
        if (cols % block)
            fail("quantized row alignment");
        t->bytes = (cols * rows / block) * bytes;
    }
    at = (at + alignment - 1) & ~((uint64_t)alignment - 1);
    if (at > file_bytes)
        fail("GGUF aligned tensor area bounds");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < tensor_count; i++) {
        tensor_t *t = &tensors[i];
        if (t->offset > file_bytes - at || t->bytes > file_bytes - at - t->offset)
            fail("tensor data bounds");
        t->offset += at;
    }
}
LOCAL tensor_t *find(const char *name) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < tensor_count; i++)
        if (equal(tensors[i].name, name))
            return &tensors[i];
    return (void *)0;
}
LOCAL tensor_t *required(const char *name) {
    tensor_t *t = find(name);
    if (!t)
        fail("required Llama tensor missing");
    return t;
}
LOCAL tensor_t *layer(unsigned index, const char *suffix) {
    char name[96];
    unsigned n = 0;
    const char prefix[] = "blk.";
    memcpy(name, prefix, 4);
    n = 4;
    if (index >= 100)
        name[n++] = (char)('0' + index / 100);
    if (index >= 10)
        name[n++] = (char)('0' + index / 10 % 10);
    name[n++] = (char)('0' + index % 10);
    name[n++] = '.';
    for (unsigned i = 0; suffix[i]; i++)
        name[n++] = suffix[i];
    name[n] = 0;
    return required(name);
}
LOCAL unsigned block_values(unsigned type) {
    return type == 8 ? 32 : (type == 12 || type == 14 ? 256 : 1);
}
LOCAL unsigned block_bytes(unsigned type) {
    return type == 8 ? 34 : (type == 12 ? 144 : (type == 14 ? 210 : (type == 0 ? 4 : 2)));
}
LOCAL const uint8_t *weight_block(const tensor_t *t, uint64_t block, uint8_t temporary[210]) {
    uint64_t off = t->offset + block * block_bytes(t->type);
    size_t n = block_bytes(t->type);
    if ((off & 4095) + n <= 4096)
        return page(CORTEX_MODEL + off / 4096, false) + (off & 4095);
    read_file(off, temporary, n);
    return temporary;
}
LOCAL float weight(const tensor_t *t, uint64_t index) {
    uint8_t temporary[210];
    unsigned count = block_values(t->type);
    return cortex_dequant_value(t->type, weight_block(t, index / count, temporary),
                                (unsigned)(index % count));
}
LOCAL void matvec(float *out, const tensor_t *t, const float *input, unsigned rows,
                  unsigned columns) {
    if (t->rows != rows || t->columns != columns)
        fail("Llama matrix shape");
    unsigned block = block_values(t->type);
    for (unsigned base = 0; base < rows; base += 4)
        for (unsigned row = base; row < rows && row < base + 4; row++) {
            float value = 0;
            for (unsigned k = 0; k < columns; k += block) {
                uint8_t temporary[210];
                const uint8_t *q =
                    weight_block(t, ((uint64_t)row * columns + k) / block, temporary);
                float decoded[256] ALIGN_64;
                if (simd && (t->type == 8 || t->type == 12)) {
                    value += quant_dot_avx(t->type, q, input + k);
                    continue;
                }
                for (unsigned j = 0; j < block; j++)
                    decoded[j] = cortex_dequant_value(t->type, q, j);
                value += simd ? dot_avx(input + k, decoded, block)
                              : dot_scalar(input + k, decoded, block);
            }
            if (!finite(value))
                fail("nonfinite matrix output");
            out[row] = value;
        }
}
LOCAL void rms(float *out, const float *in, const tensor_t *scale) {
    if (scale->columns != cfg.dim || scale->rows != 1)
        fail("RMS shape");
    float sum = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < cfg.dim; i++)
        sum += in[i] * in[i];
    float inv = 1 / root(sum / (float)cfg.dim + cfg.epsilon);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < cfg.dim; i++)
        out[i] = in[i] * inv * weight(scale, i);
}
LOCAL float x[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64, xb[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64, q[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64, k[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64,
    v[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64, attention[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64, projection[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64,
    ffn[MAX_HIDDEN] ALIGN_64, gate[MAX_HIDDEN] ALIGN_64, logits[MAX_VOCAB] ALIGN_64;
LOCAL uint64_t kv_dimension(void) { return (uint64_t)cfg.dim * cfg.kv_heads / cfg.heads; }
LOCAL uint64_t layer_pages(void) { return (4ULL * kv_dimension() * cfg.context + 4095) / 4096; }
LOCAL void kv_write(unsigned layer_id, uint64_t position) {
    uint64_t dim = kv_dimension(), start = position * dim * 2;
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < dim * 2; j++) {
        uint64_t element = start + j;
        uint16_t h = half(j < dim ? k[j] : v[j - dim]);
        if ((h & 0x7c00) == 0x7c00)
            fail("FP16 KV overflow");
        uint8_t *p = page(CORTEX_KV + (uint64_t)layer_id * layer_pages() + element / 2048, true);
        memcpy(p + (element % 2048) * 2, &h, 2);
    }
}
LOCAL float kv_value(unsigned layer_id, uint64_t position, bool value, unsigned index) {
    uint64_t dim = kv_dimension(), element = position * dim * 2 + (value ? dim : 0) + index;
    uint16_t h;
    memcpy(&h,
           page(CORTEX_KV + (uint64_t)layer_id * layer_pages() + element / 2048, false) +
               (element % 2048) * 2,
           2);
    return cortex_fp16(h);
}
LOCAL void rope(float *vector, unsigned heads, uint64_t position) {
    tensor_t *factors = find("rope_freqs.weight");
    unsigned size = cfg.dim / cfg.heads;
    float logarithm_base = logarithm(cfg.rope);
    for (unsigned h = 0; h < heads; h++)
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < size; j += 2) {
            float frequency = exponential(-(float)j / (float)size * logarithm_base), s, c;
            if (factors) {
                if (factors->columns != size / 2 || factors->rows != 1)
                    fail("RoPE factor shape");
                float f = weight(factors, j / 2);
                if (!finite(f) || f <= 0)
                    fail("RoPE frequency factor");
                frequency /= f;
            } else if (cfg.rope_scaling == 1)
                frequency /= cfg.rope_factor;
            else if (cfg.rope_scaling == 2) {
                float wavelength = 2 * PI / frequency;
                if (wavelength > (float)cfg.original_context / cfg.rope_low)
                    frequency /= cfg.rope_factor;
                else if (wavelength > (float)cfg.original_context / cfg.rope_high) {
                    float smooth = ((float)cfg.original_context / wavelength - cfg.rope_low) /
                                   (cfg.rope_high - cfg.rope_low);
                    frequency = frequency * (smooth + (1 - smooth) / cfg.rope_factor);
                }
            }
            sincosine((float)position * frequency, &s, &c);
            float a = vector[h * size + j], b = vector[h * size + j + 1];
            vector[h * size + j] = a * c - b * s;
            vector[h * size + j + 1] = a * s + b * c;
        }
}
LOCAL float head_acc[MAX_DIM] ALIGN_64;
LOCAL void paged_attention(unsigned layer_id, uint64_t position) {
    unsigned size = cfg.dim / cfg.heads;
    float inv = 1 / root((float)size);
    for (unsigned head = 0; head < cfg.heads; head++) {
        float sum = 0, maximum = -3.402823466e38f;
        float *acc = head_acc;
        memset(acc, 0, size * sizeof(float));
        unsigned kv_head = head / (cfg.heads / cfg.kv_heads);
        /* Online softmax: no context-sized score buffer. K/V pages may be evicted
         * between every head/token; the block table is the SLS radix plus pager. */
        for (uint64_t t = 0; t <= position; t++) {
            float score = 0;
            for (unsigned j = 0; j < size; j++)
                score += q[head * size + j] * kv_value(layer_id, t, false, kv_head * size + j);
            score *= inv;
            float next = score > maximum ? score : maximum, old = exponential(maximum - next),
                  now = exponential(score - next);
            for (unsigned j = 0; j < size; j++)
                acc[j] = acc[j] * old + now * kv_value(layer_id, t, true, kv_head * size + j);
            sum = sum * old + now;
            maximum = next;
        }
        if (!finite(sum) || sum <= 0)
            fail("attention normalization");
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < size; j++)
            attention[head * size + j] = acc[j] / sum;
    }
}
LOCAL unsigned forward(unsigned token, uint64_t position) {
    tensor_t *embedding = required("token_embd.weight");
    if (embedding->columns != cfg.dim || token >= embedding->rows)
        fail("embedding token bounds");
    cfg.vocab = embedding->rows;
    for (unsigned j = 0; j < cfg.dim; j++)
        x[j] = weight(embedding, (uint64_t)token * cfg.dim + j);
    for (unsigned l = 0; l < cfg.layers; l++) {
        rms(xb, x, layer(l, "attn_norm.weight"));
        unsigned kv = (unsigned)kv_dimension();
        matvec(q, layer(l, "attn_q.weight"), xb, cfg.dim, cfg.dim);
        matvec(k, layer(l, "attn_k.weight"), xb, kv, cfg.dim);
        matvec(v, layer(l, "attn_v.weight"), xb, kv, cfg.dim);
        rope(q, cfg.heads, position);
        rope(k, cfg.kv_heads, position);
        kv_write(l, position);
        paged_attention(l, position);
        matvec(projection, layer(l, "attn_output.weight"), attention, cfg.dim, cfg.dim);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < cfg.dim; j++)
            x[j] += projection[j];
        rms(xb, x, layer(l, "ffn_norm.weight"));
        matvec(ffn, layer(l, "ffn_up.weight"), xb, cfg.hidden, cfg.dim);
        matvec(gate, layer(l, "ffn_gate.weight"), xb, cfg.hidden, cfg.dim);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < cfg.hidden; j++)
            ffn[j] *= gate[j] / (1 + exponential(-gate[j]));
        matvec(projection, layer(l, "ffn_down.weight"), ffn, cfg.dim, cfg.hidden);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < cfg.dim; j++)
            x[j] += projection[j];
    }
    rms(xb, x, required("output_norm.weight"));
    tensor_t *output = find("output.weight");
    if (!output)
        output = embedding;
    matvec(logits, output, xb, cfg.vocab, cfg.dim);
    if (contract_count) {
        rejected_tokens += cortex_symbolic_prune(logits, cfg.vocab, contracts, contract_count);
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < contract_count; i++)
            if (contracts[i].token < cfg.vocab && finite(logits[contracts[i].token]) &&
                !omega_cortex_contract(contracts[i].value)) {
                uint32_t neginf = 0xff800000U;
                memcpy(logits + contracts[i].token, &neginf, 4);
                rejected_tokens++;
            }
    }
    unsigned best = 0;
    for (unsigned j = 1; j < cfg.vocab; j++)
        if (logits[j] > logits[best])
            best = j;
    if (!finite(logits[best]))
        fail("no token satisfies symbolic contract");
    accepted_tokens++;
    return best;
}
LOCAL void native_synthesis(cortex_checkpoint_t *checkpoint) {
    uint8_t *certificate = (uint8_t *)0x80003000;
    uint64_t magic = BYTECODE_MAGIC, length = 35;
    omega_rational_t a, b = {0, 1}, got;
    if (!rational_make((int64_t)checkpoint->token, cfg.vocab, &a))
        fail("native neural candidate rational");
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < contract_count; i++)
        if (contracts[i].token == checkpoint->token)
            a = contracts[i].value;
    if (!omega_cortex_contract(a))
        fail("native candidate equivalence");
    memcpy(certificate, &magic, 8);
    memcpy(certificate + 8, &length, 8);
    certificate[16] = 1;
    memcpy(certificate + 17, &a, 16);
    certificate[33] = 1;
    memcpy(certificate + 34, &b, 16);
    certificate[50] = 2;
    certificate[51] = 0;
    length = 36;
    memcpy(certificate + 8, &length, 8);
    size_t bytes;
    if (sys(19, 0, 0) || !jit_compile(certificate, 52, (uint8_t *)JIT_VA, &bytes) ||
        sys(11, JIT_VA, bytes) || !((bool (*)(omega_rational_t *))JIT_VA)(&got) ||
        got.num != a.num || got.den != a.den)
        fail("cortex native rational synthesis");
    crypto_blake2b(checkpoint->jit_hash, 32, (void *)JIT_VA, bytes);
}
LOCAL void hash_kv(uint64_t position, uint8_t digest[32]) {
    crypto_blake2b_ctx hash;
    crypto_blake2b_init(&hash, 32);
    for (unsigned l = 0; l < cfg.layers; l++) {
        uint64_t bytes = position * kv_dimension() * 4;
        crypto_blake2b_update(&hash, (const uint8_t *)&l, sizeof l);
        crypto_blake2b_update(&hash, (const uint8_t *)&bytes, 8);
        for (uint64_t off = 0; off < bytes; off += 4096) {
            size_t n = bytes - off < 4096 ? (size_t)(bytes - off) : 4096;
            crypto_blake2b_update(
                &hash, page(CORTEX_KV + (uint64_t)l * layer_pages() + off / 4096, false), n);
        }
    }
    crypto_blake2b_final(&hash, digest);
}
/* Optional destructive workload in an unused KV namespace. It exercises the
 * same public page capabilities as attention; no special kernel allocator. */
LOCAL void pager_scale_test(unsigned pages) {
    if (!pages)
        return;
    if (pages > 32768 || layer_pages() * cfg.layers > 0x400000ULL)
        fail("pager stress namespace bounds");
    uint64_t base = CORTEX_KV + 0x400000ULL;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
        uint64_t *p = (uint64_t *)page(base + i, true);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 512; j++)
            p[j] = 0x8c7a350000000000ULL ^ ((uint64_t)i << 20) ^ j;
    }
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < pages; i++) {
        const uint64_t *p = (const uint64_t *)page(base + i, false);
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < 512; j++)
            if (p[j] != (0x8c7a350000000000ULL ^ ((uint64_t)i << 20) ^ j))
                fail("out-of-core page verification");
    }
    log_line("CORTEX out-of-core KV stress >64MiB data verified PASS");
}
LOCAL void vector_probe(unsigned role) {
    uint64_t expected[4] ALIGN_64 = {0x1234567800000000ULL + role, 0xfedcba9800000000ULL + role,
                                     0x2233445500000000ULL + role, 0x5544332200000000ULL + role},
                         got[4] ALIGN_64;
    uint64_t features = sys(44, 0, 0);
    bool avx = (features & 7) == 7;
    for (unsigned sample = 0; sample < 8; sample++) {
        if (avx)
            __asm__ volatile("vmovdqu %0,%%ymm15" ::"m"(expected) : "xmm15", "memory");
        else
            __asm__ volatile("movdqu %0,%%xmm15" ::"m"(expected) : "xmm15", "memory");
        /* Keep x87 state live as well; execute no floating C until captured. */
        __asm__ volatile("fld1" ::: "memory");
        for (volatile unsigned i = 0; i < 1000000; i++)
            __asm__ volatile("pause");
        (void)sys(0, 0, 0);
        (void)sys(46, 0, 0);
        if (avx)
            __asm__ volatile("vmovdqu %%ymm15,%0" : "=m"(got)::"memory");
        else
            __asm__ volatile("movdqu %%xmm15,%0" : "=m"(got)::"memory");
        double f;
        __asm__ volatile("fstpl %0" : "=m"(f)::"memory");
        if (f != 1.0)
            fail("x87 context corruption");
        for (unsigned j = 0; j < (avx ? 4U : 2U); j++)
            if (got[j] != expected[j])
                fail("SSE/AVX context corruption");
    }
    log_line(avx ? "CORTEX XSAVE x87/SSE/YMM integrity PASS"
                 : (features ? "CORTEX XSAVE x87/SSE integrity PASS"
                             : "CORTEX FXSAVE x87/SSE integrity PASS"));
}
void _start(void) {
    volatile uint64_t *data = (volatile uint64_t *)0x80002000;
    unsigned role = (unsigned)data[0];
    simd = vector_available();
    vector_probe(role);
    if (role == 8) {
        (void)sys(45, 0, 0);
        fail("probe exit returned");
    }
    log_line(simd ? "CORTEX Ring3 AVX2/FMA dispatch" : "CORTEX Ring3 scalar/SWAR dispatch");
    uint64_t meta = sys(40, CORTEX_META, 0);
    if (meta == ~0ULL) {
        log_line("CORTEX no GGUF provisioned; awaiting model pages");
        (void)sys(45, 0, 0);
        fail("cortex exit returned");
    }
    uint8_t header[1024];
    memcpy(header, (void *)meta, sizeof header);
    if (sys(41, meta, 0))
        fail("metadata unpin");
    const char domain[16] = "OMEGA-CORTEX-01";
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        if (header[i] != (uint8_t)domain[i])
            fail("cortex model descriptor");
    memcpy(&file_bytes, header + 16, 8);
    memcpy(model_hash, header + 24, 32);
    uint32_t steps, prompt_size;
    memcpy(&steps, header + 56, 4);
    memcpy(&prompt_size, header + 60, 4);
    if (!file_bytes || file_bytes > (CORTEX_KV - CORTEX_MODEL) * 4096 || !steps ||
        steps > 1048576 || prompt_size > 128)
        fail("model descriptor bounds");
    memcpy(&contract_count, header + 576, 4);
    if (contract_count > 16)
        fail("logical contract count");
    memcpy(contracts, header + 580, contract_count * sizeof *contracts);
    gguf();
    tensor_t *embedding = required("token_embd.weight");
    cfg.vocab = embedding->rows;
    if (cfg.vocab < 2 || cfg.vocab > MAX_VOCAB || layer_pages() * cfg.layers > 0x800000ULL)
        fail("model logical address capacity");
    cortex_checkpoint_t checkpoint;
    memset(&checkpoint, 0, sizeof checkpoint);
    uint64_t saved = sys(40, CORTEX_CHECKPOINT, 0);
    uint64_t position = 0;
    unsigned token = 1;
    if (saved != ~0ULL) {
        memcpy(&checkpoint, (void *)saved, sizeof checkpoint);
        (void)sys(41, saved, 0);
        if (sys(49, 0, 0) == 0) {
            cortex_checkpoint_t approved;
            memcpy(&approved, (void *)0x80003000, sizeof approved);
            if (approved.magic == CORTEX_MAGIC)
                checkpoint = approved;
        }
        if (checkpoint.magic != CORTEX_MAGIC ||
            crypto_verify32(checkpoint.model_hash, model_hash) || checkpoint.dim != cfg.dim ||
            checkpoint.context != cfg.context || checkpoint.position > cfg.context)
            fail("checkpoint model binding");
        uint8_t digest[32];
        hash_kv(checkpoint.position, digest);
        if (crypto_verify32(digest, checkpoint.kv_hash))
            fail("persisted KV hash mismatch");
        position = checkpoint.position;
        token = (unsigned)checkpoint.token;
        log_line("CORTEX restored SLS KV-cache hash PASS");
    }
    uint64_t end = data[30] ? data[30] : position + steps;
    if (end < position)
        end = position;
    if (end > cfg.context)
        end = cfg.context;
    for (; position < end; position++) {
        if (position < prompt_size)
            memcpy(&token, header + 64 + 4 * position, 4);
        token = forward(token, position);
    }
    bool computed = accepted_tokens != 0;
    checkpoint.magic = CORTEX_MAGIC;
    if (computed)
        checkpoint.generation++;
    checkpoint.position = position;
    checkpoint.token = token;
    checkpoint.model_bytes = file_bytes;
    checkpoint.kv_pages = layer_pages() * cfg.layers;
    checkpoint.logical_bytes = checkpoint.kv_pages * 4096;
    checkpoint.dim = cfg.dim;
    checkpoint.hidden = cfg.hidden;
    checkpoint.layers = cfg.layers;
    checkpoint.heads = cfg.heads;
    checkpoint.kv_heads = cfg.kv_heads;
    checkpoint.vocab = cfg.vocab;
    checkpoint.context = cfg.context;
    checkpoint.flags = simd ? 1 : 0;
    memcpy(checkpoint.model_hash, model_hash, 32);
    hash_kv(position, checkpoint.kv_hash);
    if (computed)
        crypto_blake2b(checkpoint.logit_hash, 32, (uint8_t *)logits, cfg.vocab * sizeof(float));
    checkpoint.rejected += rejected_tokens;
    checkpoint.accepted += accepted_tokens;
    native_synthesis(&checkpoint);
    uint32_t stress;
    memcpy(&stress, header + 1000, 4);
    pager_scale_test(stress);
    unmap();
    /* The kernel commits dirty KV pages and this descriptor in one CoW root.
     * Cluster publication later signs its content in the lineage manifest. */
    if (computed) {
        memset((void *)0x80003000, 0, 4096);
        memcpy((void *)0x80003000, logits, (cfg.vocab < 1024 ? cfg.vocab : 1024) * sizeof(float));
        if (sys(47, 0, 0))
            fail("logit checkpoint staging");
    }
    memcpy((void *)0x80003000, &checkpoint, sizeof checkpoint);
    if (sys(42, 0, 0))
        fail("cortex SLS checkpoint transaction");
    log_line("CORTEX GGUF inference + PagedAttention + symbolic pruning + native JIT PASS");
    (void)sys(45, 0, 0);
    fail("cortex exit returned");
}
#endif

ARQUIVO: user/omega/driver.c

#include "omega_value.h"
#include "bytecode.h"
#include "incubator.h"
static uint8_t arena[8*1024*1024] ALIGN_4K;
static size_t used;
uint64_t ov_gas;
const char *ov_input;
V ov_output;
static uint64_t syscall(uint64_t n,uint64_t a){uint64_t r;__asm__ volatile("syscall":"=a"(r):"a"(n),"D"(a):"rcx","r11","memory");return r;}
void *memcpy(void *d,const void *s,size_t n){uint8_t *a=d;const uint8_t *b=s;for(size_t i=0;i<n;i++)a[i]=b[i];return d;}
void *memset(void *p,int c,size_t n){uint8_t *b=p;for(size_t i=0;i<n;i++)b[i]=(uint8_t)c;return p;}
void *ov_alloc(size_t n){n=(n+7)&~(size_t)7;if(n>sizeof arena-used)omega_fail("Omega static arena exhausted");void *p=arena+used;used+=n;memset(p,0,n);return p;}
void omega_fail(const char *s){char *p=(char *)0x80003000;size_t n=0;while(s[n]&&n<96){p[n]=s[n];n++;}p[n]=0;(void)syscall(60,n);for(;;)__asm__ volatile("pause");}
static __attribute__((unused)) void emit(V nodes,int64_t id,uint8_t *out,size_t *n,unsigned depth){
 if(depth>24||id<0||(uint64_t)id>=nodes->n||*n>1000)omega_fail("Backend graph budget");
 V node=nodes->a[id],op=o_get(node,o_str("op")),args=o_get(node,o_str("args"));
 if(!ov_cmp(op->s,"num")){V value=o_number(o_get(node,o_str("v")));out[(*n)++]=1;memcpy(out+*n,&value->q,16);*n+=16;return;}
 if(!ov_cmp(op->s,"neg")){emit(nodes,o_long(args->a[0]),out,n,depth+1);out[(*n)++]=6;return;}
 if(args->n!=2)omega_fail("Scalar backend arity");
 emit(nodes,o_long(args->a[0]),out,n,depth+1);emit(nodes,o_long(args->a[1]),out,n,depth+1);
 if(op->n!=1)omega_fail("Scalar backend operation");
 switch(op->s[0]){case '+':out[(*n)++]=2;break;case '-':out[(*n)++]=3;break;case '*':out[(*n)++]=4;break;case '/':out[(*n)++]=5;break;default:omega_fail("Unsupported scalar backend");}
}
static V pair(const char *op,V a,V b){V x=o_list();o_push(x,o_str(op));o_push(x,a);if(b)o_push(x,b);return x;}
/* Finite PUCT port of omega_synth_mcts/search.py: exact tensor priors and
 * rewards, affine grammar a*x+b, explicit node/iteration budgets. */
static void tensor_mcts(int64_t *best_a,int64_t *best_b,unsigned *visited){
 struct Node {int parent,depth,a,b;unsigned visits;omega_rational_t reward,prior;} nodes[31];
 unsigned total=1;uint64_t seed=47;nodes[0]=(struct Node){-1,0,0,0,0,{0,1},{1,1}};
 omega_rational_t weights[2][3]={{{1,2},{1,3},{1,4}},{{1,3},{1,5},{1,6}}};
 for(unsigned iteration=0;iteration<192;iteration++){
  unsigned at=0,path[3]={0,0,0},length=1;
  while(nodes[at].depth<2){unsigned child=0;omega_rational_t best={-1,1};bool found=false;
   bool expanded=false;for(unsigned j=1;j<total;j++)if(nodes[j].parent==(int)at)expanded=true;
   if(!expanded){if(total+5>31)omega_fail("MCTS node budget");for(int k=-2;k<=2;k++){
    omega_rational_t features[3]={{k*k,1},{k<0?-k:k,1},{1,1}},prior={1,1},v;
    for(unsigned t=0;t<3;t++){if(!rational_mul(weights[nodes[at].depth][t],features[t],&v)||!rational_add(prior,v,&prior))omega_fail("Tensor prior arithmetic");}
    nodes[total++]=(struct Node){(int)at,nodes[at].depth+1,nodes[at].depth?nodes[at].a:k,k,0,{0,1},prior};
   }}
   for(unsigned j=1;j<total;j++)if(nodes[j].parent==(int)at){omega_rational_t mean={0,1},explore,score,factor;unsigned root=1;
    while((root+1)*(root+1)<=nodes[at].visits+1)root++;
    if(nodes[j].visits&&!rational_make(nodes[j].reward.num,nodes[j].reward.den*(int64_t)nodes[j].visits,&mean))omega_fail("MCTS mean");
    if(!rational_make(root,(int64_t)(nodes[j].visits+1),&factor)||!rational_mul(nodes[j].prior,factor,&explore)||!rational_add(mean,explore,&score))omega_fail("PUCT score");
    int cmp;if(!rational_cmp(score,best,&cmp))omega_fail("PUCT compare");
    seed=seed*6364136223846793005ULL+1;
    if(!found||cmp>0||(cmp==0&&(seed>>63))){best=score;child=j;found=true;}
   }
   if(!found)omega_fail("MCTS empty expansion");
   at=child;path[length++]=at;
  }
  int64_t loss=0;for(int64_t x=-2;x<=2;x++){int64_t delta=nodes[at].a*x+nodes[at].b-(2*x+1);loss+=delta<0?-delta:delta;}
  omega_rational_t reward={1,loss+1};
  for(unsigned j=0;j<length;j++){nodes[path[j]].visits++;if(!rational_add(nodes[path[j]].reward,reward,&nodes[path[j]].reward))omega_fail("MCTS reward");}
  if(!loss){*best_a=nodes[at].a;*best_b=nodes[at].b;*visited=iteration+1;return;}
 }
 omega_fail("MCTS finite budget exhausted");
}
unsigned omega_guided_form(unsigned cycle){
 /* All V objects from the preceding frontend/egraph call are ephemeral.
  * The durable pool contains copied scalar descriptors, never arena pointers. */
 used=0;ov_gas=0;int64_t a,b;unsigned iterations;tensor_mcts(&a,&b,&iterations);
 if(a!=2||b!=1||!iterations)omega_fail("Mutation PUCT contract");
 unsigned form=cycle<16?4:1+(cycle+(unsigned)(a+b))%4;
 V x=pair("const",o_int(7),0),y=pair("const",o_int(5),0),two=pair("const",o_int(2),0),expression;
 if(form==2)expression=pair("mul",pair("add",y,x),two);
 else if(form==3)expression=pair("add",pair("mul",x,two),pair("mul",y,two));
 else expression=pair("mul",pair("add",x,y),two);

}

#include "incubator.h"
extern void omega_fail(const char *s);
extern unsigned omega_guided_form(unsigned cycle);
static omega_organism_t organisms[INCUBATOR_SLOTS];
static uint64_t sys2(uint64_t n,uint64_t a,uint64_t b){uint64_t r;__asm__ volatile("syscall":"=a"(r):"a"(n),"D"(a),"S"(b):"rcx","r11","memory");return r;}
static uint64_t stamp(void){uint32_t l,h,aux;static unsigned supported;
 if(!supported){uint32_t a,b,c,d;__asm__ volatile("cpuid":"=a"(a),"=b"(b),"=c"(c),"=d"(d):"a"(0x80000001U),"c"(0));supported=(d&(1U<<27))?2:1;}
 if(supported==1){lfence();__asm__ volatile("rdtsc":"=a"(l),"=d"(h)::"memory");lfence();return ((uint64_t)h<<32)|l;}__asm__ volatile("rdtscp; lfence":"=a"(l),"=d"(h),"=c"(aux)::"memory");return ((uint64_t)h<<32)|l;}
static size_t literal(uint8_t *p,size_t n,int64_t v){omega_rational_t q={v,1};p[n++]=1;memcpy(p+n,&q,16);return n+16;}
static size_t expression(uint8_t *p,unsigned form){
 /* Typed ring rewrites: associativity, commutativity and neutral elimination.
  * The expanded ancestor and its folded extraction denote exactly 24. */
 size_t n=16;uint64_t magic=BYTECODE_MAGIC;memcpy(p,&magic,8);
 if(form==0){n=literal(p,n,24);for(unsigned i=0;i<20;i++){n=literal(p,n,0);p[n++]=2;}}
 else if(form==1){n=literal(p,n,7);n=literal(p,n,5);p[n++]=2;n=literal(p,n,2);p[n++]=4;}
 else if(form==2){n=literal(p,n,5);n=literal(p,n,7);p[n++]=2;n=literal(p,n,2);p[n++]=4;}
 else if(form==3){n=literal(p,n,7);n=literal(p,n,2);p[n++]=4;n=literal(p,n,5);n=literal(p,n,2);p[n++]=4;p[n++]=2;}
 else n=literal(p,n,24);
 p[n++]=0;uint64_t size=n-16;memcpy(p+8,&size,8);return n;
}
static size_t seal(size_t n){uint8_t *page=(uint8_t *)JIT_VA;size_t length;
 if(sys2(19,0,0)||!jit_compile((void *)0x80003000,n,page,&length)||sys2(11,JIT_VA,length))omega_fail("Native canonical JIT seal");
 return length;
}
static uint64_t measure(void){
 uint64_t best=~0ULL;omega_rational_t q;
 for(unsigned sample=0;sample<7;sample++){uint64_t begin=stamp();for(unsigned j=0;j<32;j++){if(!((bool (*)(omega_rational_t *))JIT_VA)(&q)||q.num!=24||q.den!=1)omega_fail("Native rational fitness");}uint64_t cost=stamp()-begin;if(cost<best)best=cost;}
 return best/32;
}
void incubator_run(void){
 uint8_t *certificate=(uint8_t *)0x80003000;volatile uint64_t *data=(volatile uint64_t *)0x80002000;
 static unsigned round,total_promotions,total_rejected;
 unsigned promotions=0,rejected=0;uint64_t baseline_native,baseline_reference;size_t n=expression(certificate,1);(void)seal(n);
 baseline_native=measure();omega_rational_t q;uint64_t begin=stamp();for(unsigned i=0;i<256;i++){compiler_barrier();if(!bytecode_run(certificate,n,&q))omega_fail("Reference benchmark");}baseline_reference=(stamp()-begin)/256;
 if(baseline_native>=baseline_reference)omega_fail("Native benchmark did not improve");
 if(!round)for(unsigned i=0;i<INCUBATOR_SLOTS;i++){n=expression(certificate,0);size_t length=seal(n);organisms[i]=(omega_organism_t){i+1,0,measure(),length,{24,1},"((7+5)*2)+0 [expanded ancestor]"};}
 for(unsigned cycle=0;cycle<50;cycle++){
  unsigned slot=cycle%INCUBATOR_SLOTS;omega_organism_t *ancestor=&organisms[slot];
  n=expression(certificate,omega_guided_form(cycle));data[29]++;size_t length=seal(n);uint64_t cycles=measure();
  /* Strict conjunction: equal or smaller code AND strictly fewer measured
   * cycles. No promotion is manufactured when timing is tied or noisy. */
  if(length<=ancestor->bytes&&cycles<ancestor->cycles){ancestor->generation++;ancestor->bytes=length;ancestor->cycles=cycles;memset(ancestor->genome,0,sizeof ancestor->genome);memcpy(ancestor->genome,"tensor result = 24; mostrar result;",35);promotions++;}
 }
 /* Fault containment exercises a legitimate audited store across the SLS
  * capability boundary. First store dirties the page; second triggers #PF. */
 n=expression(certificate,4);(void)seal(n);
 uint64_t prior=*(volatile uint64_t *)0x80004ff8;
 if(incubator_call((void *)JIT_VA,(omega_rational_t *)0x80004ff8)||*(volatile uint64_t *)0x80004ff8!=prior)omega_fail("Native fault checkpoint rollback");
 rejected++;
 if(sys2(19,0,0))omega_fail("JIT reset");
 size_t length;if(!jit_compile(certificate,n,(uint8_t *)JIT_VA,&length))omega_fail("JIT audit fixture");
 ((uint8_t *)JIT_VA)[0]=0xf4;if(sys2(11,JIT_VA,length)!=~0ULL)omega_fail("Privileged opcode admitted");
 rejected++;
 /* Ill-typed and undefined rational transitions fail admission, before CPU. */
 n=16;uint64_t magic=BYTECODE_MAGIC;memcpy(certificate,&magic,8);n=literal(certificate,n,1);n=literal(certificate,n,0);certificate[n++]=5;certificate[n++]=0;uint64_t bytes=n-16;memcpy(certificate+8,&bytes,8);
 if(jit_compile(certificate,n,(uint8_t *)JIT_VA,&length))omega_fail("Division zero admitted");
 rejected++;
 n=expression(certificate,4);(void)seal(n);
 if(sys2(16,0,0)!=15)omega_fail("Sixteen process spawn");
 while(sys2(17,0,0))__asm__ volatile("pause");
 if(!promotions&&!round)omega_fail("No measured Pareto promotion");
 memset(certificate,0,4096);memcpy(certificate,"OMEGA-LINEAGE-V4",16);memcpy(certificate+16,organisms,sizeof organisms);
 total_promotions+=promotions;total_rejected+=rejected;round++;
 data[24]=baseline_native;data[25]=baseline_reference;data[26]=50ULL*round;data[27]=total_promotions;data[28]=total_rejected;
 if(sys2(20,0,0)||sys2(21,0,0))omega_fail("Incubator nomination");
}
/* Save the ELF continuation before entering native code. On a trapped native
 * fault the kernel restores this exact stack/register snapshot and rolls SLS
 * back, then returns false at the same trusted continuation. */
__asm__(".text\n.global incubator_call\nincubator_call:\n"
"pushq %rbp\npushq %rbx\npushq %r12\npushq %r13\npushq %r14\npushq %r15\nsubq $8,%rsp\n"
"movq %rdi,%r12\nmovq %rsi,%r13\nleaq 1f(%rip),%rdi\nmovq %rsp,%rsi\nmovq $12,%rax\nsyscall\n"
"movq %r13,%rdi\ncall *%r12\n"
"1:\nmovq %rax,%r14\nmovq $13,%rax\nsyscall\nmovq %r14,%rax\n"
"addq $8,%rsp\npopq %r15\npopq %r14\npopq %r13\npopq %r12\npopq %rbx\npopq %rbp\nret\n");

"""Provision three pinned identities offline. Never include these initrds in bundles."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519 import X25519PrivateKey
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PrivateKey

def provision(directory,burst_ticks=0):
    directory.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    private=[(os.urandom(32),os.urandom(32)) for _ in range(3)]
    members=b''.join(struct.pack('<IIH6x32s32s',i+1,int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(f'10.{21+i}.0.2')),40000,
        X25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(x).public_key().public_bytes_raw(),
        Ed25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(ed).public_key().public_bytes_raw()) for i,(x,ed) in enumerate(private))
    identity=hashlib.blake2b(members,digest_size=32).digest();paths=[]
    for i,(x,ed) in enumerate(private):
        header=struct.pack('<8sIIIIQ32s32s32s',b'OMCLUST4',400,i,0xffffff00,int(ipaddress.IPv4Address(f'10.{21+i}.0.1')),burst_ticks,x,ed,identity)
        body=header+members;assert len(body)==368
        path=directory/f'node-{i+1}.conf';fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
        with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:stream.write(body+hashlib.blake2b(body,digest_size=32).digest())
        paths.append(path)
    return paths
if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--output-dir',type=Path,required=True);args=parser.parse_args()
    provision(args.output_dir);print('Three private boot modules saved with mode 0600; no private keys printed.')

"""Provision an existing GGUF into a NEW SLS image, streaming 4-KiB pages.
No model is downloaded or silently replaced. Private images are never bundled.
"""
import argparse,hashlib,os,struct,json
from pathlib import Path
META=0x1000;MODEL=0x2000
POLY=0x42F0E1EBA9EA3693;MASK=(1<<64)-1
TABLE=[]
for i in range(256):
    c=i<<56
    for _ in range(8):c=((c<<1)^(POLY if c>>63 else 0))&MASK
    TABLE.append(c)
def crc(data):
    c=0
    for b in data:c=TABLE[(c>>56)^b]^((c<<8)&MASK)
    return c

def provision(gguf,image,size,steps,prompt,contracts=(),stress_pages=0):
    length=gguf.stat().st_size
    if not 0<length<(0x800000-MODEL)*4096:raise ValueError('GGUF exceeds SLS model namespace')
    if size<4*length+1024*1024:raise ValueError('Need room for two SLS semispaces and transaction reserve')
    if not 0<steps<=1048576 or len(prompt)>128 or any(not 0<=x<262144 for x in prompt):raise ValueError('Invalid token schedule')
    with gguf.open('rb') as source:
        if source.read(8)!=b'GGUF\x03\0\0\0':raise ValueError('Expected a GGUF v3 file')
        source.seek(0);digest=hashlib.blake2b(digest_size=32)
        while block:=source.read(1024*1024):digest.update(block)
    fd=os.open(image,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd,'r+b') as disk:
            disk.truncate(size);cursor=8;leaves={}
            def append(data):
                nonlocal cursor
                assert len(data)==4096
                if (cursor+8)*512>size//2:raise ValueError('Live pages exceed one semispace')
                disk.seek(cursor*512);disk.write(data);entry=(cursor,crc(data));cursor+=8;return entry
            def put(index,data):
                leaf=leaves.setdefault(index>>8,[0]*512);leaf[(index&255)*2:(index&255)*2+2]=append(data)
            header=bytearray(4096);header[:16]=b'OMEGA-CORTEX-01\0';struct.pack_into('<Q32sII',header,16,length,digest.digest(),steps,len(prompt))
            for i,t in enumerate(prompt):struct.pack_into('<I',header,64+i*4,t)
            if len(contracts)>16:raise ValueError("At most 16 explicit logical token contracts")
            struct.pack_into("<I",header,576,len(contracts))
            for i,(token,num,den) in enumerate(contracts):struct.pack_into("<IIqq",header,580+24*i,token,0,num,den)
            if not 0<=stress_pages<=32768:raise ValueError("Pager stress page count")
            struct.pack_into("<I",header,1000,stress_pages)
            put(META,header)
            with gguf.open('rb') as source:
                index=MODEL
                while data:=source.read(4096):put(index,data.ljust(4096,b'\0'));index+=1
            directories={}
            for prefix,leaf in sorted(leaves.items()):
                node=directories.setdefault(prefix>>8,[0]*512);node[(prefix&255)*2:(prefix&255)*2+2]=append(struct.pack('<512Q',*leaf))
            root=[0]*512
            for i,node in sorted(directories.items()):root[i*2:i*2+2]=append(struct.pack('<512Q',*node))
            sector,hash_value=append(struct.pack('<512Q',*root));superblock=bytearray(512)
            struct.pack_into('<7Q',superblock,0,0x324f4d454741534c,1,sector,hash_value,cursor,0,3);struct.pack_into('<Q',superblock,40,crc(superblock))
            for slot in [0,1]:disk.seek(slot*512);disk.write(superblock)
            disk.flush();os.fsync(disk.fileno())
    except BaseException:
        image.unlink(missing_ok=True);raise
    return digest.digest()
if __name__=='__main__':
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('gguf',type=Path);p.add_argument('image',type=Path);p.add_argument('--size-mib',type=int,default=4096);p.add_argument('--steps',type=int,default=1);p.add_argument('--prompt',default='1');p.add_argument('--contracts',type=Path);a=p.parse_args()
    rules=[] if a.contracts is None else [(x['token'],x['num'],x['den']) for x in json.loads(a.contracts.read_text())]
    provision(a.gguf,a.image,a.size_mib*1024*1024,a.steps,[int(x) for x in a.prompt.split(',') if x],rules);print('GGUF provisioned in new CoW SLS image; existing images were not overwritten.')

"""Offline X25519 peer provisioning. Private material is never printed."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import ipaddress
import os
from pathlib import Path
import struct
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519 import X25519PrivateKey

def create(path,data,mode):
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,mode)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as stream:stream.write(data)

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
sub=parser.add_subparsers(dest='command',required=True)
k=sub.add_parser('keygen');k.add_argument('--private',type=Path,required=True);k.add_argument('--public',type=Path,required=True)
c=sub.add_parser('config')
for option in ['private-file','peer-public-file','output']:c.add_argument('--'+option,type=Path,required=True)
for option in ['local-ip','peer-ip','gateway']:c.add_argument('--'+option,required=True)
c.add_argument('--prefix',type=int,default=24);c.add_argument('--local-port',type=int,default=40000);c.add_argument('--peer-port',type=int,default=40000)
a=parser.parse_args()
if a.command=='keygen':
    if a.private.exists() or a.public.exists():raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite an existing identity')
    private=os.urandom(32);public=X25519PrivateKey.from_private_bytes(private).public_key().public_bytes_raw()
    create(a.private,private,0o600);create(a.public,public,0o644)
else:
    secret=a.private_file.read_bytes();public=a.peer_public_file.read_bytes()
    if len(secret)!=32 or len(public)!=32:raise SystemExit('X25519 raw key files must contain exactly 32 bytes')
    if not 0<=a.prefix<=32 or not 1<=a.local_port<=65535 or not 1<=a.peer_port<=65535:raise SystemExit('Invalid prefix or port')
    local=ipaddress.IPv4Address(a.local_ip);peer=ipaddress.IPv4Address(a.peer_ip);gateway=ipaddress.IPv4Address(a.gateway)
    network=ipaddress.IPv4Network(f'{local}/{a.prefix}',strict=False)
    if local==peer or local.is_multicast or peer.is_multicast or local.is_unspecified or peer.is_unspecified:raise SystemExit('Unicast distinct peer endpoints required')
    if peer not in network and (gateway not in network or gateway.is_unspecified):raise SystemExit('Off-subnet peer requires a reachable gateway')
    body=struct.pack('<8sI4I2H32s32s',b'OMNETV3\0',128,int(local),int(peer),int(gateway),int(network.netmask),a.local_port,a.peer_port,secret,public)
    create(a.output,body+hashlib.blake2b(body,digest_size=32).digest(),0o600)
print('Provisioning files saved; private material was not printed.')

# Validação do Cortex — 2026-11-06

Comandos executados neste ambiente com GCC 14.2 e QEMU 10.0.13/TCG:

```sh
make clean
make -j4
make test-host
make test QEMU=/workspace/tools/bin/qemu-system-x86_64
```

Kernel, compilador e `build/cortex.elf` foram linkados sem libc e sem símbolos
externos indefinidos (`nm -u`). O build mantém C99/O3/LTO e
`-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic`. O kernel permanece sem uso de SIMD.

## Provas funcionais novas

- Todas as 65.536 representações FP16 foram confrontadas com a conversão
  independente do Python, incluindo subnormais, infinitos e NaNs.
- GEMM int8 escalar/SWAR e AVX2 foi comparado exatamente com NumPy int64,
  em matrizes não múltiplas dos tiles e com valores extremos assinados.
- Q8_0, Q4_K e Q6_K foram confrontados com decodificação independente.
- Seno em argumentos até ±1.000.000 e exponencial foram comparados com libm
  do host; a libm não participa dos ELFs freestanding.
- Inferência Llama completa foi executada em Q8/AVX2, Q4_K+Q6_K/AVX2 e
  Q4_K+Q6_K/escalar. Os perfis também cobrem RoPE normal, Llama 3 e linear.
  Logits mascarados, próximo token e K/V FP16 foram comparados a uma segunda
  implementação NumPy. As VMs desses ensaios possuem 64 MiB de RAM.
- Cada configuração reserva 1 GiB de KV lógico, executa posições 0–7,
  reinicia e continua até a posição 16 após conferir o hash do prefixo.
  O teste diferencia capacidade lógica de dados efetivamente escritos.
- O ensaio de escala grava e relê 17.000 páginas, totalizando 69.632.000
  bytes de payload, mais do que toda a RAM de uma VM de 64 MiB. São verificados
  todos os 512 words de cada página. Resultado: pico de 64 frames, 17.002
  escritas, 34.270 evictions e compactação real do SLS. Uma execução observada levou
  52,7 s nesse ambiente; não é uma garantia de throughput físico.
- Dois processos conservam padrões x87 e XMM/YMM diferentes através de
  syscalls, yield e preempção de hardware. Há execução em CPU sem XSAVE/AVX
  para exercitar FXSAVE/FXRSTOR e fallback escalar.
- Um GGUF com configuração inválida é colocado em quarentena; o kernel
  continua e não publica um checkpoint cognitivo desse modelo.
- O candidato racional selecionado passa pelo e-graph original, é emitido
  como código nativo, selado pela syscall 11 e executado diretamente.

## Persistência distribuída

Três nós roteados recebem o mesmo GGUF. O manifesto assinado inclui o descritor
Cortex, com hashes de modelo, prefixo KV, logits e função JIT. Antes de votar ou
instalar um certificado, cada nó verifica o prefixo no seu SLS; um nó atrasado
executa até a posição solicitada. O ensaio cobre líder isolado, recuperação de
proposta não publicada, SIGKILL de seguidor antes/depois de publicar e dois epochs.

A política é maioria assinada 2/3 com líder fixo honesto. Não é BFT geral e não
há eleição de líder. Pesos ausentes não são transferidos automaticamente.

## Limites da evidência

Os pesos do ensaio são fixtures numéricas GGUF, identificadas como tal. Não há
alegação de qualidade linguística de um modelo treinado. O motor aceita pesos
Llama GGUF externos nos formatos/limites descritos em docs/CORTEX.md. O teste
não demonstra bilhões de parâmetros nem contexto de um milhão de tokens
inteiramente inferido; demonstra o caminho completo, endereçamento paginado,
consumo físico limitado e backing real além da capacidade da RAM.

A poda lógica vale para os contratos explícitos associados a IDs de token.
Não é prova da veracidade de qualquer resposta em linguagem natural.

# Contratos físicos do Cortex

## Imagens e isolamento

O novo ELF é assinado pela mesma autoridade de desenvolvimento dos demais
processos. O loader valida seus segmentos e cria CR3, stack e dados privados.
Os processos 8 e 9 exercitam padrões x87/XMM/YMM distintos através de syscalls,
yield e interrupções LAPIC. O teste também executa CPUs sem XSAVE/AVX.

XSAVE usa o formato padrão, máscara XCR0=7 quando AVX existe, ou x87/SSE
quando apenas estes estados existem. CPUID.0Dh confirma que a área cabe em
832 bytes. O fallback usa os 512 bytes FXSAVE. Cada área tem alinhamento 64.
O estado é salvo na entrada de syscall/interrupção e restaurado para a tarefa
selecionada antes do retorno. O kernel não utiliza registradores vetoriais.
AVX-512 não é habilitado; CPUs SMP com estados incompatíveis são recusadas.

O loader agora fornece a entrada com alinhamento de pilha SysV e uma posição
válida para o endereço de retorno sintético. A desmontagem de espaços mortos
usa um bitmap físico fixo para liberar também ELFs grandes sem duplicar aliases.

## GGUF e operações

O leitor suporta GGUF v3 com arquitetura Llama e tensores rank 1/2. Os limites
configuráveis da implementação atual são dimensão 8192, FFN 32768, 128 camadas,
128 heads, vocabulário 262144 e contexto 1048576. Há limites de capacidade de
disco e de namespace além destes limites de forma. Não se aloca KV na BSS.

O caminho de inferência inclui embedding, RMSNorm, projeções Q/K/V, GQA, RoPE,
atenção causal com softmax online, projeção residual, SwiGLU e output norm/logits.
RoPE aceita frequência base, fatores de tensor, escala linear e Llama 3;
formas como YaRN não são silenciosamente interpretadas como RoPE padrão.

Q8_0 usa FP16+32 int8; Q4_K usa os campos d/dmin, escalas/mins de seis bits e
nibbles de blocos 256; Q6_K usa low/high bits e escalas assinadas. Q4_K_M é uma
receita de mistura Q4_K/Q6_K, não um tipo de bloco único. F32/F16 são suportados
para normas e demais tensores. Formatos desconhecidos falham fechado.

A deserialização não materializa uma cópia densa do modelo. O bloco é lido na
página SLS; apenas blocos que cruzam uma fronteira são reunidos num temporário
limitado a 210 bytes. Q8 e Q4 têm desquantização AVX em registradores fundida
com FMA. Q6 usa um painel temporário limitado a 256 floats. O GEMM int8 público
aceita M/N/K, usa painéis 4×32×256 e acumula em int64 sem saturação intermediária.
O fallback neural calcula em FP32; a aritmética racional pertence ao árbitro.

Não há BLAS, CUDA, libm, tokenizer geral, treinamento ou modelos de arquitetura
MoE. Seno/exp/raiz são implementações locais aproximadas para inferência FP32;
correção racional exata não transforma operações neurais em matemática exata.
Não há alegação de 90% dos FLOPS de hardware físico.

## Páginas e atomicidade

O SLS mantém seu radix de três níveis, com 2^24 páginas lógicas (64 GiB). A nova
API de I/O lógico não exige uma entrada RAM por página: a árvore em disco é a
tabela de backing. Pesos ocupam a região lógica abaixo de 32 GiB; KV ocupa a
segunda metade. A forma do modelo define os strides de camada e token.

O pager tem 64 descritores residentes com frame, ID lógico, idade LRU, pin e
permissão. As capacidades são mapeadas na janela 0xa0000000, sempre NX. Pesos
são somente leitura. Acessos são adquiridos/liberados explicitamente por syscall;
não se transforma qualquer #PF em I/O de disco implícito. Uma falta fora dessas
capacidades continua sujeita à quarentena do runtime.

Antes de reutilizar um frame, o pager persiste a página suja por VirtIO e revoga
a capacidade anterior. Dirty bits são preservados nos hits e invalidados após
commit. Upgrades RO→RW invalidam TLB. A reserva de GC considera a quantidade de
páginas de uma transação do pager, além do conjunto residente antigo.
O driver mantém um prazo limitado de 120 bilhões de TSC ticks para conclusão
de I/O/FLUSH, com diagnóstico de índices da fila. Um timeout retém a propriedade
dos buffers DMA e falha fechado; não há reenvio que possa duplicar uma escrita.

A KV é append-only por posição. Evictions podem tornar duráveis páginas de
trabalho antes de publicar uma nova posição; não alteram o prefixo já aprovado.
O checkpoint final publica, na mesma raiz CoW, os frames sujos, um descritor de
256 bytes e uma página diagnóstica com os primeiros 1024 logits. O descritor
contém forma, posição, próximo token e hashes BLAKE2b de modelo, prefixo KV,
logits completos e função JIT. Reboot confere o prefixo antes de continuar.

A memória residente do pager é constante, mas atenção causal ainda lê o passado.
Contextos longos em disco podem ser lentos. O conjunto vivo deve caber num
semispace; GC não cria capacidade infinita. O formato não promete execução
instantânea após ligar a máquina nem preservação de RAM sem energia.

## Contratos simbólicos e JIT

As regras de token são fornecidas explicitamente. O árbitro testa racionais
canônicos, overflow e q²≤1, depois consulta o e-graph original para a equivalência
polinomial da transição. A máscara é aplicada aos logits reais antes de argmax.
Sem regra válida, a seleção falha, em vez de fabricar um token.

O candidato aceito dá origem a uma expressão racional, passada ao encoder
existente. A syscall 11 valida toda a página canônica, sela RW+NX→RO+X e protege
também o alias físico. O resultado nativo é confrontado com o racional esperado;
o hash da função passa ao checkpoint. O whitelist do JIT não foi relaxado.

Essas garantias abrangem a linguagem de contratos definida. Não provam que uma
frase em linguagem natural é verdadeira, que um prompt é benigno ou que o kernel
inteiro foi verificado por Lean.

## Quórum e retomada

O descritor Cortex cabe na parte livre do manifesto V4; a assinatura de epoch
cobre seus hashes. Antes de votar ou instalar um certificado, o nó confere o
modelo local e recalcula o hash do prefixo KV no seu próprio SLS. Se atrasado,
executa o motor até a posição solicitada. Pesos devem ser provisionados nos três
nós; não há transferência automática de um modelo ausente.

No boot de cluster, o motor prefere a posição/token do último certificado
publicado, em vez de assumir que qualquer checkpoint local de trabalho foi
aprovado. O líder também retoma sua proposta durável após SIGKILL. Dados novos
podem estar em disco sem estarem publicados como estado do cluster.

A política continua sendo maioria assinada 2/3 com líder fixo honesto, não BFT
geral. Não existe eleição. Inferência deve produzir o mesmo prefixo nos votantes;
uma divergência numérica ou de pesos impede o voto. A cadência entre bursts
é configurável no módulo de provisionamento; os testes de quórum usam 60 bilhões de
TSC ticks para dar tempo à auditoria/reboots enquanto o serviço permanece ativo.

## Evidência de escala

`tests/cortex_scale.py` grava e relê 17.000 páginas (69.632.000 bytes), com
canários determinísticos verificados em todos os 512 words de cada página.
A VM possui 64 MiB de RAM; o PMM continua limitado a 64 MiB. O mesmo caminho
de aquisição de páginas usado pela atenção atingiu 64 frames residentes,
34.335 leituras, 17.002 escritas e 34.270 evictions no ensaio inicial. O SLS
compactou o log em semispaces durante o trabalho. Não é apenas uma reserva
lógica esparsa: mais de 64 MiB de payload foram efetivamente transferidos.

O workload é opcional e ocupa uma faixa KV não usada pela forma do modelo;
é ativado somente pelo descritor de teste. Em inferência normal esse custo
não existe. O tempo não é uma garantia de throughput de processador físico.
