modulo egraph_engine;
importar "../ciencia/core/exato.omega" como u;
importar "algebra.omega" como a;
exportar execute;

# Finite e-graph with union-find, congruence rebuilding, guarded ring rewrites,
# cost extraction and independent sparse-polynomial equivalence checking.
# Saturation can be exponential; hitting a budget is reported, not called optimal.
funcao root(g,id) {
  var p=g["parent"];
  enquanto(p[id]!=id) { put(p,id,p[p[id]]); id=p[id]; }
  retornar id;
}
funcao merge(g,x,y,rule) {
  se(x<0||y<0) { retornar 0; }
  var rx=root(g,x); var ry=root(g,y);
  se(rx==ry) { retornar 0; }
  se(rx>ry) { var t=rx; rx=ry; ry=t; }
  put(g["parent"],ry,rx); push(g["ledger"],[rule,x,y]); retornar 1;
}
funcao intern(g,op,payload,children) {
  var canonical=[]; var j=0;
  enquanto(j<len(children)) { push(canonical,root(g,children[j])); j=j+1; }
  var nodes=g["nodes"]; var i=0;
  enquanto(i<len(nodes)) {
    se(nodes[i][0]==op&&nodes[i][1]==payload&&len(nodes[i][2])==len(canonical)) {
      var equal=1; j=0;
      enquanto(j<len(canonical)) { se(root(g,nodes[i][2][j])!=canonical[j]) { equal=0; } j=j+1; }
      se(equal) { retornar i; }
    }
    i=i+1;
  }
  se(len(nodes)>=g["limit"]) { put(g,"limited",1); retornar -1; }
  var id=len(nodes); push(nodes,[op,payload,canonical]); push(g["parent"],id); retornar id;
}
funcao ingest(g,ast,variables,depth,meter) {
  put(meter,0,meter[0]+1);
  se(depth>24||meter[0]>128||!islist(ast)||len(ast)<1) { fail("Egraph input AST budget"); }
  var op=ast[0]; var id=-1;
  se(op=="const"&&len(ast)==2) { id=intern(g,op,u::val(ast[1]),[]); }
  senao {
    se(op=="var"&&len(ast)==2) { id=intern(g,op,u::integer(u::val(ast[1]),0,variables-1),[]); }
    senao {
      se((op!="add"&&op!="mul")||len(ast)!=3) { fail("Egraph supports const, var, add, mul with exact arity"); }
      var left=ingest(g,ast[1],variables,depth+1,meter); var right=ingest(g,ast[2],variables,depth+1,meter);
      id=intern(g,op,0,[left,right]);
    }
  }
  se(id<0) { fail("Input exceeds egraph node capacity"); }
  retornar id;
}
funcao matching(g,id,op) {
  var i=0;
  enquanto(i<len(g["nodes"])) {
    se(root(g,i)==root(g,id)&&g["nodes"][i][0]==op) { retornar i; } i=i+1;
  }
  retornar -1;
}
funcao rebuild(g) {
  var changed=0; var i=0;
  enquanto(i<len(g["nodes"])) {
    var node=g["nodes"][i]; var j=0;
    enquanto(j<i) {
      var other=g["nodes"][j];
      se(node[0]==other[0]&&node[1]==other[1]&&len(node[2])==len(other[2])) {
        var equal=1; var k=0;
        enquanto(k<len(node[2])) { se(root(g,node[2][k])!=root(g,other[2][k])) { equal=0; } k=k+1; }
        se(equal) { changed=changed+merge(g,i,j,"congruence"); }
      }
      j=j+1;
    }
    i=i+1;
  }
  retornar changed;
}
funcao rewrite(g,id) {
  var node=g["nodes"][id]; var op=node[0]; var changed=0;
  se(op!="add"&&op!="mul") { retornar 0; }
  var x=node[2][0]; var y=node[2][1]; var xc=matching(g,x,"const"); var yc=matching(g,y,"const");
  se(xc>=0&&yc>=0) {
    var value=g["nodes"][xc][1]+g["nodes"][yc][1];
    se(op=="mul") { value=g["nodes"][xc][1]*g["nodes"][yc][1]; }
    changed=changed+merge(g,id,intern(g,"const",u::check(value),[]),"constant-fold");
  }
  se(yc>=0) {
    var value=g["nodes"][yc][1];
    se((op=="add"&&value==0)||(op=="mul"&&value==1)) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,x,"identity"); }
    se(op=="mul"&&value==0) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,y,"annihilator"); }
  }
  se(xc>=0) {
    var value=g["nodes"][xc][1];
    se((op=="add"&&value==0)||(op=="mul"&&value==1)) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,y,"identity"); }
    se(op=="mul"&&value==0) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,x,"annihilator"); }
  }
  changed=changed+merge(g,id,intern(g,op,0,[y,x]),"commute");
  var nested=matching(g,x,op);
  se(nested>=0) {
    var children=g["nodes"][nested][2]; var inner=intern(g,op,0,[children[1],y]);
    se(inner>=0) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,intern(g,op,0,[children[0],inner]),"associate"); }
  }
  se(op=="mul") {
    var sum=matching(g,y,"add");
    se(sum>=0) {
      var children=g["nodes"][sum][2]; var left=intern(g,"mul",0,[x,children[0]]); var right=intern(g,"mul",0,[x,children[1]]);
      se(left>=0&&right>=0) { changed=changed+merge(g,id,intern(g,"add",0,[left,right]),"distribute"); }
    }
  }
  retornar changed;
}
funcao extracted(g,id,best,depth) {
  se(depth>128) { fail("Egraph extraction depth budget"); }
  var node=g["nodes"][best[root(g,id)]];
  se(node[0]=="const"||node[0]=="var") { retornar [node[0],node[1]]; }
  retornar [node[0],extracted(g,node[2][0],best,depth+1),extracted(g,node[2][1],best,depth+1)];
}
funcao as_polynomial(ast,n) {
  se(ast[0]=="const") { retornar a::poly_const(u::val(ast[1]),n); }
  se(ast[0]=="var") { retornar a::poly_var(u::val(ast[1]),n); }
  var left=as_polynomial(ast[1],n); var right=as_polynomial(ast[2],n);
  se(ast[0]=="add") { retornar a::poly_add(left,right); }
  retornar a::poly_mul(left,right);
}
funcao execute(r) {
  var variables=u::count(r,"variables",1,8); var rounds=u::integer(u::num(r,"rounds",8),1,32);
  var g=obj(); put(g,"nodes",[]); put(g,"parent",[]); put(g,"ledger",[]); put(g,"limited",0);
  put(g,"limit",u::integer(u::num(r,"max_nodes",256),16,1024));
  var entry=ingest(g,r["expression"],variables,0,[0]); var iteration=0; var saturated=0;
  enquanto(iteration<rounds&&!g["limited"]&&!saturated) {
    var size=len(g["nodes"]); var changed=0; var i=0;
    enquanto(i<size&&!g["limited"]) { changed=changed+rewrite(g,i); i=i+1; }
    changed=changed+rebuild(g); saturated=changed==0&&len(g["nodes"])==size; iteration=iteration+1;
  }
  var costs=[]; var best=[]; var i=0;
  enquanto(i<len(g["nodes"])) { push(costs,1000000); push(best,-1); i=i+1; }
  var changed=1; var passes=0;
  enquanto(changed&&passes<=len(g["nodes"])) {
    changed=0; i=0;
    enquanto(i<len(g["nodes"])) {
      var node=g["nodes"][i]; var cost=1; var j=0;
      enquanto(j<len(node[2])) { cost=cost+costs[root(g,node[2][j])]; j=j+1; }
      var class=root(g,i);
      se(cost<costs[class]) { put(costs,class,cost); put(best,class,i); changed=1; }
      i=i+1;
    }
    passes=passes+1;
  }
  se(best[root(g,entry)]<0) { fail("Egraph has no finite extraction"); }
  var expression=extracted(g,entry,best,0);
  var original=as_polynomial(r["expression"],variables); var equivalent=as_polynomial(expression,variables);
  se(len(a::poly_add(original,a::poly_scale(equivalent,-1)))!=0) { fail("Extracted expression polynomial equivalence failed"); }
  var out=u::result("bounded-ring-egraph-saturation",expression);
  put(out,"nodes",len(g["nodes"])); put(out,"cost",costs[root(g,entry)]); put(out,"ledger",g["ledger"]);
  put(out,"saturated",saturated); put(out,"budget_limited",g["limited"]||(!saturated&&iteration==rounds));
  put(out,"polynomial_equivalence_checked",1); put(out,"global_optimum_claimed",0); retornar out;
}

"""Auditable stage-0 bootstrap for Omega's procedural compiler dialect.

This file is not used by the stage-1 or stage-2 compiler. It deliberately only
compiles the procedural language, not the historical tensor frontend.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

BUILTINS = {'list': 'list', 'obj': 'obj', 'len': 'len', 'get': 'get', 'put': 'put',
 'push': 'push', 'has': 'has', 'keys': 'keys', 'text': 'text', 'number': 'number',
 'ident':'ident', 'decimal':'decimal', 'isnum': 'isnum', 'isstr': 'isstr', 'islist': 'islist', 'slice': 'slice', 'join': 'join',
 'contains': 'contains', 'arg': 'arg', 'argc': 'argc', 'read': 'read', 'write': 'write',
 'print': 'print', 'fail': 'fail', 'json': 'json', 'parsejson': 'parsejson',
 'qnum':'qnum','qden':'qden','qfloor':'qfloor','qbits':'qbits','monotonic_ns':'monotonic_ns','readline':'readline','flush':'flush',
 'root_read':'root_read','root_write':'root_write','root_exists':'root_exists','sha256':'sha256','file_sha256':'file_sha256',
 'append_cas':'append_cas','ed25519_verify':'ed25519_verify','ed25519_sign':'ed25519_sign','unix_time':'unix_time'}
OPS = {'+':'add','-':'sub','*':'mul','/':'div','%':'mod','==':'eq','!=':'ne',
       '<':'lt','<=':'le','>':'gt','>=':'ge'}
TOKEN = re.compile(r'\s+|\#[^\n]*|//[^\n]*|"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"|\d+(?:\.\d+)?|[^\W\d]\w*|==|!=|<=|>=|&&|\|\||[{}();,\[\]+*/%<>=!:.\-]', re.UNICODE)


def tokenize(source):
    out=[];pos=0
    for m in TOKEN.finditer(source):
        if m.start()!=pos: raise ValueError(f'Invalid source at byte {pos}')
        pos=m.end();s=m.group()
        if not s.isspace() and not s.startswith(('#','//')): out.append(s)
    if pos!=len(source): raise ValueError('Trailing source data')
    return out+['<fim>']


class Bootstrap:
    def __init__(self, source):
        self.t=tokenize(source);self.i=0
    def take(self):
        s=self.t[self.i];self.i+=1;return s
    def accept(self,s):
        if self.t[self.i]==s:self.i+=1;return True
        return False
    def need(self,s):
        if not self.accept(s):raise ValueError(f'Expected {s}, found {self.t[self.i]} at token {self.i}')
    def name(self):
        s=self.take()
        if not s.isidentifier():raise ValueError('Identifier required')
        return s
    def expr(self,level=0):
        levels=[['||'],['&&'],['==','!='],['<','<=','>','>='],['+','-'],['*','/','%']]
        if level<len(levels):
            a=self.expr(level+1)
            while self.t[self.i] in levels[level]:
                op=self.take();a=['bin',op,a,self.expr(level+1)]
            return a
        if self.t[self.i] in ('!','-'):
            return ['un',self.take(),self.expr(level)]
        s=self.take()
        if s=='(':
            a=self.expr();self.need(')')
        elif s.startswith('"'):
            value=json.loads(s)
            if '\0' in value:raise ValueError('Embedded NUL is not supported')
            a=['s',value]
        elif s[0].isdigit():a=['n',s]
        elif s=='[':
            items=[]
            if not self.accept(']'):
                items.append(self.expr())
                while self.accept(','):items.append(self.expr())
                self.need(']')
            a=['list',items]
        elif s.isidentifier():
            if self.accept('('):
                args=[]
                if not self.accept(')'):
                    args.append(self.expr())
                    while self.accept(','):args.append(self.expr())
                    self.need(')')
                a=['call',s,args]
            else:a=['v',s]
        else:raise ValueError(f'Invalid expression token {s}')
        while self.accept('['):
            a=['index',a,self.expr()];self.need(']')
        return a
    def block(self):
        self.need('{');out=[]
        while not self.accept('}'):
            word=self.t[self.i]
            if self.accept('var'):
                n=self.name();self.need('=');out.append(['var',n,self.expr()]);self.need(';')
            elif self.accept('retornar'):
                out.append(['return',self.expr()]);self.need(';')
            elif self.accept('parar'):
                out.append(['break']);self.need(';')
            elif word in ('se','enquanto'):
                self.take();self.need('(');c=self.expr();self.need(')');body=self.block()
                other=self.block() if word=='se' and self.accept('senao') else []
                out.append([word,c,body,other])
            elif self.t[self.i+1]=='=':
                n=self.name();self.need('=');out.append(['set',n,self.expr()]);self.need(';')
            else:
                out.append(['expr',self.expr()]);self.need(';')
        return out
    def parse(self):
        funcs=[]
        while self.t[self.i]!='<fim>':
            self.need('funcao');n=self.name();self.need('(');args=[]
            if not self.accept(')'):
                args.append(self.name())
                while self.accept(','):args.append(self.name())
                self.need(')')
            funcs.append([n,args,self.block()])
        return funcs


def apply_c(name,args):
    return '({' + ''.join('V a'+str(i)+'='+cexpr(a)+';' for i,a in enumerate(args)) + name+'('+','.join('a'+str(i) for i in range(len(args)))+');})'


def c_literal(text):
    """C string syntax differs from JSON for ASCII control characters."""
    if '\0' in text:raise ValueError('Embedded NUL is not supported')
    text.encode('utf-8')
    special={'"':'\\"','\\':'\\\\','\n':'\\n','\r':'\\r','\t':'\\t'}
    return '"'+''.join(special.get(c,('\\'+format(ord(c),'03o')) if ord(c)<32 or ord(c)==127 else c)
                       for c in text)+'"'


def cexpr(e):
    kind=e[0]
    if kind in ('s','n'):return ('o_str' if kind=='s' else 'o_num')+'('+c_literal(e[1])+')'
    if kind=='v':return 'v_'+e[1]
    if kind=='index':return apply_c('o_get',e[1:])
    if kind=='call':
        name=('o_'+BUILTINS[e[1]]) if e[1] in BUILTINS else 'fn_'+e[1]
        return apply_c(name,e[2])
    if kind=='list':
        return '({V r=o_list();'+''.join('o_push(r,'+cexpr(a)+');' for a in e[1])+'r;})'
    if kind=='un':return ('o_not' if e[1]=='!' else 'o_neg')+'('+cexpr(e[2])+')'
    if e[1] in ('&&','||'):return 'o_bool(o_truth('+cexpr(e[2])+')'+e[1]+'o_truth('+cexpr(e[3])+'))'
    return apply_c('o_'+OPS[e[1]],e[2:])


def cblock(stmts):
    out=[]
    for s in stmts:
        op=s[0]
        if op in ('var','set'):out.append(('V ' if op=='var' else '')+'v_'+s[1]+'='+cexpr(s[2])+';')
        elif op=='expr':out.append(cexpr(s[1])+';')
        elif op=='return':out.append('return o_ret('+cexpr(s[1])+');')
        elif op=='break':out.append('break;')
        else:
            out.append(('if' if op=='se' else 'while')+'(o_truth('+cexpr(s[1])+')){o_tick();\n'+cblock(s[2])+'}\n')
            if s[3]:out.append('else{\n'+cblock(s[3])+'}\n')
    return '\n'.join(out)+'\n'


def compile_source(source):
    fs=Bootstrap(source).parse()
    lines=['#include "runtime.h"']
    for n,args,_ in fs:lines.append('static V fn_'+n+'('+','.join('V v_'+a for a in args)+');')
    for n,args,body in fs:
        lines.append('static V fn_'+n+'('+','.join('V v_'+a for a in args)+'){o_enter();\n'+cblock(body)+'return o_ret(o_int(0));}\n')
    lines.append('int main(int argc,char **argv){o_init(argc,argv);return (int)o_long(fn_principal());}\n')
    return '\n'.join(lines)


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('source',type=Path);p.add_argument('output',type=Path);a=p.parse_args()
    a.output.write_text(compile_source(a.source.read_text()),encoding='utf-8')
if __name__=='__main__':main()

# Omega 2 procedural language: the compiler is implemented in Omega itself.
# No host-language parser/compiler API is callable from this program.
funcao peek(p) { retornar p["tokens"][p["pos"]]; }
funcao take(p) { var s = peek(p); put(p,"pos",p["pos"]+1); retornar s; }
funcao accept(p,s) { se (peek(p)==s) { take(p); retornar 1; } retornar 0; }
funcao need(p,s) { se (!accept(p,s)) { fail("Esperado " + s + ", encontrado " + peek(p)); } retornar 0; }
funcao identifier(s) { retornar ident(s); }
funcao name(p) { var s=take(p); se (!identifier(s)) { fail("Identificador esperado: "+s); } retornar s; }
funcao lex(source) {
  var tokens=[]; var i=0;
  enquanto (i<len(source)) {
    var c=source[i];
    se (contains(" \t\r\n",c)) { i=i+1; }
    senao {
      se (c=="#" || (c=="/" && i+1<len(source) && source[i+1]=="/")) { enquanto (i<len(source) && source[i]!="\n") { i=i+1; } }
      senao {
        se (c=="\"") {
          var start=i; i=i+1;
          enquanto (i<len(source) && source[i]!="\"") {
            se (source[i]=="\\") { i=i+1; }
            i=i+1;
          }
          se (i>=len(source)) { fail("String sem fechamento"); }
          i=i+1; push(tokens,slice(source,start,i));
        }
        senao {
          se (decimal(source,i)>0) {
            var start=i;
            enquanto (i<len(source) && decimal(source,i)>0) { i=i+decimal(source,i); }
            se (i<len(source) && source[i]==".") {
              i=i+1;
              enquanto (i<len(source) && decimal(source,i)>0) { i=i+decimal(source,i); }
            }
            push(tokens,slice(source,start,i));
          }
          senao {
            se (identifier(c) || c>"~") {
              var start=i; i=i+1;
              enquanto (i<len(source) && (identifier(source[i]) || decimal(source,i)>0 || source[i]>"~")) { i=i+1; }
              push(tokens,slice(source,start,i));
            }
            senao {
              var two="";
              se (i+1<len(source)) { two=slice(source,i,i+2); }
              se (contains(["==","!=","<=",">=","&&","||"],two)) { push(tokens,two); i=i+2; }
              senao {
                se (!contains("{}();,[]+*/%<>=!-@^:.",c)) { fail("Caractere inesperado: "+c); }
                push(tokens,c); i=i+1;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  push(tokens,"<fim>"); retornar tokens;
}
funcao parser(source) { var p=obj(); put(p,"tokens",lex(source)); put(p,"pos",0); retornar p; }
funcao expr(p,level) {
  var levels=[["||"],["&&"],["==","!="],["<","<=",">",">="],["+","-"],["*","/","%"]];
  se (level<len(levels)) {
    var a=expr(p,level+1);
    enquanto (contains(levels[level],peek(p))) { var op=take(p); var b=expr(p,level+1); a=["bin",op,a,b]; }
    retornar a;
  }
  se (contains(["!","-"],peek(p))) { var op=take(p); var a=expr(p,level); retornar ["un",op,a]; }
  var s=take(p); var a=[];
  se (s=="(") { a=expr(p,0); need(p,")"); }
  senao {
    se (s[0]=="\"") { a=["s",parsejson(s)]; }
    senao {
      se (decimal(s,0)>0) { a=["n",s]; }
      senao {
        se (s=="[") {
          var items=[];
          se (!accept(p,"]")) {
            push(items,expr(p,0));
            enquanto (accept(p,",")) { push(items,expr(p,0)); }
            need(p,"]");
          }
          a=["list",items];
        }
        senao {
          se (!identifier(s)) { fail("Expressao invalida: "+s); }
          se (accept(p,"(")) {
            var args=[];
            se (!accept(p,")")) {
              push(args,expr(p,0));
              enquanto (accept(p,",")) { push(args,expr(p,0)); }
              need(p,")");
            }
            a=["call",s,args];
          } senao { a=["v",s]; }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  enquanto (accept(p,"[")) { var b=expr(p,0); a=["index",a,b]; need(p,"]"); }
  retornar a;
}
funcao block(p) {
  need(p,"{"); var out=[];
  enquanto (!accept(p,"}")) {
    var word=peek(p);
    se (accept(p,"var")) { var n=name(p); need(p,"="); var e=expr(p,0); push(out,["var",n,e]); need(p,";"); }
    senao {
      se (accept(p,"retornar")) { push(out,["return",expr(p,0)]); need(p,";"); }
      senao {
        se (accept(p,"parar")) { push(out,["break"]); need(p,";"); }
        senao {
          se (word=="se" || word=="enquanto") {
            take(p); need(p,"("); var c=expr(p,0); need(p,")"); var body=block(p); var other=[];
            se (word=="se" && accept(p,"senao")) { other=block(p); }
            push(out,[word,c,body,other]);
          }
          senao {
            se (p["tokens"][p["pos"]+1]=="=") {
              var n=name(p); need(p,"="); var e=expr(p,0); push(out,["set",n,e]); need(p,";");
            } senao { push(out,["expr",expr(p,0)]); need(p,";"); }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  retornar out;
}
funcao parse(source) {
  var p=parser(source); var functions=[];
  enquanto (peek(p)!="<fim>") {
    need(p,"funcao"); var n=name(p); need(p,"("); var args=[];
    se (!accept(p,")")) { push(args,name(p)); enquanto (accept(p,",")) { push(args,name(p)); } need(p,")"); }
    var body=block(p); push(functions,[n,args,body]);
  }
  retornar functions;
}

  retornar contains(["list","obj","len","get","put","push","has","keys","text","number","ident","decimal","isnum","isstr","islist","slice","join","contains","arg","argc","read","write","print","fail","json","parsejson","qnum","qden","qfloor","qbits","monotonic_ns","readline","flush","root_read","root_write","root_exists","sha256","file_sha256","append_cas","ed25519_verify","ed25519_sign","unix_time"],n);
}

    var a="a"+text(i); push(names,a); push(out,"V "+a+"="+cexpr(args[i])+";"); i=i+1;
  }
  push(out,n+"("+join(names,",")+");})"); retornar join(out,"");
}
funcao chex(c) {
  var digits="0123456789abcdef";var i=0;
  enquanto(i<16){se(digits[i]==c){retornar i;}i=i+1;}
  fail("Hexadecimal invalido");retornar 0;
}
funcao cstring(s) {
  var parts=["\""];var i=0;
  enquanto(i<len(s)){
    var c=s[i];var quoted=json(c);var escaped=slice(quoted,1,len(quoted)-1);
    se(c=="\u007f"){escaped="\\177";}
    senao{
      se(len(escaped)==6 && slice(escaped,0,2)=="\\u"){
        var n=16*chex(escaped[4])+chex(escaped[5]);
        escaped="\\0"+text((n-n%8)/8)+text(n%8);
      }
    }
    push(parts,escaped);i=i+1;
  }

}
funcao cexpr(e) {
  var kind=e[0];
  se (kind=="s") { retornar "o_str("+cstring(e[1])+")"; }
  se (kind=="n") { retornar "o_num("+cstring(e[1])+")"; }
  se (kind=="v") { retornar "v_"+e[1]; }
  se (kind=="index") { retornar apply_c("o_get",[e[1],e[2]]); }
  se (kind=="call") { var n="fn_"+e[1]; se (builtin(e[1])) { n="o_"+e[1]; } retornar apply_c(n,e[2]); }
  se (kind=="list") {
    var out=["({V r=o_list();"]; var i=0;
    enquanto (i<len(e[1])) { push(out,"o_push(r,"+cexpr(e[1][i])+");"); i=i+1; }
    push(out,"r;})"); retornar join(out,"");
  }
  se (kind=="un") { var n="o_neg"; se (e[1]=="!") { n="o_not"; } retornar n+"("+cexpr(e[2])+")"; }
  se (e[1]=="&&" || e[1]=="||") { retornar "o_bool(o_truth("+cexpr(e[2])+")"+e[1]+"o_truth("+cexpr(e[3])+"))"; }
  var ops=obj();
  put(ops,"+","add");put(ops,"-","sub");put(ops,"*","mul");put(ops,"/","div");put(ops,"%","mod");
  put(ops,"==","eq");put(ops,"!=","ne");put(ops,"<","lt");put(ops,"<=","le");put(ops,">","gt");put(ops,">=","ge");
  retornar apply_c("o_"+ops[e[1]],[e[2],e[3]]);
}
funcao cblock(statements) {
  var out=[]; var i=0;
  enquanto (i<len(statements)) {
    var s=statements[i]; var op=s[0];
    se (op=="var" || op=="set") { var prefix=""; se (op=="var") { prefix="V "; } push(out,prefix+"v_"+s[1]+"="+cexpr(s[2])+";"); }
    senao {
      se (op=="expr") { push(out,cexpr(s[1])+";"); }
      senao {
        se (op=="return") { push(out,"return o_ret("+cexpr(s[1])+");"); }
        senao {
          se (op=="break") { push(out,"break;"); }
          senao {
            var word="while"; se (op=="se") { word="if"; }
            push(out,word+"(o_truth("+cexpr(s[1])+")){o_tick();\n"+cblock(s[2])+"}\n");
            se (len(s[3])>0) { push(out,"else{\n"+cblock(s[3])+"}\n"); }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    i=i+1;
  }
  retornar join(out,"\n")+"\n";
}

funcao texpr(p,level) {
  se (level<2) {
    var ops=["+","-"]; se (level==1) { ops=["*","/","@"]; }
    var a=texpr(p,level+1);
    enquanto (contains(ops,peek(p))) { var op=take(p); var b=texpr(p,level+1); a=["bin",op,a,b]; }
    retornar a;
  }
  se (accept(p,"-")) { retornar ["un","-",texpr(p,2)]; }
  se (accept(p,"+")) { retornar texpr(p,2); }
  var s=take(p); var a=[];
  se (s=="(") { a=texpr(p,0); need(p,")"); }
  senao {
    se (decimal(s,0)>0) { a=["n",text(number(s))]; }
    senao {
      se (s=="[") {
        var items=[];
        se (!accept(p,"]")) { push(items,texpr(p,0)); enquanto (accept(p,",")) { push(items,texpr(p,0)); } need(p,"]"); }
        a=["list",items];
      }
      senao {
        se (!identifier(s) || reserved(s) || internal_name(s)) { fail("Expressao tensorial invalida: "+s); }
        se (accept(p,"(")) {
          var args=[];
          se (!accept(p,")")) { push(args,texpr(p,0)); enquanto (accept(p,",")) { push(args,texpr(p,0)); } need(p,")"); }
          a=["call",s,args];
        } senao { a=["v",s]; }
      }
    }
  }
  se (accept(p,"^")) { a=["bin","^",a,texpr(p,2)]; } retornar a;
}
funcao node(ir,op,args,shape) {
  se (len(ir["nos"])>=12000 || len(shape)>2) { fail("Limite da IR excedido"); }
  var size=1;var j=0;
  enquanto (j<len(shape)) { se (shape[j]<1 || shape[j]>2048 || shape[j]%1!=0) { fail("Dimensao invalida"); } size=size*shape[j];j=j+1; }
  se (size>1000000) { fail("Tensor excede o limite"); }
  var n=obj();put(n,"op",op);put(n,"args",args);put(n,"forma",shape);push(ir["nos"],n);retornar len(ir["nos"])-1;
}
funcao nshape(ir,i) { retornar ir["nos"][i]["forma"]; }
funcao shape_op(op,a,b) {
  se (op=="neg" || op=="relu") { retornar a; }
  se (op=="+" || op=="-") { se (a!=b) { fail("Soma com formas diferentes"); } retornar a; }
  se (op=="*") { se (len(a)>0 && len(b)>0) { fail("Multiplicacao de dois tensores"); } se (len(a)>0) { retornar a; } retornar b; }
  se (op=="/") { se (len(b)>0) { fail("Denominador tensorial"); } retornar a; }
  se (op=="^") { se (len(a)>0 || len(b)>0) { fail("Potencia exige escalares"); } retornar []; }
  se (op=="@") {
    se (len(a)!=2 || len(b)<1 || len(b)>2 || a[1]!=b[0]) { fail("Produto matricial incompativel"); }
    se (len(b)==1) { retornar [a[0]]; } retornar [a[0],b[1]];
  }
  se (op=="dot") { se (len(a)!=1 || a!=b) { fail("dot exige vetores iguais"); } retornar []; }
  se (op=="transposta") { se (len(a)!=2) { fail("Transposta exige matriz"); } retornar [a[1],a[0]]; }
  se (op=="soma") { retornar []; }
  fail("Operacao desconhecida: "+op);retornar [];
}
funcao lower(ir,e) {
  var kind=e[0];
  se (kind=="n") { var i=node(ir,"num",[],[]);put(ir["nos"][i],"v",e[1]);retornar i; }
  se (kind=="v") { se (!has(ir["simbolos"],e[1])) { fail("Identificador nao declarado: "+e[1]); } retornar ir["simbolos"][e[1]]; }
  se (kind=="un") { var i=lower(ir,e[2]);retornar node(ir,"neg",[i],nshape(ir,i)); }
  se (kind=="list") {
    var args=[]; var shape=[];var j=0;
    se (len(e[1])==0) { fail("Lista vazia"); }
    enquanto (j<len(e[1])) { var i=lower(ir,e[1][j]);push(args,i);se (j==0) { shape=nshape(ir,i); } se (nshape(ir,i)!=shape || len(shape)>1) { fail("Lista nao retangular"); }j=j+1; }
    var full=[len(args)];j=0;enquanto (j<len(shape)) { push(full,shape[j]);j=j+1; } retornar node(ir,"stack",args,full);
  }
  se (kind=="bin") {
    var a=lower(ir,e[2]);var b=lower(ir,e[3]);var op=e[1];
    se (op=="^") { var n=ir["nos"][b];se (n["op"]!="num") { fail("Expoente literal obrigatorio"); } var q=number(n["v"]);se (q%1!=0 || q<0 || q>20) { fail("Expoente fora de 0..20"); } }
    retornar node(ir,op,[a,b],shape_op(op,nshape(ir,a),nshape(ir,b)));
  }
  se (kind=="call") {
    var op=e[1];var args=[];var j=0;
    enquanto (j<len(e[2])) { push(args,lower(ir,e[2][j]));j=j+1; }
    se (op=="zeros" || op=="identidade") {
      se (len(args)<1 || len(args)>2 || (op=="identidade" && len(args)!=1)) { fail("Construtor exige dimensoes"); }
      var shape=[];j=0;
      enquanto (j<len(args)) { var n=ir["nos"][args[j]];se (n["op"]!="num") { fail("Dimensao literal obrigatoria"); }push(shape,number(n["v"]));j=j+1; }
      se (op=="identidade") { push(shape,shape[0]); } retornar node(ir,op,[],shape);
    }
    var count=1;se (op=="dot") { count=2; }
    se (!contains(["relu","soma","transposta","dot"],op) || len(args)!=count) { fail("Funcao ou aridade invalida: "+op); }
    var b=[];se (count==2) { b=nshape(ir,args[1]); }
    retornar node(ir,op,args,shape_op(op,nshape(ir,args[0]),b));
  }
  fail("AST tensorial invalida");retornar 0;
}
funcao signature(ir,i) {
  var n=ir["nos"][i];var op=n["op"];
  se (op=="num") { retornar [op,text(number(n["v"]))]; }
  se (op=="param") { retornar [op,n["nome"]]; }
  se (op=="zeros" || op=="identidade") { retornar [op,n["forma"]]; }
  var args=[];var j=0;enquanto (j<len(n["args"])) { push(args,signature(ir,n["args"][j]));j=j+1; }
  se ((op=="+" || op=="*") && len(nshape(ir,n["args"][0]))==0 && len(nshape(ir,n["args"][1]))==0 && json(args[0])>json(args[1])) { args=[args[1],args[0]]; }
  se (op=="transposta" && ir["nos"][n["args"][0]]["op"]=="transposta") { retornar signature(ir,ir["nos"][n["args"][0]]["args"][0]); }
  se (op=="relu" && ir["nos"][n["args"][0]]["op"]=="relu") { retornar signature(ir,n["args"][0]); }
  retornar [op,n["forma"],args];
}
funcao symbolic_node(ir,i) {
  var n=ir["nos"][i];var op=n["op"];
  se (op=="num") { retornar ["n",n["v"]]; }
  se (op=="param") {
    var shape=n["forma"];se (len(shape)==0) { retornar ["v",n["nome"]]; }
    var rows=[];var j=0;
    enquanto (j<shape[0]) {
      se (len(shape)==1) { push(rows,["v","__omega_coord_"+text(len(n["nome"]))+"_"+n["nome"]+"_1_"+text(j)]); }
      senao { var cols=[];var k=0;enquanto (k<shape[1]) { push(cols,["v","__omega_coord_"+text(len(n["nome"]))+"_"+n["nome"]+"_2_"+text(j)+"_"+text(k)]);k=k+1; }push(rows,["list",cols]); }
      j=j+1;
    }
    retornar ["list",rows];
  }
  var args=[];var j=0;enquanto (j<len(n["args"])) { push(args,symbolic_node(ir,n["args"][j]));j=j+1; }
  se (op=="stack") { retornar ["list",args]; }
  se (op=="neg") { retornar ["un","-",args[0]]; }
  se (contains(["+","-","*","/","^","@"],op)) { retornar ["bin",op,args[0],args[1]]; }
  se (op=="zeros" || op=="identidade") {
    var rows=[];var j=0;
    enquanto (j<n["forma"][0]) {
      se (len(n["forma"])==1) { push(rows,["n","0"]); }
      senao { var cols=[];var k=0;enquanto (k<n["forma"][1]) { var value="0";se (op=="identidade" && j==k) { value="1"; }push(cols,["n",value]);k=k+1; }push(rows,["list",cols]); }
      j=j+1;
    }
    retornar ["list",rows];
  }
  retornar ["call",op,args];
}
funcao expand_proof(ir,e) {
  se (e[0]=="v" && has(ir["simbolos"],e[1])) { retornar symbolic_node(ir,ir["simbolos"][e[1]]); }
  se (e[0]=="n" || e[0]=="v") { retornar e; }
  se (e[0]=="bin") { retornar ["bin",e[1],expand_proof(ir,e[2]),expand_proof(ir,e[3])]; }
  se (e[0]=="un") { retornar ["un",e[1],expand_proof(ir,e[2])]; }
  var pos=1;se (e[0]=="call") { pos=2; }var args=[];var j=0;
  enquanto (j<len(e[pos])) { push(args,expand_proof(ir,e[pos][j]));j=j+1; }
  se (pos==2) { retornar ["call",e[1],args]; }retornar ["list",args];
}
funcao tensor_ir(source) {
  var p=parser(source);var theorems=obj();var ir=obj();put(ir,"formato","omega-ir-2");put(ir,"versao","1.0.0");put(ir,"nos",[]);put(ir,"simbolos",obj());put(ir,"parametros",[]);put(ir,"perdas",obj());put(ir,"comandos",[]);
  enquanto (peek(p)!="<fim>") {
    var kind=alias(take(p));var cmd=obj();
    se (contains(["parametro","perda","vetor","matriz","tensor"],kind)) {
      var category="";
      se (kind=="parametro" && contains(["vetor","matriz"],alias(peek(p)))) { category=alias(take(p));kind="parametro_tensor"; }
      var n=tname(p);se (has(ir["simbolos"],n)) { fail("Redeclaracao: "+n); }need(p,"=");var i=lower(ir,texpr(p,0));need(p,";");var shape=nshape(ir,i);
      se ((kind=="parametro" || kind=="perda") && len(shape)>0) { fail("Escalar esperado"); }
      se ((kind=="vetor" || category=="vetor") && len(shape)!=1) { fail("Vetor esperado"); }
      se ((kind=="matriz" || category=="matriz") && len(shape)!=2) { fail("Matriz esperada"); }
      se (kind=="parametro" || kind=="parametro_tensor") {
        var pid=node(ir,"param",[],shape);put(ir["nos"][pid],"nome",n);var info=obj();put(info,"nome",n);put(info,"id",pid);put(info,"inicial",i);push(ir["parametros"],info);put(ir["simbolos"],n,pid);
      } senao { put(ir["simbolos"],n,i);se (kind=="perda") { put(ir["perdas"],n,i); } }
      put(cmd,"tipo","declaracao");put(cmd,"nome",n);
    }
    senao {
      se (contains(["gradiente","gradientes","passo","passo_livre","passo_ruidoso"],kind)) {
        var n=tname(p);se (!has(ir["perdas"],n)) { fail("Perda inexistente"); }put(cmd,"tipo",kind);put(cmd,"nome",n);
        se (kind!="gradientes") {
          keyword(p,"em");var target=tname(p);var found=0;var j=0;
          enquanto (j<len(ir["parametros"])) { se (ir["parametros"][j]["nome"]==target) { found=1; }j=j+1; }se (!found) { fail("Parametro inexistente"); }put(cmd,"parametro",target);
        }
        se (contains(["passo","passo_livre","passo_ruidoso"],kind)) {
          keyword(p,"taxa");var rate=lower(ir,texpr(p,0));se (len(nshape(ir,rate))>0) { fail("Taxa nao escalar"); }put(cmd,"taxa",rate);
          se (kind=="passo_ruidoso") { keyword(p,"semente");var seed=number(take(p));se (seed<0 || seed>=4294967296 || seed%1!=0) { fail("Semente invalida"); }put(cmd,"semente",seed); }
        }
        need(p,";");
      }
      senao {
        se (kind=="mostrar") { var n=tname(p);need(p,";");se (!has(ir["simbolos"],n) && !has(theorems,n)) { fail("Simbolo inexistente"); }se (has(theorems,n)) { kind="mostrar_teorema"; }put(cmd,"tipo",kind);put(cmd,"nome",n); }
        senao {
          se (kind=="reescrever") {
            var n=tname(p);se (!has(ir["perdas"],n)) { fail("Perda inexistente"); }need(p,"=");var i=lower(ir,texpr(p,0));need(p,";");
            se (len(nshape(ir,i))>0) { fail("Reescrita nao escalar"); }
            se (signature(ir,i)!=signature(ir,ir["perdas"][n])) {
              put(cmd,"left",symbolic_node(ir,ir["perdas"][n]));put(cmd,"right",symbolic_node(ir,i));
            }
            put(ir["perdas"],n,i);put(ir["simbolos"],n,i);put(cmd,"tipo",kind);put(cmd,"nome",n);
          }
          senao {
            se (kind=="provar" || kind=="teorema") {
              var n="";se (kind=="teorema") { n=tname(p);need(p,"=");se (has(theorems,n) || has(ir["simbolos"],n)) { fail("Teorema redeclarado"); } }
              var left=expand_proof(ir,texpr(p,0));need(p,"==");var right=expand_proof(ir,texpr(p,0));need(p,";");
              put(cmd,"tipo",kind);put(cmd,"nome",n);put(cmd,"left",left);put(cmd,"right",right);se (kind=="teorema") { put(theorems,n,1); }
            }
            senao {
              se (kind=="verificar") { var n=tname(p);need(p,";");se (!has(theorems,n)) { fail("Teorema inexistente"); }put(cmd,"tipo",kind);put(cmd,"nome",n); }
              senao { fail("Comando desconhecido: "+kind); }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    push(ir["comandos"],cmd);
  }
  retornar ir;
}
funcao compile_tensor(ir) {
  var out=["#include \"tensor_runtime.h\"\nstatic V omega_graph(V state,V dirs,long lim){V vals=o_list();\n"];var i=0;
  enquanto (i<len(ir["nos"])) {
    var n=ir["nos"][i];var op=n["op"];var args=[];var j=0;
    enquanto (j<len(n["args"])) { push(args,"v"+text(n["args"][j]));j=j+1; }
    var e="";
    se (op=="num") { e="d_num(o_num("+json(n["v"])+"))"; }
    senao {
      se (op=="param") { e="d_param(state,dirs,o_str("+json(n["nome"])+"),o_parsejson(o_str("+json(json(n["forma"]))+")))"; }
      senao {
        se (op=="zeros" || op=="identidade") { e="d_construct(o_str("+json(op)+"),o_parsejson(o_str("+json(json(n["forma"]))+")))"; }
        senao {
          se (op=="stack") { e="o_list()";var j=0;enquanto (j<len(args)) { e="o_push("+e+","+args[j]+")";j=j+1; } e="d_stack("+e+")"; }
          senao {
            var names=obj();put(names,"+","add");put(names,"-","sub");put(names,"*","mul");put(names,"/","div");put(names,"^","pow");put(names,"@","mm");put(names,"neg","neg");put(names,"relu","relu");put(names,"soma","sum");put(names,"transposta","transpose");put(names,"dot","dot");
            e="d_"+names[op]+"("+join(args,",")+")";
          }
        }
      }
    }
    push(out,"o_tick();V v"+text(i)+"="+e+";o_push(vals,v"+text(i)+");if(lim=="+text(i)+")return vals;\n");i=i+1;
  }
  push(out,"return vals;}\nint main(int argc,char **argv){o_init(argc,argv);return omega_tensor_main(omega_graph,o_parsejson(o_str("+json(json(ir))+")));}\n");retornar join(out,"");
}
funcao literal(nodes,i,q) { retornar nodes[i]["op"]=="num" && number(nodes[i]["v"])==q; }
funcao rewrite_rule(n,nodes) {
  var op=n["op"];var a=n["args"];
  se (op=="+") { se (literal(nodes,a[0],0)) { retornar ["add_zero",a[1]]; }se (literal(nodes,a[1],0)) { retornar ["add_zero",a[0]]; } }
  se (op=="-" && literal(nodes,a[1],0)) { retornar ["sub_zero",a[0]]; }
  se (op=="*") { se (literal(nodes,a[0],1)) { retornar ["mul_one",a[1]]; }se (literal(nodes,a[1],1)) { retornar ["mul_one",a[0]]; } }
  se (op=="/" && literal(nodes,a[1],1)) { retornar ["div_one",a[0]]; }
  se (op=="^" && literal(nodes,a[1],1)) { retornar ["pow_one",a[0]]; }
  se (op=="neg" && nodes[a[0]]["op"]=="neg") { retornar ["double_neg",nodes[a[0]]["args"][0]]; }
  se (op=="transposta" && nodes[a[0]]["op"]=="transposta") { retornar ["double_transpose",nodes[a[0]]["args"][0]]; }
  se (op=="relu" && nodes[a[0]]["op"]=="relu") { retornar ["relu_idem",a[0]]; }
  retornar [];
}
funcao optimize(ir) {
  var nodes=[];var mapping=[];var proofs=[];var i=0;
  enquanto (i<len(ir["nos"])) {
    var clone=parsejson(json(ir["nos"][i]));var args=[];var j=0;
    enquanto (j<len(clone["args"])) { push(args,mapping[clone["args"][j]]);j=j+1; }
    put(clone,"args",args);var rule=rewrite_rule(clone,nodes);
    se (len(rule)>0) {
      se (clone["forma"]!=nodes[rule[1]]["forma"]) { fail("Reescrita com forma divergente"); }
      push(mapping,rule[1]);var entry=obj();put(entry,"indice",i);put(entry,"regra",rule[0]);put(entry,"resultado",rule[1]);push(proofs,entry);
    } senao { push(mapping,len(nodes));push(nodes,clone); }
    i=i+1;
  }
  var result=parsejson(json(ir));put(result,"nos",nodes);var labels=["simbolos","perdas"];i=0;
  enquanto (i<len(labels)) { var map=result[labels[i]];var names=keys(map);var j=0;enquanto (j<len(names)) { put(map,names[j],mapping[map[names[j]]]);j=j+1; }i=i+1; }
  i=0;enquanto (i<len(result["parametros"])) { var p=result["parametros"][i];put(p,"id",mapping[p["id"]]);put(p,"inicial",mapping[p["inicial"]]);i=i+1; }
  i=0;enquanto (i<len(result["comandos"])) { var c=result["comandos"][i];se (has(c,"taxa")) { put(c,"taxa",mapping[c["taxa"]]); }i=i+1; }
  var cert=obj();put(cert,"tipo","reescrita_ir");put(cert,"formato","omega-opt-cert-1");put(cert,"original",ir);put(cert,"otimizado",result);put(cert,"mapeamento",mapping);put(cert,"regras",proofs);retornar cert;
}
funcao refinement_source(source) {
  var p=parser(source);var types=[];var bindings=[];var output=[];
  enquanto (accept(p,"type")) {
    var label=name(p);need(p,"=");var base=[];
    enquanto (peek(p)!="where") { push(base,take(p)); }
    need(p,"where");need(p,"{");var predicate=[];
    enquanto (peek(p)!="}") { push(predicate,take(p)); }
    need(p,"}");accept(p,";");var record=obj();put(record,"name",label);put(record,"base",base);put(record,"predicate",predicate);push(types,record);
  }
  enquanto (peek(p)!="<fim>") {
    var item=take(p);push(output,item);
    se (contains(["parametro","tensor","vetor","matriz","perda"],item)) {
      var label=name(p);push(output,label);
      se (accept(p,":")) { var record=obj();put(record,"kind",item);put(record,"name",label);put(record,"type",name(p));push(bindings,record); }
    }
  }
  var result=obj();put(result,"format","omega-refinement-source-1");put(result,"types",types);put(result,"bindings",bindings);put(result,"source",join(output," "));retornar result;
}
funcao principal() {
  se (argc()<3 || argc()>4) { fail("Uso: omegac fonte.omega destino [--ir|--optimize|--optimized-ir]"); }
  var source=read(arg(1));var p=parser(source);
  se (argc()==4 && arg(3)=="--refinement-ir") { write(arg(2),json(refinement_source(source)));retornar 0; }
  se (peek(p)=="type") { fail("Refinement types require the proof-checking build frontend"); }
  se (peek(p)=="funcao") { se (argc()!=3) { fail("Modo procedural nao aceita flags de IR tensorial"); }write(arg(2),compile_procedural(source)); }
  senao {
    var ir=tensor_ir(source);var mode="";se (argc()==4) { mode=arg(3); }
    se (!contains(["","--ir","--optimize","--optimized-ir"],mode)) { fail("Modo desconhecido"); }
    se (mode=="--optimize" || mode=="--optimized-ir") { var cert=optimize(ir);ir=cert["otimizado"];write(arg(2)+".opt.json",json(cert)); }
    se (mode=="--ir" || mode=="--optimized-ir") { write(arg(2),json(ir)); }
    senao { write(arg(2),compile_tensor(ir)); }
  }
  retornar 0;
}

"""Proposal guides have no admission authority; malformed priors are rejected."""
import math


def features(partial,variables):
    from .grammar import size,holes
    operations={'+':0,'-':0,'*':0,'/':0}
    def visit(node):
        if node[0] in operations:operations[node[0]]+=1
        for child in node[1:]:
            if isinstance(child,(tuple,list)):visit(child)
    visit(partial)
    return [size(partial)/63,holes(partial)/32,len(variables)/32,*[operations[op]/32 for op in operations],1.0]


class HeuristicPolicy:
    def __init__(self):self.statistics={}
    def priors(self,partial,productions,variables):
        weights=[]
        for label,_ in productions:
            visits,reward=self.statistics.get(label,(0,0.0))
            base=2.0 if label.startswith('var:') else 1.2 if label.startswith('const:') else 1.0
            weights.append(base*(1+reward/max(1,visits)))
        total=sum(weights)
        return [w/total for w in weights]
    def update(self,labels,reward):
        for label in labels:
            visits,total=self.statistics.get(label,(0,0.0));self.statistics[label]=(visits+1,total+reward)


class NeuralPolicy:
    """Tiny optional PyTorch guide, trained on grammar decisions and rewards."""
    def __init__(self,labels,*,seed=0):
        import torch
        if not labels or len(set(labels))!=len(labels) or len(labels)>128:raise ValueError('Bounded unique production labels required')
        self.labels=tuple(labels);self.index={v:i for i,v in enumerate(labels)}
        with torch.random.fork_rng():
            torch.manual_seed(seed);self.network=torch.nn.Sequential(torch.nn.Linear(8,32),torch.nn.Tanh(),torch.nn.Linear(32,len(labels)))
        self.optimizer=torch.optim.Adam(self.network.parameters(),lr=0.01)
        self.history=[]
    def priors(self,partial,productions,variables):
        import torch
        with torch.no_grad():logits=self.network(torch.tensor(features(partial,variables),dtype=torch.float32))
        selected=[float(logits[self.index[label]]) if label in self.index else 0.0 for label,_ in productions]
        maximum=max(selected);weights=[math.exp(v-maximum) for v in selected];total=sum(weights)
        return [v/total for v in weights]
    def train(self,observations,*,epochs=8):
        import torch
        if type(epochs) is not int or not 1<=epochs<=128 or not 1<=len(observations)<=4096:raise ValueError('Training budget exceeded')
        vectors=[];targets=[]
        for vector,label in observations:
            if len(vector)!=8 or any(not math.isfinite(float(x)) for x in vector) or label not in self.index:raise ValueError('Invalid policy observation')
            vectors.append(vector);targets.append(self.index[label])
        x=torch.tensor(vectors,dtype=torch.float32);y=torch.tensor(targets)
        for _ in range(epochs):
            self.optimizer.zero_grad();loss=torch.nn.functional.cross_entropy(self.network(x),y)
            if not torch.isfinite(loss):raise ValueError('Nonfinite guide loss')
            loss.backward();self.optimizer.step();self.history.append(float(loss.detach()))
        return tuple(self.history[-epochs:])
    def update(self,labels,reward):pass

"""PUCT over partial Omega ASTs with independent universal admission."""
from dataclasses import dataclass,field
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import math
import random
import time
from omega_refine_check.syntax import parse,evaluate,rational,render,substitute
from omega_refine_check.contracts import verify_contract
from .grammar import Grammar,holes,size
from .policy import HeuristicPolicy
from .pruning import LeanPruner


@dataclass
class Node:
    ast:tuple
    prior:float=1.0
    label:str='root'
    visits:int=0
    value:float=0.0
    children:list=field(default_factory=list)
    expanded:bool=False


def specification(spec):
    fields={'variables','ensures','examples','constants','requires','operators'}
    if type(spec) is not dict or not {'variables','ensures','examples'}<=set(spec)<=fields:raise ValueError('Explicit synthesis contract and examples required')
    variables=spec['variables']
    if type(variables) is not dict or len(variables)>32 or type(spec['examples']) is not list or not 1<=len(spec['examples'])<=64:raise ValueError('Problem budget exceeded')
    normalized=[]
    for observation in spec['examples']:
        if type(observation) is not dict or set(observation)!={'inputs','output'} or set(observation['inputs'])!=set(variables):raise ValueError('Example schema mismatch')
        env={v:rational(q) for v,q in observation['inputs'].items()}
        for v,p in variables.items():
            if evaluate(parse(p),{**env,'self':env[v]}) is not True:raise ValueError('Example violates variable contract')
        if any(evaluate(parse(p),env) is not True for p in spec.get('requires',[])):raise ValueError('Example violates precondition')
        target=rational(observation['output'])
        if evaluate(parse(spec['ensures']),{**env,'result':target}) is not True:raise ValueError('Example target violates requested postcondition')
        normalized.append((env,target))
    return normalized


def search(spec,*,iterations=1024,max_nodes=15,max_depth=8,seconds=30,seed=0,policy=None,verify=True,max_proof_checks=16):
    if type(iterations) is not int or not 1<=iterations<=100000 or type(seconds) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(seconds) or not 0<seconds<=3600 or type(seed) is not int:
        raise ValueError('MCTS execution budget exceeded')
    if type(max_proof_checks) is not int or not 1<=max_proof_checks<=128:raise ValueError('Proof budget exceeded')
    examples=specification(spec)
    grammar=Grammar(spec['variables'],spec.get('constants',[0,1,-1]),operators=spec.get('operators',['+','-','*','/','neg','relu']),max_nodes=max_nodes,max_depth=max_depth)
    guide=policy or HeuristicPolicy();pruner=LeanPruner(spec['variables'],enabled=verify)
    root=Node(('hole',));rng=random.Random(seed);started=time.monotonic()
    considered=set();rejected=[];proof_checks=0;pruned=0;evaluations=0;expansions=0;best=None;best_loss=None
    for iteration in range(iterations):
        if time.monotonic()-started>=seconds:break
        node=root;path=[node]
        while node.expanded and node.children:
            node=max(node.children,key=lambda n:(n.value/max(1,n.visits)+1.4*n.prior*math.sqrt(max(1,path[-1].visits))/(1+n.visits),rng.random()))
            path.append(node)
        if holes(node.ast) and not node.expanded:
            options=grammar.productions(node.ast);priors=guide.priors(node.ast,options,grammar.variables)
            if len(priors)!=len(options) or any(type(p) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(p) or p<0 for p in priors) or sum(priors)<=0:raise ValueError('Invalid neural/heuristic proposal distribution')
            total=sum(priors)
            for (label,ast),prior in zip(options,priors):
                if pruner.prune(ast):pruned+=1;continue
                node.children.append(Node(ast,float(prior/total),label))
            node.expanded=True;expansions+=len(options)
            if node.children:
                node=rng.choices(node.children,weights=[max(n.prior,1e-12) for n in node.children])[0];path.append(node)
        candidate=grammar.complete(node.ast,rng) if holes(node.ast) else node.ast
        try:
            loss=sum((abs(evaluate(candidate,env)-target) for env,target in examples),Q(0))
            if max(abs(loss.numerator).bit_length(),loss.denominator.bit_length())>16384:raise ValueError('Fitness arithmetic budget exceeded')
            reward=1/(1+float(loss))
        except (ValueError,ZeroDivisionError,OverflowError,TypeError):loss=None;reward=0.0
        evaluations+=1
        if loss is not None and (best_loss is None or loss<best_loss):best_loss=loss;best=candidate
        for visited in path:visited.visits+=1;visited.value+=reward
        guide.update([n.label for n in path[1:]],reward)
        key=repr(candidate)
        if loss==0 and key not in considered:
            considered.add(key)
            if not verify:
                return {'candidate':candidate,'admission':None,'verified':False,'evaluations':evaluations,'expansions':expansions,'pruned':pruned,'seed':seed}
            proof_checks+=1
            try:
                admission=verify_contract(spec['variables'],candidate,spec['ensures'],requires=spec.get('requires',()))
                return {'candidate':candidate,'source':render(candidate),'verified':True,'admission':admission,
                        'evaluations':evaluations,'expansions':expansions,'pruned':pruned,'pruning_certificates':pruner.certificates,
                        'proof_checks':proof_checks,'rejected':rejected,'seed':seed,'optimality_proved':False}
            except ValueError as error:rejected.append({'candidate':candidate,'reason':str(error)[-2000:]})
            if proof_checks>=max_proof_checks:break
    return {'candidate':None,'verified':False,'evaluations':evaluations,'expansions':expansions,'pruned':pruned,
            'pruning_certificates':pruner.certificates,'proof_checks':proof_checks,'rejected':rejected,
            'best_observed':best,'best_loss':str(best_loss),'seed':seed,'reason':'search or proof budget exhausted','optimality_proved':False}


def synthesize(spec,directory,**limits):
    import json
    from pathlib import Path
    result=search(spec,**limits)
    root=Path(directory);root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    (root/'search.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    if result['verified']:
        (root/'contract.lean').write_text(result['admission']['source'])
        lines=[]
        first=spec['examples'][0]['inputs']
        for name,value in first.items():lines.append(f'parametro {name}={render(("const",str(rational(value))))};')
        lines += ['tensor result='+result['source']+';','mostrar result;']
        source=root/'candidate.omega';source.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
        from omega_selfhost.driver import build,run
        build(source,root/'candidate');observed,native=run(root/'candidate')
        if Q(observed['values']['result'])!=rational(spec['examples'][0]['output']):raise ValueError('Native synthesized result mismatch')
        result['native_admission']=native
    return result


def isolated_search(spec,*,budget=None,**limits):
    """No-network AST proposal process, followed by independent host admission."""
    import json,sys,tempfile
    from pathlib import Path
    from omega_platform.sandbox import run
    from omega_platform.budget import Budget
    from omega_refine_check.syntax import tree
    from dataclasses import asdict
    specification(spec)
    if set(limits)-{'iterations','max_nodes','max_depth','seconds','seed'}:raise ValueError('Unknown isolated search limit')
    budget=budget or Budget(wall_seconds=60,cpu_seconds=45)
    package=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;root=package.parent
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='omega-mcts-proposal-') as temporary:
        path=Path(temporary)/'problem.json';path.write_text(json.dumps({'spec':spec,'limits':limits}))
        mounts=[root/name for name in ('omega_synth_mcts','omega_refine_check','omega','omega_selfhost','omega_platform')]
        outcome=run([sys.executable,'-E','-S','-B',package/'worker.py',path],
                    readonly=[*mounts,path,Path(sys.base_prefix)/'lib'],budget=budget,check=True)
    proposal=json.loads(outcome.stdout)
    if type(proposal) is not dict or proposal.get('verified') is not False:raise ValueError('Invalid proposal envelope')
    if proposal.get('candidate') is None:return {**proposal,'sandboxed':outcome.sandboxed,'budget':asdict(budget)}
    candidate=tree(proposal['candidate'])
    if size(candidate)>limits.get('max_nodes',15):raise ValueError('Proposal exceeds host AST budget')
    examples=specification(spec)
    if any(evaluate(candidate,env)!=target for env,target in examples):raise ValueError('Proposal fails host replay')
    admission=verify_contract(spec['variables'],candidate,spec['ensures'],requires=spec.get('requires',()))
    return {**proposal,'candidate':candidate,'source':render(candidate),'verified':True,'admission':admission,
            'sandboxed':outcome.sandboxed,'budget':asdict(budget),'optimality_proved':False}

}
